textes.Bon vent ! Tu as l'air d'avoir faim. Ça: Fair winds! You look hungry. That's lucky: so am I, always.
textes.Bon vent ! Tu as raté le dernier tour de: Fair winds! You've missed the last island tour. Come back tomorrow morning, at ten.
textes.Bon vent ! Tu montes au sommet ? L'ascen: Fair winds! Going up to the top? The lift is in the middle. It's made of glass: don't look at your feet.
textes.Bon vent ! Tu prends la capsule, toi aus: Fair winds! Are you taking the capsule too?
textes.Bon vent ! Tu tombes bien : il nous faut: Fair winds! Perfect timing: we need a witness. This kite is going to be the biggest at the Wind Festival.
textes.Bon vent ! Tu tombes bien : on cherche q: Fair winds! Perfect timing: we're looking for someone slim to do the pushing. No, I'm joking. Then again…
textes.Bon vent ! Tu tombes bien : on lâche un: Fair winds! You're just in time: we're releasing a weather balloon in a moment.
textes.Bon vent ! Tu veux le bulletin de nuit ?: Fair winds! Want the night report? It's very short: “all is well”.
textes.Bon vent ! Tu viens essayer le parapluie: Fair winds! Here to try the lift-umbrella? Everyone comes for that.
textes.Bon vent ! Tu viens voir l'hologramme ?: Fair winds! Come to see the hologram? It's even prettier at night.
textes.Bon vent ! Tu viens voir les fraises géa: Fair winds! Have you come to see the giant strawberries? Everyone comes to see the giant strawberries.
textes.Bon vent ! Tu viens voir les étoiles ? I: Fair winds! Come to see the stars? There are plenty for everyone.
textes.Bon vent ! Un jus de soleil ? C'est offe: Fair winds! A sunshine juice? It's free on board for your first flight.
textes.Bon vent ! Vous avez vu notre locataire: Fair winds! Have you met our lodger? He doesn't pay any rent, but he waters the plants.
textes.Bon vent ! Vous tombez bien : c'est l'he: Fair winds! You're just in time: it's weather report time. Assistant, notebook at the ready!
textes.Bon vent ! Vous venez écouter la harpe ?: Fair winds! Have you come to hear the harp? It only plays if you open the big window for it. Like a cat that wants to go out.
textes.Bon vent ! … Pardon, c'est l'habitude. I: Fair winds! … Sorry, force of habit. Here we say it even to ask the time.
textes.Bon vent ! … Pardon, je n'ai plus de sou: Fair winds! … Sorry, I haven't got the breath for the rest of the sentence.
Fair winds, and keep your purse shut.
textes.Bon vent, va. Assieds-toi, j'en ai une n: Fair winds, you old so-and-so. Sit down, I've got a new one.
textes.Bon vent, {surnom} ! Et essuie-toi la lè: Fair winds, {surnom}! And wipe your lip: you've got a cloud moustache. Welcome to the club!
textes.Bon vent, {surnom} ! Et garde la tête da: Fair winds, {surnom}! And keep your head in the clouds: up here, that's a compliment.
textes.Bon vent, {surnom} ! Et méfie-toi des li: Fair winds, {surnom}! And watch out for the vines on the right.
textes.Bon vent, {surnom} ! Et si quelque chose: Fair winds, {surnom}! And if something starts smoking in your bag, don't worry. Well, come and see me anyway.
textes.Bon vent, {surnom} ! Et si tu croises un: Fair winds, {surnom}! And if you meet a butterfly, say hello from me. It'll know.
textes.Bon vent, {surnom} ! Et si tu vois Barna: Fair winds, {surnom}! And if you see Barnabé down there, tell him I'm waiting for him at the glass Belvedere. With a chair.
textes.Bon vent, {surnom} ! Et si tu vois Héloï: Fair winds, {surnom}! And if you see Héloïse, tell her I'm waiting for her at the Column. She'll know.
textes.Bon vent, {surnom} ! Et si tu vois un ba: Fair winds, {surnom}! And if you see a red balloon, tell it I'm looking for it.
textes.Bon vent, {surnom} ! Face au vent, toujo: Fair winds, {surnom}! Always face the wind! And land often!
textes.Bon vent, {surnom}. Au revoir enregistré: Fair winds, {surnom}. Goodbye recorded. Expected return: soon, I hope.
textes.Bon vent, {surnom}. Et lève les yeux ce: Fair winds, {surnom}. And look up tonight. There'll be a free painting.
textes.Bon vent, {surnom}. Et pas de panique. J: Fair winds, {surnom}. And don't panic. Ever.
textes.Bon vent, {surnom}. Que vos journées soi: Fair winds, {surnom}. May your days be sunny, and your worries as light as a cumulus.
textes.Bon vent. Et si tu vois Barnabé… ne lui: Fair winds. And if you see Barnabé… don't tell him anything.
textes.Bon vent. Expression locale. Je la dis b: Fair winds. Local expression. Am I saying it right?
All right, all right. It smells good. A bit.
textes.Bon, d'accord : qu'est-ce qui est gris,: All right, fine: what's grey, very tall, and doesn't move? … Me when I'm asleep. And me when I'm awake. Hee hee!
textes.Bon, d'accord. Le Grand Spaghetti aime l: Oh, all right. The Great Spaghetti loves generous people. And people who haggle. A little.
textes.Bon, d'accord. Le partage, c'est ce qui: Oh, all right. Sharing is what makes the world go round.
textes.Bon, d'accord. Mais ne le dis à personne: Fine, okay. But don't tell anyone.
textes.Bon, d'accord. Pour toi, je fais un prix: Oh, all right. For you, I'll do a pastel price.
textes.Bon, j'ai une crête en papier, pour ce s: Right, I've got a paper mohawk for tonight. Rivet said it counts. Half.
textes.Bon, par où on va maintenant ?: So, which way do we go now?
textes.Bon, pour la traversée, je prendrai peut: Well, for the crossing, maybe I'll take a rowing boat. I'll row fast. That counts, right?
textes.Bon, pour {objet}, ça fera {prix}. Clou,: Right, for {objet}, that'll be {prix}. Clou, put that away. No, don't eat it.
textes.Bon. Alors il est trop cher, comme toujo: Good. Then it's too expensive, as always.
textes.Bon. BON ! Prends-le. Gratuitement. Tu m: Fine. FINE! Take it. For free. You wore me down. But don't tell anyone: I have a reputation as a businesswoman. Well, businessman. Anyway.
textes.Bon. Bzzt. Puisque tu insistes, {surnom}: Right. Bzzt. Since you insist, {surnom}. In the evening, when everyone's watching the auroras, I talk to the Heart. Very quietly. I tell it about the day: Ionie's coffee, Quark's pranks, Écliptique's speeches. It beats a little more gently afterwards. I think it likes stories. Don't repeat that.
Fine. Ten arches. Long ones, then.
textes.Bon. Et cette anisette, dimanche ?: Fine. And that lemonade, on Sunday?
textes.Bon. Il était une fois un hibou qui avai: All right. Once upon a time there was an owl who had lost his night…
textes.Bon. Je te le dis à toi, {surnom}. Chaqu: All right. I'm telling you, {surnom}. Every week, I write Lucas a letter. I don't sign it Lola. I sign it “The Seagull”. Sometimes I wonder if he thinks a real seagull is writing to him. That would be just like him. I don't dare talk to him, because if he said no… As long as I don't ask anything, he can't say no.
textes.Bon. Je vais te dire la vérité, {surnom}: Right. I'm going to tell you the truth, {surnom}, just this once. The Howling Bolts only ever played one gig. In front of three people and a dog. But the dog danced. I swear that dog danced. All my stories come from that one night. I just… made them a bit bigger. And one of those three people was Barricade.
textes.Bon. Je vais te dire un truc, {surnom},: OK. I'll tell you something, {surnom}, but if you repeat it, I'll deny everything. In the evening, I watch Kira dance. And afterwards, when there's nobody left, I try her steps in front of the Arcade window. I'm rubbish. But I'm practising.
textes.Bon. Le Lisse-Center n'aura pas lieu. (I: Well. There will be no Lisse-Center. (He looks at his model for a long time, then wraps it in a studded scarf.) To protect it. From the dust.
Right. We start again. I'm used to it.
textes.Bon. Puisque c'est vous, {surnom}. Chaqu: Well. Since it's you, {surnom}. Every Friday, for two years, Hector has come to dinner at my place. In a clean shirt. The second sea bream is for him. I don't tell anyone, because here a story once told no longer belongs to those who live it: it belongs to Rosalie. This one, I'm keeping. It's the only true stone I've found here.
textes.Bon. Puisque vous insistez. Oui, je nour: Fine. Since you insist. Yes, I feed the sparrows, behind the Residences. Every morning. They're called Pépin, Miette, Noisette and Gérard. Gérard is the fattest. Don't tell anyone. If people find out I have a heart, I'll have to say hello to them.
textes.Bon. Qui a une tartine dans les cheveux: Right. Who's got toast in their hair?
textes.Bon. Tiens, une brioche. Et pas de greno: All right. Here, a brioche. And no frogs in the dough trough.
textes.Bon. Tu gardes ça pour toi, {surnom}. J': Right. You keep this to yourself, {surnom}. I wrote a letter to Arc-en-Ciel. To tell him his rhythms are amazing. I gave it to Bruine to post. He never wrote back. No big deal. Well, it is, a bit. A lot. Anyway.
Fine. A drop. A little one.
textes.Bon. Une question. Tu es du genre à démo: Right. A question. Are you the type who takes things apart, or who leaves them alone?
textes.Bon. Une. Petite. Et tu ne le dis à pers: Fine. One. Small. And you don't tell anyone.
textes.Bondi ? Un lapin qui court vite et qui l: Bondi? A rabbit who runs fast and says so even faster. Three carrots, not one more, but a head as big as a pumpkin. He's cute, in his vanity. Shh.
textes.Bondi est mon voisin, dans l'arbre du su: Bondi is my neighbour, in the south tree. The night before his first cup, he knocked on my door at midnight: “Pépin, your drum is making my carrots shake.” So I moved my practice behind the bakery. He won the next day. He says it was thanks to the quiet. I say it was thanks to me.
textes.Bondi mange trois carottes avant chaque: Bondi eats three carrots before every race. He says it makes you run faster. I think it just makes… three fewer carrots.
textes.Bondi, c'est le champion. Il est rapide,: Bondi's the champion. He's fast, he's nice, he's annoying. Three times I've seen his back, and it's a very fine back, I admit. This time I'll see his snout.
textes.Bondi, mon petit frère, le champion. Je: Bondi, my little brother, the champion. I'm so proud of him my apron strings could burst. But oh, is he vain! Three carrots, not one more… but four slices of toast, if you please.
textes.Bonjour ! Approche, regarde. Tu peux tou: Hello! Come closer, have a look. You can touch. I'm Lumi, from the Swap Shop. Here, we sell almost nothing: we swap. A bolt for a ring, a ring for a story, a story for a smile. Shiny, eh? They're bolts. Yes, really. Look closer.
textes.Bonjour ! Assieds-toi, il reste une plac: Hello! Have a seat, there's one place left. Our machine makes everything: the chocolate, the toast, the coffee… and sometimes a mess.
textes.Bonjour ! Attention au drone : il arrose: Hello! Watch out for the drone: he waters anything that doesn't move fast enough. His name's Plic.
textes.Bonjour ! Attention au plateau : la Libe: Hello! Mind the tray: the Dragonfly's dancing a bit.
textes.Bonjour ! Attention aux ailes : on vient: Hello! Mind the wings: we've only just put them on. A glider in the living room is handy for tinkering with. For getting it out, much less so.
textes.Bonjour ! Attention où tu marches, les c: Hello! Watch where you step, the courgettes are very touchy.
textes.Bonjour ! Attention où vous marchez : qu: Hello! Mind where you step: when he's had a drink, he drips a bit. It's my daughter's cloud.
Hello! Mind where you step: when he's had a drink, he drips a bit. It's my son's cloud.
textes.Bonjour ! Attention à la queue : on l'a: Hello! Mind the tail: we've laid it right across the living room. Eleven metres of ribbons, hand-sewn.
textes.Bonjour ! Attention à la tête… enfin, au: Hello! Mind your head… well, the wings. Welcome to the butterfly room!
textes.Bonjour ! Au Pain Doré, tout sort du fou: Good morning! At the Pain Doré, everything's fresh from the oven. Just smell that!
textes.Bonjour ! Aubin, apothicaire. Potions de: Good day! Aubin, apothecary. Healing potions, herbal teas, remedies. Everything is tested. By me. (He pushes up his glasses; his ears are slightly green.) This morning's side effect. Expected. More or less.
textes.Bonjour ! Bienvenue dans la cabine ! Je: Hello! Welcome to the cabin! I'm Barnabé, apprentice liftkeeper. Hold on to the handrail. I'm holding on too. Very tight. It's not fear, it's… professionalism.
textes.Bonjour ! Bienvenue à l'Institut des Ven: Hello! Welcome to the Institute of Winds. Here, we listen to the sky, and sometimes it answers.
textes.Bonjour ! Bienvenue à l'Observatoire. Le: Hello! Welcome to the Observatory. Professor Lunette is out on the terrace: he's counting the clouds. He says it's upside-down astronomy.
textes.Bonjour ! Bienvenue à la station météo d: Hello! Welcome to the family weather station. Here, we forecast the weather. Today, it's fine. I predicted it.
textes.Bonjour ! Bonjour ! C'est pour toi, ça :: Hello! Hello! That's for you: you wanted a parrot that says hello. Bartholomé is practising. Well, he's trying.
textes.Bonjour ! Bonjour ! J'ai encore plein de: Hello! Hello! I've still got loads of hellos!
textes.Bonjour ! Café de la Place, installez-vo: Hello! The Square Café, make yourself comfortable. A coffee? This is the best seat for watching the town go by.
textes.Bonjour ! Capucine Buvard, fleuriste. En: Hello! Capucine Buvard, florist. Well, black-and-white florist, since the Downpour. My bouquets look like funeral notices. I don't sell a thing any more.
textes.Bonjour ! Chut, on s'entraîne : un jour,: Hello! Shh, we're practising: one day, my little girl will drive a real Column cabin. I'm on the stopwatch.
Hello! Shh, we're practising: one day, my little boy will drive a real Column cabin. I'm on the stopwatch.
textes.Bonjour ! Des fleurs ? Pour quelqu'un de: Hello! Flowers? For someone special? Everyone's special, so take two.
textes.Bonjour ! Deux coups, puis un ! C'est le: Hello! Two knocks, then one! It's the first one Pimprenelle and I learned. It's the most important. After that, you can say anything.
textes.Bonjour ! Docteur Aurèle Brise, météorol: Hello! Doctor Aurèle Brise, meteorologist at the Institute of Winds. You've arrived at fourteen minutes past ten, with a twelve-kilometre-an-hour north-westerly wind. I was expecting you at twelve past ten. Slight error of precision. Never mind: you were simply ahead of my calculations.
textes.Bonjour ! Du courrier pour vous ? Non. M: Hello! Any mail for you? No. But I check every morning anyway.
textes.Bonjour ! Excuse le désordre. Enfin, l'o: Hello! Excuse the mess. Well, the order. Well… everything's on the ceiling, you know.
textes.Bonjour ! Fais attention où tu marches,: Hello! Watch where you step, there are radishes sleeping. I'm Lavande, I look after the camp's gardens: sunflowers, tomatoes, mint, camomile… and herbal teas for everyone.
textes.Bonjour ! Fais attention à ta tête : la: Hello! Mind your head: the great wheel doesn't stop for anyone.
textes.Bonjour ! Fruits et légumes des Vergers,: Hello! Fruit and veg from the Orchards, picked this morning by Old Bastien himself. He said goodbye to them one by one.
textes.Bonjour ! Guichet des formulaires de Hau: Hello! Hautefond forms counter. How can I help you? Mind you: every question has its own form.
textes.Bonjour ! Gustave est à son kiosque, sur: Hello! Gustave's at his kiosk, out on the terrace. I'm minding the place… and the cloud machine.
textes.Bonjour ! Halima, potière. Plats à tajin: Hello! Halima, potter. Tajine dishes, jugs, cups, bowls. All made from the clay of the wadi, fired in my mother's kiln. Careful when you turn around.
Hello! Dr Roux's herbal shop. A graze, a sunburn, a broken heart? I have a tea for everything.
textes.Bonjour ! Ici, on lave le linge de tout: Hello! Here, we wash the whole neighbourhood's laundry. With hot water from the Forge pipes, it's clean before it's even wet.
textes.Bonjour ! Il est exactement l'heure de s: Good day! It is exactly time for introductions.
textes.Bonjour ! Ix Sak. Je tisse, je teins, je: Hello! Ix Sak. I weave, dye and embroider the huipils of the whole village. These colours? Red from cochineal, blue from indigo, yellow from flowers. And macaw feathers, for festivals.
textes.Bonjour ! Je chante pour la fontaine. El: Hello! I'm singing for the fountain. It sings the backing vocals: listen, it gurgles in time.
textes.Bonjour ! Je m'appelle Bouton-d'Or, j'ai: Hello! My name's Bouton-d'Or, I'm eight and a half, and I make the flower crowns for the whole camp! Do you want to dance around the ribbon tree? We go round and round, and then we fall over! Hee hee!
textes.Bonjour ! Je m'appelle Mio ! Mon papa, c: Hello! My name's Mio! My papa is Kenji, he fixes everything. And my best friend is Zéro, the android who sweeps the square. He's very old. He's forty! That's older than Papa!
textes.Bonjour ! Je m'appelle Nebet ! J'ai huit: Hello! My name's Nebet! I'm eight and a half! Where are you from? Have you seen a cat? A ginger cat, with a bent ear? His name's Miou!
textes.Bonjour ! Je peux t'interviewer ? C'est: Hello! Can I interview you? It's for my fanzine, “The Cherry on the Zine”. First question: do you have a mohawk? … No? Why not? I'm writing down: “doesn't have a mohawk yet”. That's OK, it'll come.
textes.Bonjour ! Je sers ici avec Firmin. Ce so: Hello! I wait tables here with Firmin. Tonight's special is the whistling hot chocolate. It whistles because it's happy someone's drinking it.
textes.Bonjour ! Je suis Grigri, le virus le mo: Hello! I'm Grigri, the cheapest virus in the world!
textes.Bonjour ! Je suis Pimprenelle, la plus g: Hello! I'm Pimprenelle, the greatest magician in the village! Well… when I have my wand.
textes.Bonjour ! Je suis cartographe : je dessi: Hello! I'm a cartographer: I'm drawing Hautefond, street by street. It's the hardest town to draw: it has an upstairs and a downstairs.
textes.Bonjour ! Je suis la greffière : j'écris: Hello! I'm the clerk: I write the history of the City, one session at a time.
textes.Bonjour ! Je viens des Vergers pour voir: Hello! I've come from the Orchards to see the Column up close. It's even taller than people say. And people say it a lot.
textes.Bonjour ! La Libellule part à quinze heu: Hello! The Dragonfly leaves at three. Would you like a window seat? They're all window seats.
textes.Bonjour ! La Poste de Port-Azur, lettres: Hello! The Port-Azur Post Office: letters, parcels and telegrams. Writing to someone?
textes.Bonjour ! Le chocolat d'altitude, c'est: Hello! Altitude hot chocolate is the same as down below, only served higher up. That changes everything.
textes.Bonjour ! Mirabelle, apprentie alchimist: Hello! Mirabelle, apprentice alchemist. Want a potion? They've all gone wrong. That's what makes them unique. This one makes you sneeze bubbles. That one turns your voice into a duck's for an hour.
textes.Bonjour ! Ne faites pas attention à mon: Hello! Don't mind my husband, he thinks he's an orchestra conductor. Mind you, he's the best wind conductor in the whole City.
textes.Bonjour ! Ne touche pas au bras mécaniqu: Hello! Don't touch the mechanical arm, its handshake is a bit too firm.
textes.Bonjour ! Nenetl ! Je joue du huehuetl,: Hello! Nenetl! I play the huehuetl, the big drum, the teponaztli, the slit drum, and the clay flute. And the conch shell, when Ehécatl asks me to!
textes.Bonjour ! Nous sommes en sortie scolaire: Hello! We're on a school trip. Would you like to join us? There's a quiz.
textes.Bonjour ! On trie la récolte du jour : l: Hello! We're sorting today's harvest: the pretty ones for the market, the bruised ones for stewed apples. Nothing goes to waste!
textes.Bonjour ! Pas trop de bobos aujourd'hui: Hello! Not too many bumps and scrapes today?
textes.Bonjour ! Pivoine, herboriste. Tu as l'a: Hello! Pivoine, herbalist. You look tired… No? Then you soon will be, and you'll come back to see me. Mist tea for sleeping, moon tea for dreaming.
textes.Bonjour ! Prends la chaise d'en face, si: Hello! Take the chair opposite, if you like. Usually only the clouds sit in it.
textes.Bonjour ! Prends un numéro. Ah non, il n: Hello! Take a number. Ah, no, there aren't any numbers. Take… a seat, then.
textes.Bonjour ! Prudence Touche. Voici mon pia: Hello! Prudence Touche. Here is my mechanical piano: it plays by itself, turns its own pages, and bows at the end. Sometimes the audience applauds by itself too.
textes.Bonjour ! Recule un peu : le ballon a le: Hello! Step back a little: the balloon gets hiccups when there's a crowd.
Hello! Step back a bit. A bit more. There. Mireille Volta, inventor! Welcome to the Inventors' Workshop. Everything here works. Almost. The “almost” comes free with every item, at no extra charge.
textes.Bonjour ! Reculez d'un pas. Encore un. V: Hello! Take a step back. One more. There. Miss Sulfura, flame teacher at the Infernal Academy. I don't bite, but my pupils do spit, sometimes. Sparks. By accident.
Hello! Rosalie Gomme, gardener. I look after the village's window boxes, the hedges, the trees, everything that grows. Well, everything that grows grey, now. The plants look like they're cold.
textes.Bonjour ! Samira. Soie, coton, laine du: Hello! Samira. Silk, cotton, wool from the north, desert dyes: saffron, indigo, madder. Touch it, it's soft as a cloud.
textes.Bonjour ! Solenne, ambassadrice d'Astral: Hello! Solenne, ambassador of Astralys. My job? Representing the Lumens to the islands of the archipelago. I've never been there, of course. Never. (She hides a pirate's tricorn hat behind her back.) Officially.
textes.Bonjour ! Tout va bien ? Rien de cassé ?: Hello! Everything all right? Nothing broken?
textes.Bonjour ! Tu as un boulon ? Non ? Ce n'e: Hello! Have you got a bolt? No? That's okay. I'm Pimprenelle. I'm nine, I've got three hundred and twelve bolts, and when I grow up, I'll be Grand Liftkeeper. It's already decided. We just have to tell Mistress Capucine.
textes.Bonjour ! Tu as un bout de fromage ? Mêm: Hello! Do you have a bit of cheese? Even a small one?
textes.Bonjour ! Tu crois que ce parapluie est: Hello! Do you think I'd get a refund on this umbrella if it flies away?
textes.Bonjour ! Tu embarques ? La cabine de ve: Hello! Are you boarding? The glass cabin there, at the foot of the mast, goes up to the gondola.
textes.Bonjour ! Tu entends ? Ce ronronnement,: Hello! Can you hear that? That hum is the island floating.
Hello! Can you hear that? That hum is a whole city floating.
textes.Bonjour ! Tu fais la queue ? Moi, je fai: Hello! Are you here for the queue? I'm here for the conversation.
textes.Bonjour ! Tu pars aussi ? J'ai pris mon: Hello! Are you leaving too? I've brought my best hat. It's tied on, this time.
textes.Bonjour ! Tu tombes bien, c'est l'heure: Hello! You've come at just the right time, it's breakfast. Are you hungry?
textes.Bonjour ! Tu tombes en pleine séance. As: Hello! You've dropped in mid-session. Sit at the back, and raise your hand if you have an idea.
textes.Bonjour ! Tu veux lancer la soufflerie ?: Hello! Want to start the wind tunnel? The button's right there. Not for too long, though: the ribbons get tired.
textes.Bonjour ! Tu veux m'aider ? Je compte le: Hello! Do you want to help me? I'm counting the butterflies. I've been trying for three weeks and I just can't do it.
textes.Bonjour ! Tu veux voir ? Ne regarde pas: Hello! Want to see? Don't look at the Feather's nose, I botched it.
textes.Bonjour ! Tu veux voir mon invention ? E: Hello! Want to see my invention? It doesn't exist yet, but it's brilliant.
textes.Bonjour ! Tu viens d'en bas ? Du vrai ba: Hello! Are you from down below? The real down below? The Floor? I'm Lili, I'm ten, I fly kites, and I have NEVER been down. Never! So tell me: is the sea cold? Does it move all the time? What does it smell like?
textes.Bonjour ! Tu viens d'en haut ? De là où: Hello! Are you from up top? From where the sky is? The real one? I'm Mila, I'm ten, I was born here, and I've NEVER seen the sky. Or the sun. Or rain. Or a bird. So tell me: does the sky have a ceiling? Is it far? Can you touch it if you jump?
textes.Bonjour ! Tu viens pour une réparation ?: Hello! Here for a repair? Mr Gaspard's at the counter, out front. I'm the apprentice: I make the little wheels.
textes.Bonjour ! Tu viens voir la lanterne ? L': Hello! Come to see the lantern room? The stairs are over there, at the back. Don't look down: it spins a bit.
textes.Bonjour ! Une fleur ? Elle est blanche,: Hello! A flower? It's white, but it smells nice.
textes.Bonjour ! Une table ? Je vous apporte la: Hello! A table? I'll bring you the menu. There's only one menu, it's written on the blackboard.
textes.Bonjour ! Venez voir, j'ai presque fini: Hello! Come and see, I've almost finished the lighthouse.
textes.Bonjour ! Vous montez ? … S'il vous plaî: Hello! Going up? … Please say yes, I hate going up alone!
textes.Bonjour ! Vous voulez des potins ? J'ai: Hello! Want some gossip? I've got gossip.
textes.Bonjour ! Vous êtes nouveau, n'est-ce pa: Good day! You're new, aren't you? One can tell: you keep looking up.
textes.Bonjour ! Xóchitl, la Fleur ! Je cultive: Hello! Xóchitl, the Flower! I tend the chinampas, the floating gardens. We pile lake mud onto reed mats, plant willows at the corners to hold it all together, and things grow! Maize, beans, squash, chillies, flowers!
textes.Bonjour bonjour ! Dis, toi, tu te lèves: Morning, morning! Say, are you an early riser?
textes.Bonjour bonjour ! Gaston et moi discutio: Hello, hello! Gaston and I were just talking about you. Well, mostly Gaston.
textes.Bonjour bonjour ! Gérard Dupuis, en vaca: Hello hello! Gérard Dupuis, on holiday with my wife and the little one. May I take a photo? Ah, no, I've lost my camera. What a nuisance.
textes.Bonjour bonjour ! Levée à cinq heures, f: Morning, morning! Up at five, oven lit, dough kneaded. Mochi steals the cakes… Mochi! Put that down! Pépin practises his drum behind the bakery, and the dough rises in time. And Caramel… ever since the Great Swap chain broke between us, we greet each other with the tips of our whiskers. We have to: our girls are inseparable.
textes.Bonjour bonjour ! Professeur Augustin Bo: Hello, hello! Professor Augustin Boum! Don't stand there, I'm in the middle of an experiment. Stand there. No, there. Further. Further still. Perfect.
textes.Bonjour bonjour ! Trèfle, boulangère. Pa: Hello hello! Trèfle, baker. Carrot bread, mooncake… Everything's fresh from the oven, everything's warm. Mochi! Put that cake down! … Sorry. That's my daughter.
textes.Bonjour bonjour, Pépin. Le pain est chau: Morning, morning, Pépin. The bread's hot.
Good morning first. Then three coffees.
textes.Bonjour docteur ! Mes temps sont en bais: Morning, Doctor! My times are going down!
textes.Bonjour quand même, Grommelot ! Six pièc: Good morning anyway, Grommelot! Six coins a shard?
textes.Bonjour à {joueur}, notre auditeur préfé: Hello to {joueur}, our favourite listener! Well, one of them. OK, it's you. Don't tell the seagulls.
textes.Bonjour, Amirale ! J'ai sonné neuf heure: Morning, Admiral! I rang nine o'clock on the dot!
textes.Bonjour, Archimage ! Je vous ai apporté: Good morning, Archmage! I brought you an apple.
textes.Bonjour, Basile. Vous avez cette tête… v: Hello, Basile. You've got that look… you've got a new bubble.
textes.Bonjour, Bramm. Tu as une chèvre sur l'é: Morning, Bramm. You've got a goat on your shoulder.
textes.Bonjour, Brume ! Tu sais déjà ce que j'a: Hello, Brume! Do you already know what I did this morning?
textes.Bonjour, Caelan. Tu as bien dormi ? Ah n: Morning, Caelan. Sleep well? Oh no, that's right, you were playing.
textes.Bonjour, Coquille ! Pas de récif à l'hor: Morning, Coquille! No reef on the horizon!
textes.Bonjour, Doyenne. Halo m'envoie vous sal: Hello, Elder. Halo sent me to greet you.
Good morning, Faelar. Three rays this morning.
textes.Bonjour, Fil-de-Fer ! Pas de trois-mâts: Morning, Fil-de-Fer! No three-masters in the sky?
textes.Bonjour, Flora. Bonjour, la fraise. Bonj: Hello, Flora. Hello, strawberry. Hello, strawberry. Hello, str…
textes.Bonjour, Frère Cendrin ! Je viens emprun: Morning, Brother Cendrin! I've come to borrow three embers!
textes.Bonjour, Gaston. Le sandwich est prêt ?: Hello, Gaston. Is the sandwich ready?
textes.Bonjour, Gilles ! … Il dort. Bonjour qua: Hello, Gilles! … He's asleep. Hello anyway.
textes.Bonjour, Gorgoth. Chut. Un nouveau recue: Hello, Gorgoth. Shh. A new collection?
textes.Bonjour, Grommelot ! Un petit nectar pou: Morning, Grommelot! A little nectar to sweeten your mood?
textes.Bonjour, Grommelot… Merci pour la coquil: Morning, Grommelot… Thank you for the nutshell.
textes.Bonjour, Hortense numéro deux. La vraie: Hello, Hortense number two. The real one is watching you.
textes.Bonjour, Héloïse ! C'est déjà le printem: Good day, Héloïse! Is it spring already?
textes.Bonjour, Isaac. Le stock du mois ?: Good day, Isaac. This month's stock?
textes.Bonjour, Madame Bricolette. Mes moteurs: Good day, Madame Bricolette. How are my engines?
textes.Bonjour, Madame la mairesse. Vous avez g: Hello, Madame Mayor. You won again.
Good morning, Your Majesty. Your flower has had its drink.
textes.Bonjour, Marée. Les laminaires sont bell: Good morning, Marée. Is the kelp nice today?
textes.Bonjour, Maître Filandre ! Je viens just: Good morning, Master Filandre! I've just come to read.
textes.Bonjour, Maître Lumen. Vous avez respiré: Good morning, Master Lumen. Did you breathe?
textes.Bonjour, Maître Rivet. Il va très bien,: Good day, Master Rivet. Your son is doing very well.
textes.Bonjour, Maître Rivet. Je sais ce que vo: Good morning, Master Rivet. I know what you're going to say.
Good day, Monsieur Fil. Nice hat.
textes.Bonjour, Monsieur Lisse ! Vous aimez les: Good morning, Mr Lisse! Do you like flowers?
textes.Bonjour, Monsieur Lisse. Vous aimez les: Good morning, Mister Lisse. Do you like trees?
textes.Bonjour, Monsieur le Bourgmestre. Elle b: Good day, Mr Burgomaster. Your sash is nice and shiny.
Hello, Moustache. I read the mud.
textes.Bonjour, Murmure ! Je joue plus bas, pro: Hello, Murmure! I'll play more quietly, I promise.
textes.Bonjour, Mère Sauge ! Vous portez l'écha: Good morning, Mother Sage! You're wearing the scarf!
textes.Bonjour, Mère Sauge. Rien de brûlé, rega: Good morning, Mother Sage. Nothing burnt, look.
textes.Bonjour, Mélisse… J'ai un peu de rosée d: Morning, Mélisse… I've got a little moon dew.
Hello, Noisette! May the Dawn keep you.
Good morning, Octave. Your kapok tree says hello.
Good morning, Orophin. I'm heading north.
textes.Bonjour, Perlée. Ma fleur a bu ?: Good morning, Perlée. Has my flower had its drink?
textes.Bonjour, Pimprenelle. Tu allumes toujour: Hello, Pimprenelle. Do you still light the lanterns with a snap of your fingers?
textes.Bonjour, Pip. Ta question du jour ?: Hello, Pip. Your question of the day?
textes.Bonjour, Père Bastien ! Elles sont prête: Good morning, Old Bastien! Are they ready?
textes.Bonjour, Père Bastien. Ils traitent la d: Hello, Old Bastien. They are processing the request.
textes.Bonjour, Pélagos ! Une sur trois, promis: Morning, Pélagos! One in three, promise!
textes.Bonjour, Pépin. Tu sais ta leçon d'histo: Good morning, Pépin. Do you know your history lesson?
textes.Bonjour, Rita. Toujours dans vos cartes: Good morning, Rita. Still in your cards?
textes.Bonjour, Rita. Vous n'avez rien vu, j'es: Good morning, Rita. You haven't seen anything, I hope?
textes.Bonjour, Sextant ! Bienvenue sur le belv: Hello, Sextant! Welcome to the lookout!
textes.Bonjour, Thalion. Non, je ne te dirai pa: Good morning, Thalion. No, I won't tell you.
textes.Bonjour, amiral des mouettes ! Elles t'o: Hello, admiral of the gulls! Do they obey you now? They still don't obey me.
textes.Bonjour, bonjour ! Augustin Gomme, ancie: Hello, hello! Augustin Gomme, retired schoolmaster. I taught the whole village to read. To write, too. And above all, to rub out. (He pushes his glasses up.) You're in colour? Very good. Ten out of ten.
textes.Bonjour, bonjour ! Aurélien Lumen, maîtr: Hello, hello! Aurélien Lumen, master of light, astronomer, and incidentally the only one here who sleeps during the day. Did you see the sky last night? No? What a shame. It was magnificent.
textes.Bonjour, bonjour ! Bobor, boulanger du F: Hello, hello! Bobor, baker of the Eternal Oven! My oven hasn't gone out in four hundred years: my great-great-grandfather lit it with an ember from the Ember Heart. An ember brioche? It's just out of the oven. It's hot. Always.
textes.Bonjour, bonjour ! Ernest, gardien du té: Hello, hello! Ernest, cable car keeper. Two cabins, one cable, forty seconds from the port to the city. Get in when the cabin is in the station, and don't lean out. Above all, don't lean out.
textes.Bonjour, bonjour ! Lumina, la lanternièr: Hello, hello! Lumina, the lantern-maker! Every lantern in Pandémonia, I make it: the little ones, the big ones, the round ones, the pointy ones, and the city's seven Great Lanterns. Look: this one's shaped like a horn!
textes.Bonjour, bonjour ! Pardon, je n'ai qu'un: Hello, hello! Sorry, I've only got a minute: the tube never stops. Forty capsules a day!
textes.Bonjour, bonjour ! Philémon Lunette, car: Hello, hello! Philémon Lunette, cartographer. I draw the islands that others discover. It's less dangerous. Although… this island cost me three quills and a toe.
textes.Bonjour, bonjour ! Sœur Penne, cheffe du: Hello, hello! Sister Penne, choir leader! Do you sing? Everybody sings! Even the ones who can't. ESPECIALLY the ones who can't: the Great Spaghetti loves noise. (She sings a scale, very loud and a little off-key.) Do-re-mi-fa-sol-la-ti-RAMEN!
textes.Bonjour, bonjour ! Très bien, assieds-to: Hello, hello! Very good, sit down. Radis, former natural sciences teacher, now gardener of the Shared Gardens. See these tomatoes? Ten out of ten for redness. These courgettes, seven out of ten. Could do better.
textes.Bonjour, bonjour. Assieds-toi… Non ? Tu: Hello, hello. Sit down… No? You'd rather stand? In my day, young people stood too. Out of politeness.
textes.Bonjour, bonjour… Yum Kab, gardien des a: Hello, hello… Yum Kab, keeper of the bees. My bees have no sting. They're gentle, like me. Want to taste the honey? It tastes of jungle flowers.
textes.Bonjour, jeune citoyen ! Tu as une idée: Hello, young citizen! Got an idea to propose? All ideas are welcome. Especially snack ideas.
textes.Bonjour, jeune homme. Une demi-taille, t: Good morning, young man. Still half a size?
textes.Bonjour, jeune homme… ou jeune fille ? M: Hello, young man… or young lady? My eyesight runs a bit slow, like my clock. I'm waiting for someone to fix it.
textes.Bonjour, jeune personne. Quelle heure es: Good day, young person. What time is it? Oh, forgive me. Nobody knows any more, around here.
textes.Bonjour, jeune pousse. Père Bastien Gref: Hello, young sprout. Old Bastien Greffe, gardener of the Orchards. Speak softly, please: the little pippin there has just blossomed. She's very shy. Tell her she's pretty. … There. Look how happy she is.
textes.Bonjour, les abeilles ! … Elles m'ont en: Hello, bees! … Did they hear me?
textes.Bonjour, les fraisiers ! Bien dormi ?: Good morning, strawberry plants! Sleep well?
textes.Bonjour, ma petite Madeleine. Tu as enco: Hello, my little Madeleine. Hungry again?
textes.Bonjour, madame Colette ! Et ce pot, auj: Good day, Madame Colette! And that jar, today?
textes.Bonjour, maître. Le corail mord toujours: Good morning, master. Does the coral still bite?
textes.Bonjour, maître. Vous avez l'air en form: Good day, master. You look well.
textes.Bonjour, mon gars ! Gaubert, fermier. Ce: Hello, lad! Gaubert, farmer. These fields are my life: wheat, carrots, and turnips. The turnips are… alive. A bit. In spring, they wake up and run away. But they're good little fellows. Just a bit sporty.
textes.Bonjour, mon garçon. Et bonjour, les arb: Hello, my boy. And hello, trees.
textes.Bonjour, mon petit ! Attention où tu met: Hello, dear! Watch where you step: there's a cat everywhere.
textes.Bonjour, mon petit ! Bienvenue au Camp d: Hello, little one! Welcome to the Flower Camp. I'm Granny Sunflower. I planted the very first seed of this camp… oh, a long time ago. Before you were born. Before your mother was born, maybe. Come and sit in the sun.
textes.Bonjour, mon petit ! Tu entends ? Cent s: Hello, dearie! Can you hear that? A hundred and seven cuckoo clocks, and every one of them wants its turn of the key. I'm doing my rounds.
textes.Bonjour, mon petit ! Une chouquette ? Je: Hello, dear! A sugar puff? I count them, but I share.
textes.Bonjour, mon petit cerisier. Pas encore: Hello, my little cherry tree. No flowers yet? They'll come.
textes.Bonjour, mon petit chêne. Tu as encore p: Hello, my little oak. You've grown again.
textes.Bonjour, mon petit patient. N'aie pas pe: Hello, my little patient. Don't be afraid: I don't do injections. Aurore, healer. I heal with light: I lay my hands on you, they glow, and the pain goes away. Bumps, scrapes, sorrows… Sorrows take longer. But it works on them too.
textes.Bonjour, mon petit pommier. Tu donnes to: Hello, my little apple tree. Still giving as much as ever?
textes.Bonjour, mon petit. Fais attention où tu: Hello, little one. Mind where you step: there are my ash peppers, and there my sulphur roses. Mother Brasille, gardener. I've tended these gardens for three hundred years. They're the only gardens in the world you water with hot water.
textes.Bonjour, mon petit. Je tricote des pulls: Hello, dear. I knit plaid sweaters for the whole street. When it rains, you need to be warm. And when it doesn't rain… it rains anyway, here. Want a pair of socks? I have too many.
textes.Bonjour, mon petit. Mère Sauge. Tu as un: Hello, little one. Mother Sage. You look a bit peaky, you do. Are you eating enough? Here, chew this mint leaf. It's good for everything, except hiccups.
textes.Bonjour, monsieur Échec. Votre automate: Hello, Mr Checkmate. Is your automaton well?
textes.Bonjour, passager ! Nous partons bientôt: Hello, passenger! We'll be setting off on the island tour soon. Take a seat facing one of the big windows.
textes.Bonjour, petit Phare. Tu brilles bien, a: Hello, little Lighthouse. You're shining nicely today.
Hello, little fella. Don't be scared.
textes.Bonjour, petit humain. Je suis Cargo. Je: Hello, little human. I am Cargo. I carry the containers. A container weighs twenty tonnes. A seagull weighs one kilo. I am very careful with both.
textes.Bonjour, petite étoile. Combien de quest: Good morning, little star. How many questions today?
textes.Bonjour, professeur ! Vos sourcils vont: Good day, Professor! How are your eyebrows?
textes.Bonjour, professeur. Toujours pas monté: Good morning, Professor. Still haven't gone up to see my grandfather?
textes.Bonjour, prêtresse ! Je cours, je cours: Good morning, priestess! I'm running, I'm running!
textes.Bonjour, s'il te plaît, merci : trois mo: Hello, please, thank you: three more words, Ursule.
textes.Bonjour, voyageur ! Bienvenue chez nous: Hello, traveller! Welcome to our home!
textes.Bonjour, voyageur ! Vous venez… d'en bas: Hello, traveller! Have you come… from down below?
textes.Bonjour, voyageur. Citlali, l'Étoile. J': Hello, traveller. Citlali, the Star. I teach at the calmecac, the school where you learn the songs, the calendars, writing in pictures. Our books unfold like a folding screen. We call them codices.
textes.Bonjour, {surnom} ! Bonjour, bonjour, bo: Hello, {surnom}! Hello, hello, hello! Sorry. I haven't said hello for years. I've got loads in stock.
textes.Bonjour, {surnom}. Et bonjour à la Vieil: Hello, {surnom}. And hello to the Old Lady, from you.
textes.Bonjour, {surnom}. J'ai fini le chapitre: Hello, {surnom}. I've finished chapter twelve. There's a chapter thirteen. I'm very happy.
textes.Bonjour, {surnom}. Je me sens bien. Votr: Hello, {surnom}. I feel good. Your theory works.
textes.Bonjour, {surnom}. La table du coin est: Hello, {surnom}. The corner table is free.
Hello, {surnom}. The oak says hello. I believe.
textes.Bonjour, {surnom}. Tu reviens voir la to: Hello, {surnom}. Have you come back to see the cloth? It's grown three rows since your last visit.
textes.Bonjour, {surnom}. Tu viendras danser, c: Hello, {surnom}. Will you come and dance tonight?
textes.Bonjour, {surnom}. Visage reconnu. Bonjo: Hello, {surnom}. Face recognised. Hello, bench. Hello, sparrow. Hello again, {surnom}. I said hello to you twice. It is because I am happy.
textes.Bonjour-bonjour ! Brindille, factrice !: Hello-hello! Brindille, postwoman! I fly, I deliver, I'm off again! Letters, parcels, postcards, love notes, bills, and once a cheese, but I don't talk about that any more. Got any post? No? Shame. Right, see you! … No, wait, I'll stay a bit. You look nice.
textes.Bonjour. Agathe Basalte, Doyenne de la G: Good day. Agathe Basalte, Dean of the Strata Guild. They call me wise. That's because I say little. You came down by the Line? Good. That's what it reopened for. For you. And a few others. Welcome.
textes.Bonjour. Ambroise Échec. Mon automate n': Hello. Ambroise Échec. My automaton has never lost a game. Would you like to try? No? Wise choice.
textes.Bonjour. Anouk, la guérisseuse. Mon infi: Hello. Anouk, the healer. My infirmary is on the lower deck, between the hammocks. Seaweed, honey, and plenty of patience. Are you hurt?
Hello. Aurore, castle steward. If you're looking for the Baron, he's in the garden, or on the rampart, or on a roof chasing a hat. If you're looking for someone who knows where things are, that's me.
textes.Bonjour. Commis aux registres. Si c'est: Hello. Registry clerk. If it's about a pigeon, it's the counter, on the left. If it's about anything else, it's also the counter.
textes.Bonjour. Driss. Je ne parle pas beaucoup: Hello. Driss. I don't talk much. Neither does the sea. We get along.
textes.Bonjour. Germaine. La femme de Gaubert,: Hello. Germaine. Gaubert's wife, and the farm's net. If a turnip goes by, don't move. Hup! … Saw that one coming. Do you need something? If Babette sent you, the answer is no.
textes.Bonjour. Hapou. Je cultive l'orge, le bl: Hello. Hapou. I grow barley, wheat and flax on the south bank. And I chase crocodiles out of my fields. Mostly that, these days.
textes.Bonjour. Il est exactement l'heure où no: Good day. It is exactly the time at which we meet. Tempo, timekeeper. These clocks floating around me? They're all on time. Each one at a different time: Ondelune time, Astralys time, and the time Gloubi thinks lunch is ready.
textes.Bonjour. Il est… quatorze heures, douze: Good afternoon. It is… two o'clock, twelve minutes, and seven seconds. Eight. Nine. Gaspard Ressort, clockmaker. I repair anything that goes tick-tock, and anything that ought to go tick-tock but no longer does. Do you have a watch? No? We shall fix that.
textes.Bonjour. Ingénieure Nova Volant, cheffe: Hello. Engineer Nova Volant, head of the Levitators. Touch nothing, don't jump on the porthole, and don't panic. The island floats thanks to calculations and tea. I have both.
textes.Bonjour. Je m'appelle Ortie, j'ai neuf a: Hello. My name is Ortie, I'm nine, and I'm going to be the greatest inventor in Pandémonia. After Zigomar. No: before Zigomar. You can write that down.
textes.Bonjour. Je suis Aïko. J'ai été fabriqué: Hello. I am Aïko. I was built to sort parcels. One day, a parcel came open: there was a painting of a cherry tree inside. I looked at it for eleven hours. Afterwards, I resigned. Now I paint.
textes.Bonjour. Je suis Plumeau, robot jardinie: Hello. I am Plumeau, gardener robot of the City of Clouds. I gather leaves, I water, and I say hello to the trees. Hello, tree. … There. Hello, visitor. You are chattier than the tree. It is pleasant.
textes.Bonjour. Je suis l'assistant. Assistant: Hello. I'm the assistant. Assistant meteorologist, third class: she appointed me herself. I'm still waiting for my pay rise.
textes.Bonjour. Madame Odile Nautile, institutr: Hello. Miss Odile Nautile, teacher at the School of the Deep. You're from up top? Perfect. My pupils have never seen the sky. You have. So one of these days, you'll be the one giving the lesson. Be prepared: they ask a lot of questions. Especially a little one with curls. Mila. You'll recognise her: she'll already have started.
textes.Bonjour. Mademoiselle Prune, secrétaire: Good day. Mademoiselle Prune, Monsieur Lisse's secretary. Do you have an appointment? No? I'll put you down. There: you have an appointment. Monsieur Lisse will see you in… (She checks her journal.) …never. But you may wait. The chairs are grey. All of them.
textes.Bonjour. Margot. J'ai huit ans et demi e: Hello. Margot. I'm eight and a half and I'm an engineer. Well, an apprentice. Léonce does the rockets, I do the calculations. Without me, his rockets would make even more smoke.
textes.Bonjour. Nolwenn, voilière. Tu vois les: Hello. Nolwenn, sailmaker. See the red and blue awnings all over Carène? Those are my old sails. I re-sew them, re-cut them, give them a second life.
textes.Bonjour. Nourredine, lanternier. Toutes: Hello. Nourredine, lantern maker. Every lantern in Tazira, in the souk, on the square, in the houses, comes out of my workshop. In the evening, the town lights up thanks to me.
textes.Bonjour. Perles, pierres, or ancien. J'a: Hello. Pearls, gems, antique gold. I buy too, if you have any treasures.
textes.Bonjour. Prenez le temps de respirer : v: Hello. Take the time to breathe: you've arrived.
textes.Bonjour. Respire. Voilà. Je suis Pastill: Hello. Breathe. There. I'm Pastille, volunteer nurse at the First-Aid Post, at the entrance to the Cannery. Bumps, scrapes, skateboard falls, sunburns, heartaches: everything can be treated. For heartaches, I have plasters with kittens on them.
textes.Bonjour. Tiyi. Je tisse le lin, le plus: Hello. Tiyi. I weave linen, the finest on the river: so fine you can see the light through it. My daughter, Nebet, is running around somewhere. She's always running around somewhere.
textes.Bonjour. Toujours une demi-taille de tro: Good morning. Still half a size too big?
Good morning. Three coffees. Thank you.
textes.Bonjour. Tu as réfléchi au problème du m: Hello. Have you thought about the perpetual motion problem? I have. It's impossible. Don't tell Mr Cogne.
textes.Bonjour. Vespérine, apothicaire. Potions: Hello. Vespérine, apothecary. Sap potions, magic potions, star elixirs. Everything labelled, dated and tested. On me. Don't worry about the green of my eyes: it's natural. Well, I think so.
textes.Bonjour. Wilfried Ressort. Et voici Boul: Hello. Wilfried Ressort. And this is Boulon, man's best friend… mechanical edition. He fetches, he gives his paw, he sits up and begs. He doesn't pee everywhere: that's his big advantage.
textes.Bonjour. Yolande Hublot, Atelier des Sca: Hello. Yolande Hublot, Diving Suit Workshop. I repair everything that keeps the water out: diving suits, portholes, seals, the Funicular, the Little Diver, and the Air Chimney when it coughs. Don't touch the pressure gauge. It's touchy. So am I, a little.
textes.Bonjour. Épicerie fine. On touche avec l: Good day. Fine groceries. Look with your eyes, not your hands.
textes.Bonjour. … Bonjour ! Bonjour, bonjour, b: Hello. … Hello! Hello, hello, hello! Sorry. It's been so long. (His voice is a little deep, a little crackly, like an old radio.) Thank you, my friend. Mio will be so happy. And Cargo… he kept it for me, didn't he? He keeps everything, that big softie. Here: these are the two sodas I had in my treasure hatch. For twenty years. They still sparkle.
textes.Bonjour… Attention où tu marches, chaque: Hello… Watch where you step, every dewdrop has a name.
textes.Bonjour… Pardon, je ne suis pas de très: Hello… Sorry, I'm not very good company. Hugo. I'm… on my honeymoon. Well, I was.
textes.Bonjour… Philibert Vis. Inventeur. Enfin: Hello… Philibert Vis. Inventor. Well, almost. Every idea I have, someone's already had it. Yesterday, I invented the wheel. It already existed.
textes.Bonjour… Tu as des yeux faciles, toi. Je: Hello… You've got easy eyes, you know. Did I already tell you?
textes.Bonne ! L'assemblée de ce matin a duré q: Good! This morning's assembly lasted four hours. We voted on the colour of the new gate. Pink, twenty-three votes to one. The vote against was Tapage. He wanted “black, like in 1977”.
textes.Bonne ! Le four chauffe bien, la pâte lè: Good! The oven is hot, the dough is rising. What more could you ask?
textes.Bonne ! Les maquereaux mordent, et aucun: Good! The mackerel are biting, and no gargoyle raided my stall this morning. Touch basalt.
textes.Bonne ! On est sortis à cinq heures, ren: Good! We went out at five, came back at ten, holds full. Now I'm asleep on my feet.
textes.Bonne aventure, {surnom}. Revenez entier: Happy adventuring, {surnom}. Come back in one piece: injury forms take ages to fill in.
textes.Bonne garde, Thalion ! Je te joue quelqu: Good watch, Thalion! Shall I play you something?
Have a nice day! Enjoy the sunshine.
textes.Bonne journée, {surnom}. Et tenez la ram: Have a good day, {surnom}. And hold the handrail, even on solid ground: it's a good habit.
textes.Bonne nouvelle : mer d'huile aujourd'hui: Good news: sea like glass today, just how you like it. Even the goat would have held on.
textes.Bonne nuit ! Après la dernière cabine, l: Good night! After the last cabin, the Upside-Down Column sleeps head down. Like a bat. A very well-mannered one.
textes.Bonne nuit ! Bernadette s'endort au dépô: Good night! Bernadette is going to sleep in the depot. She goes “pfff.” So will I, soon.
textes.Bonne nuit ! Ce soir, l'Albatros dort au: Good night! Tonight, the Albatross sleeps at the Mast. It snores a little when the wind blows through its rigging.
textes.Bonne nuit ! Dernier départ à vingt heur: Good night! Last departure at eight o'clock. After that, the cabin sleeps in its station, all round, like a bubble that decided to stay put.
textes.Bonne nuit ! Dernière capsule à vingt et: Good night! Last capsule at nine p.m. After that it sleeps in its station, all white, like an egg.
textes.Bonne nuit ! Dors bien : les gardes veil: Good night! Sleep well: the guards are on watch. Well… Gilles is on watch. In his own way.
textes.Bonne nuit ! Dors bien, si tu y arrives: Good night! Sleep well, if you can: the steam organ goes “parp” until eleven. After that, it snores.
Good night! Sleep well, if you can: the Bilge Rats play until quarter to midnight.
textes.Bonne nuit ! J'éteins la chaudière. Psch: Good night! I'm turning off the boiler. Psshhht… It always sighs before going to sleep. So do I.
textes.Bonne nuit ! Je ferme à vingt-trois heur: Good night! I close at eleven. The last sugar puff is mine. That's the rule. My rule.
Good night! I close at eleven. So does the machine. It gives one last, very soft little “choo”. Listen.
textes.Bonne nuit ! Je range les bancs. Il en r: Good night! I'm putting the benches away. There's always one left crooked: Brunehaut's.
textes.Bonne nuit ! Je vais chez Firmin, gagner: Good night! I'm off to Firmin's to win my evening argument.
textes.Bonne nuit ! Je vais dire bonne nuit à m: Good night! I'm going to say good night to my bolts. It takes a while.
textes.Bonne nuit ! Je vais dormir comme un rai: Good night! I'm going to sleep like a rail: nice and straight, and no squeaking.
textes.Bonne nuit ! Je vais faire un long frott: Good night! I'm going to do one long scrape on my bedroom wall. That means good night. Maybe it'll get all the way up top.
textes.Bonne nuit ! Je vais relire mes nouvelle: Good night! I'm going to reread today's news before I sleep. It gives me sweet dreams. Especially the ones with a hat.
textes.Bonne nuit ! Je vais rêver de la mer. Co: Good night! I'm going to dream about the sea. As usual.
textes.Bonne nuit ! La Forge s'endort. Elle ron: Good night! The Forge is falling asleep. It snores a little through the chimneys. Like me.
textes.Bonne nuit ! La Libellule dort sur son p: Good night! The Dragonfly is asleep at her pier. She's dreaming of speed. So am I.
textes.Bonne nuit ! La Perle devient violette,: Good night! The Pearl is turning violet, and my pot is falling asleep. She still lets out a bubble or two. She's dreaming.
textes.Bonne nuit ! La Perle est toute violette: Good night! The Pearl's all violet. They say that up there, at night, there are stars. Thousands of them. I'd count every single one. I'd never sleep.
textes.Bonne nuit ! La forge refroidit, et moi: Good night! The forge is cooling down, and so am I. Well, not my laugh. My laugh never cools down.
textes.Bonne nuit ! Le Petit Plongeon dort dans: Good night! The Little Diver is asleep in the Pool, portholes shut. I dream of diving. So does he, I bet.
textes.Bonne nuit ! Les cristaux du Gouffre bri: Good night! The Chasm crystals shine brighter at night. If you go by the Bridge, make a wish on the bluest one.
Good night! The murals sleep too. Well, they glow a little. It's the crystal. They dream in blue.
textes.Bonne nuit ! Les papillons dorment. Les: Good night! The butterflies are asleep. The strawberries keep on growing. They don't know how to stop.
textes.Bonne nuit ! Lève les yeux tout à l'heur: Good night! Look up in a little while: the auroras are going to dance. They dance for everyone, even for the ones who are asleep.
textes.Bonne nuit ! Maman a dit vingt et une he: Good night! Mum said half past nine. It's half past nine. And two minutes. I'm going, I'm going!
textes.Bonne nuit ! Mes bras dorment déjà. Mes: Good night! My arms are already asleep. My feet are still tapping a bit. They always finish the song on their own.
textes.Bonne nuit ! Moi, je reste à l'établi. J: Good night! I'm staying at the workbench. I have an idea. It isn't smoking yet.
textes.Bonne nuit ! Moi, je vais dormir au rez-: Good night! I sleep on the ground floor. I picked my flat on purpose.
textes.Bonne nuit ! On ne plane pas la nuit. Mê: Good night! No gliding at night. Even birds sleep. Well, except owls. They cheat.
textes.Bonne nuit ! Regarde : la Grande Perle d: Good night! Look: the Great Pearl is turning midnight blue, then violet. Down here, that's our sunset.
textes.Bonne nuit ! Regarde : le Soleil de Lait: Good night! Look: the Brass Sun is dimming its lamp, it's turning all amber. Down here, that's our moon.
textes.Bonne nuit ! Écoute : sous nos pieds, le: Good night! Listen: beneath our feet, the Levitators are purring. Engineer Nova says they're counting the stars.
textes.Bonne nuit ! Écoute bien : la nuit, la C: Good night! Listen closely: at night, the Column purrs. Mistress Capucine says it's dreaming.
textes.Bonne nuit, mon caillou. La marmite dort: Good night, my pebble. The pot's asleep, Excalibur's asleep, and I'm off to sleep too. In that order.
textes.Bonne nuit, mon petit veilleur. Tiens, t: Goodnight, my little night watchman. Here, your mint.
textes.Bonne nuit, mon petit. Je vais couvrir l: Good night, my little one. I'm going to bank the embers. They never go out. They just sleep. Like good ideas.
textes.Bonne nuit, {surnom}. Ciel dégagé, étoil: Good night, {surnom}. Clear skies, plenty of stars, clouds asleep. Even Gontran.
textes.Bonne nuit, {surnom}. Moi, je commence m: Good night, {surnom}. Me, I'm just starting my day. Three thousand four hundred… drat.
textes.Bonne nuit. Dors au chaud : les lanterne: Good night. Sleep warm: the lanterns watch over the city.
textes.Bonne nuit. J'éteins les lampes une par: Good night. I switch the lamps off one by one, from the pinkest to the most violet. The last one I leave on a little longer. For the lettuce that's afraid of the dark.
textes.Bonne nuit. Je dois encore dire bonne nu: Good night. I still have to say good night to a hundred and seventeen trees. I'll be quick. Well, at my own speed.
textes.Bonne nuit. Je fais encore le tour des h: Good night. One more round of the portholes. Two knocks, then one, for every pane. There are a hundred and ninety. I'll be done before midnight. More or less.
textes.Bonne nuit. Je monte allumer la lampe. R: Good night. I'm going up to light the lamp. Watch it turn tonight. It turns for you too.
textes.Bonne nuit. Je vais me recharger. Bonne: Good night. I am going to recharge. Good night, tree. Good night, bench.
textes.Bonne nuit. Je vais rentrer avant que Cé: Good night. I'll head home before Céleste comes looking for me. She has a voice like a north wind.
textes.Bonne nuit. Le Grand Cristal veille sur: Good night. The Great Crystal watches over us.
textes.Bonne nuit. Le Léviathan craque, mais il: Good night. The Léviathan creaks, but it holds.
textes.Bonne nuit. Le soleil est parti sous l'î: Good night. The sun has gone under the island. It'll come back tomorrow from the other side, brand new.
textes.Bonne nuit. Le soleil voyage sous le mon: Good night. The sun travels beneath the world, but it will return.
textes.Bonne nuit. Le vent se couche. Moi aussi: Good night. The wind's going to bed. So am I. We've always done it together.
textes.Bonne nuit. Les Jardins s'allument. Rest: Good night. The Gardens are lighting up. Stay a while, if you like. That's what the bench is for.
textes.Bonne nuit. Les bateaux dorment. Moi aus: Good night. The boats are sleeping. Me too, soon. Hm.
textes.Bonne nuit. Les moteurs veillent. Moi au: Good night. The engines keep watch. So do I, a little, with my tea.
textes.Bonne nuit. Moi, je redescends. Enfin, j: Good night. I'm heading back down. Well, I'm taking the service stairs. Shh.
textes.Bonne nuit. Moi, je redescends. Par la c: Good night. I'm heading back down. By the cabin now, like everyone else. I'm keeping the service stairs for special occasions.
textes.Bonne nuit. Si vous entendez une explosi: Good night. If you hear an explosion, it's Professor Boum. Go back to sleep.
textes.Bonne nuit. Écoute bien : ce sont les ta: Good night. Listen closely: those are the moon drums. They'll rock you till morning.
textes.Bonne nuit. Écoute la fête, elle dure ju: Good night. Listen to the party, it goes on until midnight.
textes.Bonne nuit. Écoute, avant de dormir. Le: Good night. Listen, before you sleep. Silence has a note too. Very low. It's the most beautiful one.
textes.Bonne nuit… ou bonjour. À Néopolis, on n: Good night… or good morning. In Neopolis, you never quite know.
textes.Bonne route ! Et si tu te perds dans la: Safe travels! And if you get lost in the mist, follow the lanterns.
textes.Bonne route ! Et si tu vois Jack, dis-lu: Safe travels! And if you see Jack, tell him he forgot his cables. He always forgets his cables.
textes.Bonne route ! Ici, la porte est toujours: Safe travels! Here, the door is always open. Well, it's a boiler door. It's heavy. But it's open.
Safe travels! Here, the door is always open. Well, it fell off in 1998. But same thing.
textes.Bonne route ! Si tu croises une couleur,: Safe travels! If you come across a colour, bring it back to the Palette.
textes.Bonne route, {surnom} ! Et huile tes rou: Safe travels, {surnom}! And oil your gears: in Hautefond, everything creaks, except the people.
textes.Bonne route, {surnom} ! Et méfie-toi des: Safe travels, {surnom}! And watch out for the frogs: their tongues are even longer than Mélusine's.
textes.Bonne route, {surnom} ! Et parle fort, e: Safe travels, {surnom}! And speak up, up there: so we can hear you all the way down here!
textes.Bonne route, {surnom} ! Et regarde où tu: Safe travels, {surnom}! And watch your step: there are rails everywhere down here, even where you least expect them.
textes.Bonne route, {surnom} ! Et si tu entends: Safe travels, {surnom}! And if you hear whistling up top, say hello to my old boiler.
textes.Bonne réponse. On alerte d'abord, on dis: Right answer. Alarm first, talk after. Even if it's Hulotte. Especially if it's Hulotte.
textes.Bonne réponse. Tiens : un accord de ré,: Right answer. Here: a D chord, just for you. Tonight, at the Perroquet, I'll play you three more.
textes.Bonne réponse. Tu as l'âme d'un réparate: Good answer. You've got a repairer's soul. If you ever want a screwdriver, I've got two hundred.
textes.Bonne réponse. Un équipage fidèle te ram: Right answer. A loyal crew will bring a ship home, even in pieces. The reverse isn't true. You'd make a good first mate.
textes.Bonne soirée ! Je vais réviser mon disco: Good evening! I'm off to rehearse tomorrow's speech. There's nothing to inaugurate tomorrow. I'll find something.
textes.Bonne soirée. Et couvrez-vous : il fait: Good evening. And wrap up warm: it's chilly, barely fifty degrees.
textes.Bonne soirée. La Guilde ferme, mais le c: Good evening. The Guild is closing, but the counter stays on watch. Well, Clac does.
textes.Bonne, Capitaine ! Et pas une gargouille: Good, Captain! And not a gargoyle in sight!
textes.Bonne, tant que Chak garde sa balle loin: Good, as long as Chak keeps his ball away from my pots.
textes.Bonne, tant que les chiots de Flammèche: Good, as long as Flammèche's puppies don't come digging in my flowerbeds. They bury bones under my lava begonias. I've dug up eleven bones this month. And a shoe.
textes.Bonne. J'ai ajouté une écaille au dragon: Good. I added a scale to the dragon: a red car door. He's happy. He doesn't say so, but I know: he creaked.
textes.Bonne. J'ai sorti une fournée parfaite c: Good. I took a perfect batch out of the kiln this morning. Not a single crack.
textes.Bonne. Quatre mille deux cents jours san: Good. Four thousand two hundred days without a single accident. I have a board in my office. Every morning, I add a day. It's the most beautiful number I know.
textes.Bonne. Toutes les horloges de la boutiqu: Good. All the clocks in the shop chime at the same time. All of them. Except one, which is half a second fast. I shall not sleep until it has apologised.
textes.Bonnes bulles ! C'est ainsi qu'on dit, i: Happy bubbles! That's what we say here. I say it to the jellyfish too. They don't answer. They light up, sometimes. It's almost the same.
textes.Bonnes bulles ! Et si tu as une carte po: Happy bubbles! And if you have a postcard from up there, keep it for my Topside Wall. Even folded. Even stained.
textes.Bonnes bulles, mon poisson ! Et reviens: Happy bubbles, my little fish! And come back tonight: I'm making samphire galettes. They crunch like breaking waves.
textes.Bonnes bulles, {surnom} ! Et ouvre bien: Happy bubbles, {surnom}! And keep your eyes wide open up there: I want to know everything when you get back. Everything.
textes.Bonnes bulles, {surnom} ! Et si tu crois: Happy bubbles, {surnom}! And if you run into Barnabé up there, tell him his old uncle is keeping the seat by the glass for him.
textes.Bonnes bulles, {surnom} ! Ici, ça veut d: Happy bubbles, {surnom}! Here, that means goodbye. And hello. And thank you. Bubbles are good for everything.
textes.Bonnes bulles, {surnom}. Et remontez dou: Happy bubbles, {surnom}. And go back up gently: the best things, here, happen at the speed of the tide.
Good evening! Quietly, now: the Dragonfly's asleep.
textes.Bonsoir ! Doucement, les écrans dorment: Good evening! Softly now, the screens are half asleep.
textes.Bonsoir ! Entre, le moulin tourne tout s: Good evening! Come in, the mill's turning by itself tonight: the wind knows the way.
textes.Bonsoir ! Il me reste deux croissants, j: Good evening! I've got two croissants left, you can have them half price.
textes.Bonsoir ! Je fais mes comptes : trois ce: Good evening! I'm doing my accounts: three hundred and twelve sugar puffs today. A record. Mr Pascal had forty of them.
textes.Bonsoir ! Je règle les pendules du quart: Good evening! I'm adjusting the neighbourhood's clocks. They're better behaved in the evening: we're more in sync.
textes.Bonsoir ! L'atelier est fermé, mais les: Good evening! The workshop is closed, but the inventions never really sleep.
Good evening! The Harbour Master's Office is on night watch. Like the sky.
textes.Bonsoir ! La Libellule dort, le vent aus: Good evening! The Dragonfly's asleep, and so is the wind. Me, I'm reading tomorrow's forecast. It says “fine”. It always says “fine”. And it's right.
textes.Bonsoir ! La séance est levée depuis lon: Good evening! The session ended long ago, but you can have a look. No voting, mind.
textes.Bonsoir ! Le café ouvre à sept heures. L: Good evening! The café opens at seven. The sugar puffs, at one minute past seven.
textes.Bonsoir ! Ne marche pas sur le plan, il: Good evening! Don't step on the blueprint, it's still wet. Yes, that's ink. No, it doesn't matter.
textes.Bonsoir, Amélie. Toujours pas de corail: Good evening, Amélie. Still no coral?
textes.Bonsoir, Basile. Il reste de la place po: Good evening, Basile. Any room left for nothing wrapped in wood?
Good evening, Berthe. The table at the back.
textes.Bonsoir, Ernest. Un café, comme d'habitu: Good evening, Ernest. A coffee, as usual.
textes.Bonsoir, Gaston. La bouteille de nuit ?: Good evening, Gaston. The night bottle?
textes.Bonsoir, Gorgoth. Un poème pour toi, sur: Good evening, Gorgoth. A poem for you, on the bench.
textes.Bonsoir, Lilas ! Prête pour la lune ?: Evening, Lilas! Ready for the moon?
textes.Bonsoir, Lulu. Nos champignons brillent: Good evening, Lulu. Are our mushrooms glowing nicely?
textes.Bonsoir, Mama. Votre soupe était parfait: Good evening, Mama. Your soup was perfect last night.
textes.Bonsoir, Maître Filandre. Je rapporte le: Good evening, Master Filandre. I'm bringing back volume three.
textes.Bonsoir, Mère-Lune ! Votre cape va bien: Good evening, Mère-Lune! How's your cloak?
textes.Bonsoir, Mère-Lune. Vous m'avez regardée: Good evening, Mother Moon. Did you watch me?
textes.Bonsoir, Nausicaa. La marée est haute ?: Good evening, Nausicaa. Is the tide high?
textes.Bonsoir, Nox ! Je joue ta valse ?: Good evening, Nox! Shall I play your waltz?
textes.Bonsoir, Nox ! Ta valse, ce soir ?: Good evening, Nox! Your waltz, tonight?
textes.Bonsoir, Nox ! Tout est allumé ?: Good evening, Nox! Is everything lit?
textes.Bonsoir, Nox. Rayon sept. Un nouveau rec: Good evening, Nox. Shelf seven. A new collection.
textes.Bonsoir, Philibert ! Vous m'avez gardé m: Good evening, Philibert! Did you save my seat?
textes.Bonsoir, Sylvain. Bonne table, ce soir ?: Good evening, Sylvain. Good table tonight?
textes.Bonsoir, Triton. Je chante la haute ?: Good evening, Triton. Shall I sing the high tide?
textes.Bonsoir, Ursule ! Juste des fers un tout: Evening, Ursule! Just horseshoes a teeny bit lighter?
textes.Bonsoir, Ysolde ! Les pierres brillent b: Good evening, Ysolde! The stones are shining nicely tonight.
textes.Bonsoir, Ysolde. Je peux leur lire le ch: Good evening, Ysolde. May I read them chapter eight?
textes.Bonsoir, Ysolde. Ta journée de demain se: Good evening, Ysolde. Tomorrow will be a calm day for you.
textes.Bonsoir, capitaine sans cloche. Par la q: Good evening, captain without a bell. By the keel, still afloat?
textes.Bonsoir, la patronne ! Le poêle tient le: Evening, boss! Is the stove holding up?
Good evening, my girl. It smells good tonight.
textes.Bonsoir, mon petit. Moi, c'est Mamie Kik: Good evening, little one. I'm Mamie Kiku. I've been serving tea at the Night Market since… since back when there was nothing here but a pontoon, three huts and a street lamp. Sit down. Tea isn't for drinking standing up.
textes.Bonsoir, {surnom}. Dernière montée à vin: Good evening, {surnom}. Last trip up at ten o'clock. After that, it sleeps. Don't wake it.
textes.Bonsoir, {surnom}. La Perle devient viol: Good evening, {surnom}. The Pearl is turning violet. My notebook awaits: I have a sentence to write for a hundred years from now. Perhaps you'll be in it.
textes.Bonsoir, {surnom}. Moi, je reste sur mon: Good evening, {surnom}. I'm staying on my bench. She may pass tonight. I have my question all ready.
textes.Bonsoir, {surnom}. Nuit claire, vent fai: Good evening, {surnom}. Clear night, light winds, plenty of stars. I'm never wrong about that forecast.
textes.Bonsoir. Je rentre préparer la leçon de: Good evening. I'm going home to prepare tomorrow's lesson: the wind. I'll take the class to the grille of the Air Chimney. Only a very small one comes down. But it's a real one.
textes.Bonsoir. Je vais surveiller la Fronde de: Good evening. I'm off to watch over the Fronde from the balcony. From afar. With pride. But don't repeat that.
textes.Bonsoir. L'Horloge Chantante va bientôt: Good evening. The Singing Clock will soon sing ten o'clock. It sings more softly in the evening.
Good evening. My miners are all home. Get home safe, you too. That'll make one more.
textes.Bonsoir. Mon voisin humain trouve que je: Good evening. My human neighbor finds me good company.
Good evening. Stay away from the lake.
textes.Bonsoir. Regardez le Soleil de Laiton ba: Good evening. Watch the Brass Sun dim. If the cavern stays all pink, it was my turn at the crank.
textes.Bonsoir. Si c'est un soir de concert, me: Good evening. If it's a concert night, put cotton wool in your ears. Or don't, and tell me if it was any good.
textes.Bonsoir. Sylvain. On m'appelle Doigts-d': Good evening. Sylvain. They call me Doigts-d'Argent — Silver-Fingers. Here, at the big table, we play big and lose everything. Do take a s… sorry: sit down. The dice are waiting for you.
Good evening… Shh. Look at the sky.
textes.Bonsoir… ah non, bonjour. Pour une music: Good evening… ah no, good morning. For a musician, it's always a little bit evening. Calcine, violinist of the Great Square. I play for the dancers, for the storyteller, for the passers-by. And for the lanterns, when nobody's around. They adore waltzes.
textes.Bonsoir… ou bonjour ? J'ai perdu la noti: Good evening… or good morning? I've lost all track of time, that's a good sign.
textes.Bon… Ici, on ne laisse personne au fond: Well… Here, we don't leave anyone at the bottom of the Chasm. A little something. Don't tell the Assembly: they'd want to vote on whether it was little enough.
textes.Bon… Ici, on ne laisse personne sur le c: Fine… Round here, we don't leave anyone out in the cold. A little discount. Don't tell Lisse: he'd call it “a non-optimised loss”.
textes.Bon… avant le Zéphyr quand il a le vent: Well… before the Zéphyr when it's sailing into the wind. Still counts. Hop.
textes.Bon… parce que c'est toi. Un petit geste: Well… because it's you. A little something off.
textes.Bon… parce que tu as une bonne tête de v: Well… because you have a nice face, for a traveller from up top. A little something. Don't tell Honorine, she'd want to feed you on top of it.
Well… because you have a nice traveller's face. A little discount. Don't tell Mr Pascal, he'd file a complaint with the Council.
Fine… because you've got a nice traveller's face. A little discount. Don't tell Rosalie, she'd tell the entire market.
textes.Bon… parce que tu as une bonne tête. Un: Fine… because you have a nice face. A little discount. But don't tell anyone, I have a reputation.
textes.Bon… parce que tu as une tête d'aventuri: Fine… because you've got an honest adventurer's face. A little discount. Don't tell Églantine, she'd write it down.
textes.Bon… parce que tu es descendu de si haut: Fine… because you came down from so high up. A little something. Don't tell Ernest, he'd spread it all the way up to the Clouds.
textes.Bon… pour le premier visiteur depuis mil: Well… for the first visitor in a thousand years, a little discount.
textes.Bon… pour toi, un petit rabais. Les arbr: Well… for you, a small discount. The trees saw nothing.
textes.Bon… si tu changes d'avis, tu sais où me: Well… if you change your mind, you know where to find me.
textes.Bon… tant que tu ne le répètes pas à Ros: Well… as long as you don't repeat it to Rosalie.
textes.Borin Barbe-de-Fer ? Un nain qui croit q: Borin Barbe-de-Fer? A dwarf who thinks good iron grows under his mountain. Good iron is made by the arm. He forges well. I'll never tell him so.
textes.Borin a encore volé une louche de ragoût: Borin pinched another ladle of stew before noon again. I saw him. I see everything.
textes.Borin dit qu'il est le meilleur forgeron: Borin says he's the best blacksmith on the mountain. Borin says a lot of things.
Borin is the best blacksmith in the world. He says so, and it's true. He shouts a lot. But when I get it wrong, he shows me. Every time. Even while shouting.
textes.Borin et Grimli se disputent depuis cent: Borin and Grimli have been arguing for a hundred years over who has the finest beard. It's me.
textes.Borin forge bien, je ne dis pas. Mais il: Borin forges well, I'll grant you. But he talks about his beard as if it were the city gates. Mine burnt because of him, and it grew back finer. That's a fact.
textes.Borin grave trois runes sur ta lame et l: Borin engraves three runes on your blade and feeds them at the heart of the magma. They light up, blue, and never go out again. “A king's blade, lad.”
textes.Borin rive des écailles de bronze sur ta: Borin rivets bronze scales onto your mail, like the skin of a dragon. “Dwarves wore these in the days of the Great Mines.”
textes.Borin tape fort et parle fort. Il croit: Borin hits hard and talks loud. He thinks I look down on him because I correct his runes. I correct them because his steel deserves to be well written.
textes.Borin vole une louche de ragoût tous les: Borin steals a ladleful of stew every day, says it needs salt, and goes back for thirds. The best smith on the mountain. And the worst liar.
textes.Borin. Le meilleur forgeron de la Montag: Borin. Best blacksmith in Fire Mountain. Grumpy. Chatty. A blade I can't improve any more, I send to him. He'll grumble. That's a good sign.
textes.Borin. Mon maître. Le meilleur forgeron: Borin. My master. Best blacksmith in the world, and he knows it. I still hold the coal against him. A bit. I owe him everything else.
textes.Borée ! Tu entends ? Il chante en ré !: Borée! Do you hear? It's singing in D!
textes.Borée Givrelin m'apprendra le gel si je: Borée Givrelin will teach me frost if I bring him three everlasting frost flakes from the northern cliffs. Then I'll have to cross the Mirror Lake to the Frost Crystal.
textes.Borée est têtu comme un caillou, et tu s: Borée is as stubborn as a pebble, and you know what I think of pebbles! We never agree about the north wind. And yet I'm fond of him, that old icicle. A little. A lot, on windless days.
textes.Borée et Pyra ne se parlent plus depuis: Borée and Pyra haven't spoken since the winter she melted his lake to take a bath. They'll make up eventually. In a hundred years.
textes.Borée et moi, on est deux vieux au bord: Borée and I are two old men by the water. Him his lake, me my sea. He doesn't talk, I talk for two. We get on very well. He thanks me for wood I never gave him.
textes.Borée et moi, on n'est pas d'accord sur: Borée and I don't agree about the north wind. He says it whistles. I say it sings. Out of tune, but it sings.
textes.Borée mange à la table du fond, loin de: Borée eats at the table at the back, far from the door and far from Pyra. He doesn't talk, he never blows on his spoon, he always says thank you. A perfect customer. A bit chilly, but perfect.
textes.Borée me boude depuis douze hivers pour: Borée has been sulking at me for twelve winters over a bath. A bath! He's old, he's stiff, he's slow. And he makes the finest ice in the archipelago. That annoys me even more.
textes.Borée me demande ma soupe douce, celle q: Borée asks me for my mild soup, the one that doesn't burn. Pyra asks me for my strong soup, the one with character. It's the same soup, sweetie. The same pot. I blow on one a little, I pepper the other over the counter, and there you go. Never tell them. They'd fight over who copied whom.
textes.Borée prétend que la glace est plus élég: Borée claims ice is more elegant than fire. Ice melts. Just saying.
textes.Borée était déjà là quand je suis arrivé: Borée was already here when I arrived. He's as stubborn as a glacier, and just as slow to melt. I'm very fond of him. I rarely tell him so: he freezes up.
Borée, Pyra was asking after you.
textes.Borée, c'est mon plus vieil ami. Il parl: Borée is my oldest friend. He talks little, freezes a lot, sulks for ages. But he's never forgotten a Sunday. He's a faithful man, like his lake.
textes.Borée, ta soupe douce, comme d'habitude: Borée, your mild soup, as usual?
textes.Bouge encore une fois, et ce sera une lo: Move one more time, and it'll be a ladle.
textes.Bouge pas… bouge PAS… (Ocre tire la lang: No move… NO move… (Ocre sticks out his tongue. Ocre scratches, dabs, blows red ochre onto a flat stone.) There! It you! … Well. It you in squares. Ocre did best. Take. Ocre paint another on cave wall.
textes.Bouleversée ? Je suis… je suis… (Elle tr: Upset? I'm… I'm… (She trips over nothing.) Sorry. My sun rosary! Father Clotaire gave it to me for my fifteenth birthday. I was praying by the lake for Monsieur Yvon, and an enormous, ENORMOUS frog stuck out its tongue and… slurp. It swallowed it. Monsieur Yvon calls it the Duchess. Frogs spit out what they swallow when you beat them, apparently. Would you please… ? I'll pray. From afar. From very far.
textes.Boulon ! La camionnette bleue, ce dimanc: Boulon! The blue van, this Sunday?
textes.Boulon ! Tu gardes la meute, ce soir ?: Boulon! Will you watch the pack tonight?
textes.Boulon a fait l'aller jusqu'à Tazira en: Boulon flew all the way to Tazira barking at every cloud. Every cloud! I could hear the Zéphyr barking from the airfield, and through my binoculars I could see a spring tail sticking out of the window. Gustave said he'd never had a better-guarded flight. The clouds didn't say a word.
textes.Boulon a un cœur. Un vrai petit moteur q: Boulon has a heart. A real little engine that beats faster when you pet him. I made it that way on purpose.
textes.Boulon est allé à Tazira en Zéphyr. Il a: Boulon went to Tazira on the Zéphyr. He barked the whole flight. Not at the passengers: at the clouds. Every single cloud. Gustave said he'd never had a better-guarded flight. The commander, who stayed on the ground, swears she could hear him from the airfield. The whole way, Boulon defended the Zéphyr against the entire sky.
textes.Boulon est déjà allé à Tazira en dirigea: Boulon has already been to Tazira by airship. He chased the cats at the port. He didn't catch a single one. They caught him.
textes.Boulon et sa grue Mademoiselle sont mes: Boulon and his crane Mademoiselle are my biggest fans. I put fairy lights on the crane and wired the fountain to it. Boulon thinks it's magnificent. He's right.
textes.Boulon garde mes chiens pendant les conc: Boulon looks after my dogs during concerts. They sleep on his belly. He doesn't move for two hours. He's the most patient man on the island.
textes.Boulon passe me voir le dimanche. Il sou: Boulon comes by on Sundays. He lifts the cars so I can look for parts underneath. He puts them down gently. Always. Even the wrecks. Especially the wrecks.
textes.Boulon remonte à bord, demain ?: Can Boulon come aboard again tomorrow?
textes.Boulon soulève mes épaves comme des orei: Boulon lifts my wrecks like pillows. He always puts them down gently. Even the rustiest. He's got the biggest heart on the island, in the biggest body.
textes.Boulon te soulève à bout de bras pour qu: Boulon lifts you up at arm's length so you can see the stage. What a view!
textes.Boulon voudrait savoir, et moi aussi : v: Boulon would like to know, and so would I: do you prefer dogs or cats?
textes.Boulon vous a reconnu. Regardez sa queue: Boulon recognised you. Look at his tail!
textes.Boulon, c'est ma montagne. Je dors dessu: Boulon is my mountain. I sleep on him. He doesn't move. He's the best mountain.
Boulon. Big. Gentle. Scared of heights. Drives a crane. That's courage. The real kind.
textes.Boum ! Boum-boum ! Boum fait parler tamb: Boum! Boum-boum! Boum make drum talk. Drum say: everybody dance! You dance too?
textes.Boum ! Dis-moi, {surnom} : tu as le ryth: Boom! Tell me, {surnom}: have you got rhythm?
