textes.Tiens, goûte. … Alors ? Je le savais. Le: Here, taste. … Well? I knew it. The saffron comes from Aïcha's, the preserved lemon from my mother's, and the sea bream… from yours. Take one for the road, and these few coins. And come back on Friday.
textes.Tiens, il pleut ? Non : c'est le petit n: Hey, is it raining? No: it's the family's little cloud passing over your head. It looks very happy to see you.
textes.Tiens, le fuyard ! Tu cours toujours aus: Well, if it isn't the runaway! Still running as fast?
textes.Tiens, le passager ! Toujours en bateau: Well, the passenger! Still going by boat? Do me a favour: the steps of the quay, at a run. Hop!
textes.Tiens, le supporter de Raymond. Tu viens: Well, if it isn't Raymond's supporter. Come to see a real champion, or did you get the wrong pitch again?
textes.Tiens, mon amateur de vanille ! Ta boule: Well, my vanilla fan! Your scoop is waiting for you. In my mind, still. But for real too, if you drop by.
textes.Tiens, mon chou : deux potions de mana,: Here, dearie: two mana potions, for your trouble. They're surely magic. These ones, I'm almost sure.
textes.Tiens, mon métronome préféré ! Tu sais q: Well, if it isn't my favourite metronome! Did you know you walk in rhythm? You do, you do. I heard it from the bridge. One step, two steps, one-two-three-four… You were made for the mosh pit.
textes.Tiens, mon retardataire. À l'heure, aujo: Well, if it isn't my latecomer. On time, today? No? I only said it to encourage you.
textes.Tiens, quelques pièces, et deux bols de: Here, a few coins, and two bowls of soup to take away. They're in jars, with a lid. Copeau made the lids. Out of pallets, of course.
textes.Tiens, revoilà la jeunesse. Tu viens m'a: Well, look who's back, young blood. Come to help me untangle, or just to listen to my stories?
textes.Tiens, te revoilà, {surnom} ! Ça fait {a: Well, look who's back, {surnom}! It's been {absence}. Gaston thought the crabs had eaten you.
Here, hold the pot. … (You hold the pot. He gets paint everywhere. Mostly on you.) … Perfect! Here, for the helping hand.
textes.Tiens, tiens… Toi qui réfléchis : tu pré: Well, well… You're a thinker: would you rather know the answer, or keep the mystery?
textes.Tiens, tiens… Un humain. Je suis Cardamo: Well, well… A human. I'm Cardamome. I love riddles, secrets and people who think. Do you think?
textes.Tiens, tiens… Venez donc m'expliquer, vo: Well, well… Come and explain yourself, you.
textes.Tiens, tiens… Viens donc m'expliquer, to: Well, well… Come and explain yourself, you.
textes.Tiens, toi. L'eau est bonne, aujourd'hui: Oh, it's you. The water's lovely today. Coming in?
textes.Tiens, tu as la moustache de chocolat de: Well, look, you've got my brother Firmin's chocolate moustache! You've been to the Jolly Piston, admit it. Is his machine still whistling? Ha! Up here, we froth. It's more refined.
textes.Tiens, un gâteau de miel de Bobor, que j: Here, a Bobor honey cake that I was saving for myself. I'm giving it to you: you did the hardest part, I only did the planting.
textes.Tiens, un nouveau visage ! Rosa. On m'ap: Well, a new face! Rosa. They call me the Red, for my hair, not for blood. Well, not only. I look after the Moray's cannons. Sixteen cannons, all my babies.
textes.Tiens, un nouveau. Scarlett. On m'appell: Well, a new one. Scarlett. They call me la Rouquine — the Redhead — guess why. I throw knives. Not at people. Well… not at polite people.
textes.Tiens, un visiteur du soir ! J'écoute la: Well, an evening visitor! I'm listening to the radio: sometimes the Albatross passes down below, and Héloïse wishes me good night. With plenty of cheek.
textes.Tiens, une bulle. Avec du rien dedans. E: Here, a bubble. With nothing inside. And no wood.
Here, a corn cake from Ix Chab.
textes.Tiens, une petite carte de ton portrait,: Here, a little card of your portrait, as a souvenir!
textes.Tiens, une petite fusée de remerciement…: Here, a little thank-you rocket… no, some coins, rather. Rockets are for the party.
textes.Tiens, une petite inconnue à capuche…: Well, well, a little stranger in a hood…
textes.Tiens, {dernier_cadeau}. Hmm. Merci, je: Well, {dernier_cadeau}. Hmm. Thanks, I suppose. I'm sure I'll find a use for it.
textes.Tiens, {surnom} ! Monte, j'ai du neuf. E: Well, {surnom}! Come on up, I've got new stock. Well, the same stock.
textes.Tiens, {surnom} ! Tu veux que je t'appre: Hey, {surnom}! Want me to teach you the code? Two knocks, then one: hello, thank you. Three quick knocks: found a bolt. One long scrape: good night. The rest is secret.
textes.Tiens, {surnom}. Je t'ai vu venir depuis: Well, {surnom}. I saw you coming from the jetty.
textes.Tiens, {surnom}. Tu as pris un peu de pl: Well, {surnom}. You've caught a bit of rain. It suits you.
Hold it tight… nice and gently.
textes.Tiens. (Ses antennes clignotent bleu.) T: Well, well. (His antennae blink blue.) You'd make a good apprentice. Don't get excited, I don't take any. But you'd make a good apprentice.
Here. Hang it above your bed. And if you ever have a nightmare, come tell me: I'll strengthen the net.
textes.Tiens. Des pièces, et trois flacons de m: Here. Some coins, and three flasks of my tonic: honey, fever grass, syrup and a secret. One sip, and you get back up from any brawl. Well, almost any.
Well. Sunflower. It's going to rain.
textes.Tiens… on se connaît ?: Well now… do we know each other?
textes.Tilleul ! Et alors, cette louve, elle l': Tilleul! So, that she-wolf, did she fish the moon out?
textes.Tilleul ! Tu as reçu mon histoire ?: Tilleul! Did you get my story?
textes.Tilleul ? Le premier qui m'ait raconté u: Tilleul? The first one who told me a story in Ramure, and the only one who's never told me the end of one. My oldest friend. His paws creak as much as mine.
textes.Tilleul, le conteur de Ramure. Un ours q: Tilleul, the storyteller of Ramure. A bear who tells stories the way you take a nap: slowly, and you wake up happy. He taught me that a story can happen twice.
textes.Tilleul, le conteur de Ramure. Un ours,: Tilleul, the storyteller of Ramure. A bear, a real one, with ears. He tells stories better than me, but he falls asleep before the end. In Carène, nobody believes me when I talk about him.
textes.Tisane de brume pour dormir, de lune pou: Mist tea for sleeping, moon tea for dreaming. Every evening I take Mother Moon hers, and I sew the fox ears she gives to travellers who help her. Roux comes home with leaves in his tail and swears he was picking herbs. And Trèfle's tarts, I can smell them a hundred paces off: I walk past just as they come out of the oven. How? The nose, of course.
textes.Tisser en secret le tapis de ma propre n: To secretly weave the carpet for my own wedding, at night, while Rachid sleeps, and unroll it in front of him on the wedding day. For once in his life, he'd be speechless.
textes.Tisser un huipil avec toutes les couleur: To weave a huipil with all the colours of the island: the blue of the Cenote, the green of the jungle, the yellow of the sun, the red of the macaws, and Tiyi's white. You'd see it from Aztlán!
textes.Tisser un lin si fin qu'il flotterait da: To weave a linen so fine it would float in the air like smoke. We'd let it go from the top of the temple, and it would take an hour to fall.
textes.Tisser à Ondine une robe couleur de sole: To weave Ondine a sun-coloured dress, for the day she goes up there. I'd need yellow thread. Under the sea, there's only the gold of the crown, and the queen is rather attached to it. Will you bring me some?
textes.Titou ! Ta pirouette, elle compte pas do: Titou! Your pirouette doesn't count double.
textes.Titou a inventé le crabe amoureux, je le: Titou invented the lovestruck crab, I admit it. But he danced it badly: too many arms, not enough hips. I fixed it, called it the “sentimental crab” and I teach it. He's demanding his name on my poster. I offered him a teeny little line at the bottom. He said: “Thank you, Miss.” I couldn't tell if that was mean.
textes.Titou compte les versions de mes histoir: Titou counts the versions of my stories and imitates my dancing on the square, in front of all the kids. “The elegant seal.” Cheeky. And he forgets the shoulder move, on top of it.
textes.Titou dit qu'il en est à dix-sept versio: Titou says he's up to seventeen versions of my party in the mine. He writes them down in a journal. One evening he read me version seven, the one with the dragon. I didn't remember telling it. It was very good. I served it up again to Gaspard the next day, polished a little.
textes.Titou dit qu'une pirouette compte double: Titou says a pirouette counts double. That's not in the rules! There aren't any rules, but it's not in the rules. Apart from that, he's my jumping brother.
textes.Titou est adorable, drôle, généreux… et: Titou is adorable, funny, generous… and I haven't got a single sharp photo of him in three years. Not one. And on top of that, he's the one who lost my last glow sticks.
textes.Titou fait le dauphin dans son spectacle: Titou plays the dolphin in his show on the square, to make fun of me. He jumps, he goes “kik-kik”, he ends up in a bucket of water. The kids scream with laughter. I went to watch, ready to grumble. I laughed so hard I gave every kid a necklace. His dolphin cost me fifteen necklaces.
textes.Titou me pique mes élèves, mes idées et: Titou steals my pupils, my ideas and my side of the fountain. He's funny, that's the worst part. His lovestruck crab, I kept it in my class, under a better name.
textes.Titou, l'épaule. On roule l'épaule, comm: Titou, the shoulder. You roll the shoulder, like this.
textes.Titou, ton pas de danse, là, c'est quoi: Titou, that dance step of yours, what is it?
textes.Titou, tu es encore de mon côté de la fo: Titou, you're on my side of the fountain again.
textes.Titou. Une photo. Tu ne bouges pas. D'ac: Titou. One photo. You don't move. OK?
textes.Titouan ! On suit qui, aujourd'hui ?: Titouan! Who are we following today?
textes.Titouan ! Un conseil d'ami ?: Titouan! A word from a friend?
textes.Titouan croit à tous mes exploits. Tous: Titouan believes in all my exploits. All of them! It's for him that I wish they were true. He'll be a great adventurer. Greater than me. That's not hard.
textes.Titouan est né pendant que je finissais: Titouan was born while I was finishing an order of twenty swords for the guard. I put down the hammer, had my son, looked at him and said: “He's got good shoulders.” His father, a sailor, went back to sea soon after. He sends shells. Titouan keeps them in a box. I keep Titouan.
textes.Titouan m'a demandé comment on bat un sl: Titouan asked me how to beat a slime. I explained: one hit, it bounces; two hits, it melts. He nodded. Then he watched me do it. I gave the first hit, the slime bounced off my nose, and I fell backwards into the wash-house. Titouan wrote in his notebook: “Don't stand in front of the slime.” It's very good advice.
textes.Titouan m'a dit un jour qu'il voulait êt: Titouan told me one day he wanted to be rank S because his papa wasn't here. My papa isn't here either. He's across the sea. So I gave him my biscuit. He ate it without a word. Then he gave me one of his shells. The smallest one. I keep it with my papa's letters, in the biscuit tin.
textes.Titouan veut devenir rang S. Il me deman: Titouan wants to become rank S. He asks me for advice, then he watches me fail, and he writes down what not to do. He has two notebooks. He'll go very far.
Titouan wants to be an S-rank adventurer. Not a blacksmith. I know. I teach him smithing anyway, because an adventurer who can mend his own sword comes home more often. That's all I want. For him to come home.
Titouan wants to be rank S. Not a blacksmith. I know. I teach him smithing anyway, because an adventurer who can mend his sword comes home. That's all I want.
textes.Titouan, c'est le guerrier de la Guilde: Titouan is the Little Heroes' Guild's warrior. He's got a hammer, he's very brave, and he wants to be rank S. He pretends he's not scared. I pretend to believe him.
textes.Titre de demain : « Achille Plumevent to: Tomorrow's headline: “Achille Plumevent still in flight”. Like yesterday. Like the day before.
textes.Titre de la Gazette, un mardi : « Le Zép: Gazette headline, one Tuesday: “The Zéphyr Is Three Minutes Late”. On the front page! Three minutes! There was a headwind over Carène. I wrote a right of reply. She printed it. With a typo: “The commander disputes the elay”. The whole city laughed. So did I. A little. The next day.
textes.Tiyi ! Le quatrième, c'est qui ? Juste l: Tiyi! Who's the fourth one? Just the first sign!
textes.Tiyi ! Tu as porté ma ceinture ?: Tiyi! Have you worn my belt?
textes.Tiyi ! Une perche, pour Nebet. Rien que: Tiyi! A perch, for Nebet. Just for Nebet.
textes.Tiyi tisse le lin le plus fin du monde,: Tiyi weaves the finest linen in the world, white as dawn. She speaks softly and laughs on the inside. She says she only likes white. I don't entirely believe her.
textes.Tiyi tisse mes robes et le lin des autel: Tiyi weaves my robes and the altar linen. She speaks little, laughs softly, and her white is the purest on the river. I'd trust her with my secrets. I already trust her with my wardrobe.
textes.Tiyi tisse mon lin. Elle choisit chaque: Tiyi weaves my flax. She picks each bunch the way you pick a friend: slowly, in silence. She's fair, she pays well, and she never laughs at my crocodiles. That's rare.
textes.Tiyi tisse un lin si fin qu'on voit le s: Tiyi weaves linen so fine you can see the sun through it. Me, when I see her, I can't see anything at all. Because of the sun, I mean. Obviously.
textes.Tiyi, c'est ma meilleure amie depuis l'e: Tiyi has been my best friend since childhood. She weaves the most beautiful linen on the river and she turned down three suitors this year. She says four. I don't know the fourth one. I'll find out.
textes.Tiyi, la tisserande, a refusé trois prét: Tiyi the weaver turned down three suitors this year. Three! She says she prefers her loom. I understand her: at least the loom doesn't snore.
Tiyi, your robe still shines at dawn.
Tiyi. The flax is fine this year.
textes.Tlaco a juste soif ! Tlaloc est d'accord: Tlaco's just thirsty! Tlaloc doesn't mind!
textes.Tlaco aboie après Mixtli depuis le premi: Tlaco has been barking at Mixtli since the first day. Because of the jaguar skin. I explained to Tlaco that he's a man. He doesn't agree. Mixtli says Tlaco is right to be wary of jaguars, even jaguars with a man inside. So now Tlaco barks, and Mixtli says thank you.
textes.Tlaco aboie après les serpents de pierre: Tlaco barks at the stone serpents at the bottom of the stairs. Every day. I tell him they're gods, he barks louder. One day, Cuauhtli walked by, looked at Tlaco, looked at the serpents… and I think he smiled. Just a tiny bit. Nobody believes me.
Tlaloc forgives him. So do I.
textes.Tlaloc va t'adorer ! La pluie, c'est le: Tlaloc is going to love you! Rain means maize, flowers, the lake. It's life. And a few colds, all right. But mostly life.
Tobias! My roof's leaking, on the north side.
textes.Tobias ! Ta galette, dans ta poche, comm: Tobias! Your crêpe, in your pocket, as usual.
textes.Tobias a cloué une casserole au plafond: Tobias nailed a saucepan to the ceiling of his workshop, right under my anvil. Every time I strike, it rings. He says it's so I hear what he hears. So I hung a saucepan under my anvil too, which rings at the same time. Now it makes music. He doesn't find it funny.
textes.Tobias bouche les trous du bateau depuis: Tobias has been plugging the holes in the ship for thirty years and never has time to eat. So every morning, I put a crêpe in his pocket. He says thank you the way other people say sorry.
textes.Tobias dit que je suis ses yeux sous la: Tobias says I'm his eyes under the hull. I tell him where it's seeping, where the wood's soft. He listens without sighing, which is rare for him. And his daughter is my friend.
textes.Tobias dit que la coque tiendra encore c: Tobias says the hull will hold for another hundred years. Tobias has been saying that for thirty years.
textes.Tobias me dit que la coque tiendra encor: Tobias tells me the hull will hold another hundred years. He's been telling me that for thirty years. I know what it means: he'll spend his life on it. No one is more faithful to this ship.
textes.Tobias recalfate ma barque-maison chaque: Tobias re-caulks my boat-house every autumn and won't let me pay him. He takes a mackerel, he sighs, he leaves. Gloomy as a windless day, but a good lad.
textes.Tobias se plaint de tout, et surtout de: Tobias complains about everything, and especially about me. He says one day I'll go straight through the deck. He's the grumpiest man in Carène, and I owe him more than he'll ever say.
textes.Tobias se plaint du bruit. Tobias se pla: Tobias complains about the noise. Tobias complains about everything.
textes.Tobias soupire chaque fois que je parle: Tobias sighs every time I talk about putting the Léviathan back in the water. He sighs when I don't talk about it too. But he's the one who knows how to plug the holes, so I keep coming back.
textes.Tobias, le calfat, doit reboucher une vo: Tobias, the caulker, has to patch a leak in the hull of the Léviathan. He needs good timber.
textes.Tobias. Tribord, sous la troisième membr: Tobias. Starboard, under the third frame, it's seeping.
textes.Toc toc ! … Ah non, c'est toi qui frappe: Knock knock! … Oh no, you're the one knocking. Shall we start over?
textes.Toc toc toc ? Hé, c'est MOI qui fais les: Knock knock knock? Hey, I'M the one who tells the jokes around here!
textes.Toc toc… (Une voix ensommeillée, derrièr: Knock knock… (A sleepy voice, behind the door.) “Who's there? … Ah, it's you. We're asleep, it's night! Come back tomorrow, we'll look for the colours together.”
textes.Toc toc… La Maison du Conseil est fermée: Knock knock… The Council House is closed. A poster: “Extraordinary meeting: WHERE HAVE OUR COLOURS GONE? Everyone is asked to search everywhere.”
textes.Toc toc… Personne : de jour, tout le mon: Knock knock… Nobody: by day, everyone is out looking for the colour pots.
textes.Toc toc… Personne. Sur la porte, un peti: Knock knock… Nobody. On the door, a little note: “Gone to find the blue of the sky. Back soon! — the Brush family”
textes.Toc toc… Personne. Un mot un peu taché :: Knock knock… Nobody. A slightly smudged note: “Gone to find the red of the poppies. Please water our flowers, thanks! — the Blotter family”
textes.Toc toc… Personne. Un petit mot : « Part: Knock knock… Nobody. A little note: “Gone to find the green of the leaves. Don't erase anything while we're away! — the Rubber family”
textes.Toc, toc, toc. Une petite voix, derrière: Knock, knock, knock. A little voice, behind the door: "
textes.Toc, toc. Le seul qui répond, c'est la p: Knock, knock. The only one answering is the rain on the roof: tic, tic, tic…
textes.Toc, toc. Rien… Un écriteau peint : « En: Knock, knock. Nothing… A painted sign: “Meditating. Come back in an hour, or in a lifetime.”
textes.Toc, toc… Personne. Sur la porte, un pet: Knock, knock… Nobody. On the door, a little note: “Gone to pick poppies. Come back whenever you like, the door of the heart is always open (this one, not so much).”
textes.Toc, toc… Rien. Puis, de très loin dans: Knock, knock… Nothing. Then, from deep inside the yurt, a sleepy voice: “… It's not time for rehearsal yet…”
textes.Tochtli ! Encore un escargot magique à m: Tochtli! Another magic snail to sell me?
textes.Tochtli ! Mes plumes sont bien arrivées: Tochtli! Did my feathers get to Aztlán safely?
textes.Tochtli ! Tu as vendu ma jarre à crocs ?: Tochtli! Did you sell my fanged jar?
textes.Tochtli a voulu me vendre une plume de q: Tochtli tried to sell me a quetzal feather. It was a parrot feather painted green. I gave him his feather back. On his head.
textes.Tochtli emporte mes jarres jusqu'à Per-H: Tochtli takes my jars all the way to Per-Hâpy and comes back with stories. He sells everything, even my cracked jars. Especially my cracked jars. I never know how much he makes. That's probably for the best.
textes.Tochtli est mon cousin. Il vend de tout,: Tochtli is my cousin. He sells everything, he talks non-stop, and he sold me a parrot feather painted green. I gave it back to him. On his head. He hasn't forgiven me for the training. We're even. Almost.
textes.Tochtli m'achète mes plumes d'ara et les: Tochtli buys my macaw feathers and sells them for three times the price in Aztlán. He calls it trade. I call it feathers that gain value by travelling.
textes.Tochtli vend son copal plus cher les jou: Tochtli sells his copal for more on feast days. The gods see it. He sells them copal anyway, through me. I don't know who he's robbing. Maybe everyone, a little.
Tochtli sells his copal dearer on feast days. The gods see it. Tochtli sees the gods too, for that matter: he sells them copal.
textes.Tochtli vend tout, même ce qu'il n'a pas: Tochtli sells everything, even what he doesn't have. He sells me my own seeds dearer on feast days. He's funny, he's clever, and you never know if he's lying. Neither does he, I think.
textes.Tochtli vendrait le vent s'il pouvait. I: Tochtli would sell the wind if he could. He has tried, actually. He says I should charge for my music. Music is like air: if you sell it, it suffocates.
textes.Tochtli. Mes fleurs, à ton étal ?: Tochtli. My flowers, on your stall?
textes.Tochtli. Ton copal coûte combien, aujour: Tochtli. How much is your copal today?
textes.Tochtli. Une plume de quetzal, une vraie: Tochtli. A quetzal feather, a real one?
textes.Toi ! C'est toi ! Tu es là ! Tu es TOUJO: You! It's you! You're here! You're ALWAYS here! It's the best day of my life! Again!
textes.Toi ! Les pigeons parlent de toi !: You! The pigeons are talking about you!
textes.Toi ! Ne crois pas que je ne sais pas ce: You! Don't think I don't know what you did.
textes.Toi ! Oui, toi ! Tu seras mon rival !: You! Yes, you! You shall be my rival!
textes.Toi ! Oui, toi. Tu viens d'en haut ? Vie: You! Yes, you. Are you from up top? Come here, I need you for a lesson.
textes.Toi ! T'as un sacré crochet du gauche. M: You! You've got a cracking left hook. My jaw still remembers it. Respect.
textes.Toi ! Ta veste ! Viens ici, elle a besoi: You! Your jacket! Come here, it needs me!
textes.Toi ! Toi trop maigre ! Pas assez de car: You! You too skinny! Not enough squares! Eat, eat. Fern flatbread, Granny Silex recipe. Nice and crunchy.
textes.Toi ! Tu as faim ? Bien sûr que tu as fa: You! Are you hungry? Of course you're hungry!
textes.Toi ! Tu as l'air affamé. Entre donc !: You! You look starving. Come on in!
textes.Toi ! Tu as une tête à aimer les histoir: You! You look like someone who loves stories.
textes.Toi ! Tu connais la différence entre un: You! Do you know the difference between a radish and a turnip?
textes.Toi ! Tu n'es pas blessé, au moins ?: You there! You're not hurt, are you?
textes.Toi ! Tu sais manier la hache ?: You! Can you handle an axe?
textes.Toi ! Tu sais quel jour on est ?: You! Do you know what day it is?
textes.Toi ! Tu tombes bien ! Dis-lui, toi :: You! Just in time! Tell him, would you:
textes.Toi ! Tu veux chanter avec nous ? Do-ré-: You! Do you want to sing with us? Do-re-mi-RAMEN!
textes.Toi ! Tu veux voir du feu ?: You! Want to see some fire?
textes.Toi ! Viens voir, j'ai presque fini les: You! Come and see, I've almost finished the boats.
textes.Toi ? Dans les Neuf Cercles ? (Le vieux: You? Into the Nine Circles? (The old guardian looks at you for a long time, then unhooks a big black key from his belt.) The Key of the Ember. The door is at the back of the nave. Listen well: a coin for Charon, honey cakes for Cerberus, good answers for Minos. And take a coat, little one. Cocytus is no joke.
textes.Toi ? Dans une mine ? Je rentre !: You? In a mine? I'm coming home!
textes.Toi ? Je me souviens de tout de toi ! Tu: You? I remember everything about you! You're in my Sky Notebook, page four. You explained clouds to me. My drawing doesn't look much like you. But it's a very kind one.
textes.Toi ? Je te reconnaîtrais même au fond d: You? I'd know you even at the bottom of the Trench! You patted the Little Diver's hull the way you'd pat a horse. He went “bloop”. From him, that's a big compliment.
textes.Toi ? Peur de la mer ? Mais tu es venu j: You? Scared of the sea? But you came all the way here! … So you can be scared and go anyway? Oh. That changes everything.
textes.Toi ?! Sur MA scène ? … D'accord. Vas-y,: You?! On MY stage? … Fine. Go ahead, the audience is hot. Well, warm. Well, it's made of stone.
textes.Toi aussi tu veux rester, hein ? On a un: You wanna stay too, huh? We've got a secret together now. Shh.
So will you be, soon. She's telling you so.
textes.Toi aussi, tu as eu peur de la mer, et t: You were scared of the sea too, and you came anyway. I think about it every time I look up.
textes.Toi aussi, tu as peur de la mer. Je ne l: You're scared of the sea too. I won't forget. That makes us two pond cats.
You heard it too, the song. There are two of us. It does me good to know that.
textes.Toi aussi, tu perds le compte. On devrai: You lose count too. We should start a club. There'd be four thousand two hundred and twelve of us. Or thirteen.
textes.Toi aussi, tu pleures, quelquefois. Je l: You cry sometimes too. I kept it to myself. If it ever happens to you here, come and find me. I know the good spots.
You too. I mean… have a nice evening.
textes.Toi aussi. À ton enclume. Et aux pierres: You too. With your anvil. And with stones.
You no move! Ocre look at you.
textes.Toi chez qui tout meurt : j'ai écrit une: You whose plants all die: I've written a lullaby for plants, just for you. It starts with “sorry”.
textes.Toi du Clan. Toi toujours bienvenu au fe: You of the Clan. You always welcome at fire.
textes.Toi encore. Bien. Tant que tu respectes: You again. Good. As long as you respect the ship, you're welcome.
textes.Toi encore. Tu n'aurais pas croisé un ch: You again. You wouldn't have come across a ginger cat, by any chance? A filthy beast. A demon with whiskers.
textes.Toi et ta cabane dans un arbre… J'ai fai: You and your tree house… I made a try: a bubble hanging from one of Photon's big flowers. It sways. He said yes.
textes.Toi et ta fête de village… j'y repensais: You and your village party… I was thinking about it. There was an old fellow in a beanie dancing, wasn't there? No? Pity.
textes.Toi et ta harpe… Caelan a joué jusqu'à q: You and your harp… Caelan played until four. I thought of you. I looked behind me.
textes.Toi et tes deux pieds gauches… Je te pro: You and your two left feet… I'm offering you a lesson in the Zero-Gravity Garden. When you fall, you fall slowly. It's reassuring.
textes.Toi et tes lettres de chez toi : j'ai es: You and your letters from back home: I tried to invent two. They look like ducks.
textes.Toi et ton gros slime ! J'ai dit à Hilai: You and your big slime! I told Hilaire you'd beaten one. He was jealous. He missed his.
textes.Toi et ton mal de mer ! Tu as repris des: You and your seasickness! You've got your colour back since. Arcanelle suits you better than the waves.
textes.Toi et ton poisson grillé… j'ai essayé u: You and your grilled fish… I tried a sardine with ember mushroom. It sneezed. So did I.
textes.Toi grandir. Toi devenir carré comme nou: You grow. You become square like us!
textes.Toi l'amateur de mystères, je t'ai gardé: You lover of mysteries, I've saved you a riddle with no answer. Don't solve it too fast.
textes.Toi le bateau : ta pirogue est dans mon: You, the boat: your canoe is in my codex. I gave it waves. Lots of waves.
textes.Toi le bâtisseur de cabane : elle tient: You, the hut builder: is it still standing? If it lets water in, come and see me. I've got tar.
textes.Toi le champion ! Un jour, toi et moi, s: You, the champion! One day, you and me, on the court. I'll let you score once. Maybe.
textes.Toi le chanteur ! Le roi demande si tu r: Hey, singer! The king's asking if you're coming back tonight. He says he needs someone to drown out his voice.
textes.Toi le difficile, je cherche toujours to: You, the fussy one, I'm still looking for your dish. I tried biscuit tagine. Tibo says no.
textes.Toi le dormeur : je t'ai gardé une datte: You, sleepyhead: I've saved you a date. For the day you want to see the dawn.
textes.Toi le dur, je te surveille. Le jour où: Mister tough, I'm keeping an eye on you. The day you cry, I'll be there. With my hanky and a big smile.
textes.Toi le ramasseur de coquillages : la Pla: You the shell collector: Bone Beach has some magnificent ones. Hurry, the crabs like them too.
textes.Toi non plus ? Ah. On est deux. Ça me ra: You neither? Ah. That makes two of us. That reassures me. It doesn't help me, but it reassures me.
textes.Toi non plus, tu n'as jamais vu la balei: You've never seen the whale either. Shall we start a club? Two members already makes a watch.
textes.Toi non plus, tu n'oses pas. On fait un: You don't dare either. Shall we make a pact? The first one who dares tells the other.
textes.Toi que la grenouille a goûté le premier: The frog tasted you first, so your revenge is still waiting for you. Number seven, grilled.
textes.Toi que le feu réchauffe, n'oublie pas :: You who are warmed by fire, don't forget: the Ember Heart belongs to everyone. Come and sit by it whenever you like.
textes.Toi que les bons repas réchauffent, je t: You who are warmed by a good meal, I'd saved you a slice of brioche. Well, I ate it. But I thought of you.
textes.Toi que les bêtes escaladent, je t'ai mi: You whom the animals climb all over, I've put aside a thick old cloak for you. Hooves leave marks.
textes.Toi qui adores danser : ce soir, je joue: You who love dancing: tonight, I'm playing for you. Fast. Very fast. Get your feet ready.
textes.Toi qui adores le bateau… tu me raconter: You love boats… will you tell me about Port-Azur? With details. I want to know everything, without going.
textes.Toi qui affûtes ton épée tous les soirs,: You sharpen your sword every evening, so show it to me. … HA! Spotless.
textes.Toi qui aimes ce qui chatouille ! Ma gra: You, who like tickly things! My grandmother would have adored you. Come on, the jelly's fresh. It's already wobbling with joy.
textes.Toi qui aimes ce qui dure, regarde ma gr: You who love things that last, look at my grate in the Heart: forty years, and not one crack. Like my marriage. Well, almost.
textes.Toi qui aimes construire, ta palette t'a: You like building, so your pallet's waiting for you at the joinery. With a pencil. Measure twice.
textes.Toi qui aimes danser… il y a un bal, par: You who like dancing… there's a ball, sometimes, at the Crâne Fendu. Dance. For those who can't any more.
textes.Toi qui aimes la cuisine douce, j'ai mis: For you who likes it mild, I put less rouille in your portion. My pot hasn't spoken to me since.
textes.Toi qui aimes la mer : si tu croises Sob: You who like the sea: if you run into Sobek out there, tell him to stay there. With his friends.
textes.Toi qui aimes la nuit… Gustave, le réver: You who love the night… Gustave, the market street lamp, flickered when you walked past yesterday. He likes you.
textes.Toi qui aimes la pluie : j'ai fait une j: You who like rain: I made a jar thinking of you. Get ready to be soaked.
textes.Toi qui aimes la pluie la nuit : la proc: You who like rain at night: next time it falls on your roof, listen carefully. It's Tlaloc singing for you.
textes.Toi qui aimes la pluie… si tu passes à R: You who love the rain… if you pass through Rainville, say hello to the little cloud for me.
textes.Toi qui aimes la soupe de légumes, je t': You love vegetable soup, so I always keep a bowl warm for you. With an extra leek.
textes.Toi qui aimes la soupe de poisson, j'en: You who love fish soup, I made some yesterday. With thirteen fish. I beat Port-Azur by three fish.
textes.Toi qui aimes la ville : tu as vu Aztlán: You who like the town: have you seen Aztlán? They farm on the water. You'd like that sort of madness.
textes.Toi qui aimes la vitesse ! J'ai un nouve: You who love speed! I've got a new shortcut over the Greenhouse. It's a bit dangerous. I'll show you.
textes.Toi qui aimes le blanc : regarde ma toil: You who love white: look at my cloth against the light. You'll see what I mean.
textes.Toi qui aimes le blanc : tu as vu le lin: You who love white: have you seen Tiyi's linen, in Per-Hâpy? Go and look at it. Against the sun.
textes.Toi qui aimes le blanc et les couleurs :: You who love white and colours: we're alike, you and me. Don't tell anyone.
textes.Toi qui aimes le bleu : regarde mes doig: You who like blue: look at my fingers. Still a little blue. We're alike.
textes.Toi qui aimes le bruit. Le souk t'attend: You who like noise. The souk awaits you. Go. Salam.
textes.Toi qui aimes le calme, tu remarques que: You who love peace and quiet, have you noticed I talk more softly with you? It's a huge effort. HUGE.
textes.Toi qui aimes le chêne, j'en ai trouvé u: You love oaks, so I found one in the Spore Wood. It has your stubborn look. I named it after you.
textes.Toi qui aimes le cirque : un de ces soir: You, who love the circus: one of these evenings, I'm doing an act at the Crâne Fendu. Hold your breath for me.
textes.Toi qui aimes le jour : tu me racontes l: You who love the day: will you tell me about the colours? I imagine them. Red, especially. Like someone's cheeks.
textes.Toi qui aimes le jus de coco : il y en a: You, who like coconut juice: there's some at Mama's bar. I've seen it. I haven't touched it. Hardly.
textes.Toi qui aimes le piment : je t'ai gardé: You who like chilli: I've saved my strongest recipe for you. Get your tears ready.
textes.Toi qui aimes le poisson grillé : Grumba: You who love grilled fish: Grumbald has put “fish à la Moloka” on his slate. He says it's in your honour. He's lying, but it's sweet.
textes.Toi qui aimes le rouge : j'ai trouvé une: You who like red: I found a perfect macaw feather. I'm keeping it for you.
textes.Toi qui aimes le silence : écoute bien m: You, who love silence: listen closely to my song tonight. There are four beats of silence in the middle. They're for people like you.
textes.Toi qui aimes le silence, ce soir je fer: You who love silence, tonight I'll leave a pause between two songs. A long one. You'll know why.
textes.Toi qui aimes le silence, viens m'écoute: You, who like silence, come and hear me play “nothing.” It's my shortest piece. Murmure adores it.
textes.Toi qui aimes le silence. Assieds-toi. O: You who like silence. Sit down. We'll say nothing. Together.
textes.Toi qui aimes le soir, j'ai allumé le pr: You who love the evening, I lit the first street lamp thinking of you. It made a shy little flame. Like me.
textes.Toi qui aimes le soleil… tu as vu comme: You who love the sun… have you seen how it shines on my flowers today?
textes.Toi qui aimes le vert, j'ai peint une fe: You who love green, I painted a leaf for you on the Expression Wall. Well, the label says green.
textes.Toi qui aimes les bains très chauds : le: You who love very hot baths: the second pool has been singing louder since you came by. It likes you.
textes.Toi qui aimes les belles histoires, j'en: You, who love beautiful stories, I've got a brand-new one. It isn't true at all. It's magnificent.
textes.Toi qui aimes les bonnes nouvelles, en v: You love good news, so here's one: today's pie is apple. I'M SHOUTING IT!
textes.Toi qui aimes les champs : viens tirer l: You who like the fields: come and work the shadoof one morning. It builds your back. And your character.
textes.Toi qui aimes les chansons drôles, viens: You love funny songs, so come tonight: I'm singing Rodrigue's tragedy. You'll love it.
textes.Toi qui aimes les chiens et les chats :: You who love dogs and cats: a cat has moved into the kennel. The pups adore him. He tolerates them.
textes.Toi qui aimes les chiens, les chats et l: You love dogs, cats and rats, so you're welcome in my pack. It's a very mixed one.
textes.Toi qui aimes les coins… J'ai essayé d'e: You, who like corners… I tried to draw one. Just one. It scared me. I rounded it off. Sorry.
textes.Toi qui aimes les complaintes : un soir: You, who love laments: some rainy evening, sit near the stage. I'll play for you. Softly.
textes.Toi qui aimes les couleurs : va voir Ix: You who love colours: go and see Ix Sak, in Yaxché, and tell her Tiyi sent you. She'll understand.
textes.Toi qui aimes les deux… Il était deux fo: You who like both… Twice upon a time, {surnom}. See? You're smiling already.
textes.Toi qui aimes les feux de camp : Grand-p: You who love campfires: Grandpa's telling stories on the square tonight. There'll be a flame-shaped lantern. For you.
textes.Toi qui aimes les fins heureuses, j'en a: You like happy endings, so I've got a new one. It ends with a turnip going home.
textes.Toi qui aimes les fins, je t'en garde un: You who love endings, I'm saving one for you. But not just yet. An ending has to be earned. Come back and see me.
textes.Toi qui aimes les gigues : ce soir, la p: You, who love jigs: tonight, the fastest one in my repertoire. If you last to the end, I'll buy you a grog.
textes.Toi qui aimes les histoires qui font peu: You like scary stories, so tonight I'm telling the one about the singing mimic. Brrr.
textes.Toi qui aimes les histoires vraies : cel: You who like true stories: this one really happened. Twice, in fact. Sit down.
textes.Toi qui aimes les images, regarde le cie: You who love images, look at the sky tonight: the Spire looks like a feather stuck in a cloud. That's for you.
textes.Toi qui aimes les jeux de mots, j'en ai: You love puns, so I've got a new one. It's inkredible. Want to hear it? Too late, I just said it.
textes.Toi qui aimes les lames légères… j'ai pe: You who like light blades… I thought of you this morning while thinning an edge. By a hair. A dwarf's hair, mind, which is already a lot.
textes.Toi qui aimes les levers de soleil : j'a: You who love sunrises: I've made an orange and pink lantern. It's not as beautiful. But it rises whenever you like.
textes.Toi qui aimes les musiques douces, je t': You, who like gentle music, I've composed you a lullaby. It goes “oooh” very low. It's called “Sleeping Heavy-Foot.”
textes.Toi qui aimes les navets, la prochaine a: You love turnips, so next alert, come and see me afterwards. I pay better than anyone.
textes.Toi qui aimes les nouvelles drôles, hier: You love funny news, so: yesterday, Rodrigue fell into the fountain in the middle of a speech. I announced it.
textes.Toi qui aimes les pommes rouges, j'en ai: You like red apples, so I've set one aside. The reddest. Germaine's going to howl.
textes.Toi qui aimes les pommiers, je t'ai gard: You love apple trees, so I saved you an apple from Radis's tree. Don't tell him, he counts them.
textes.Toi qui aimes les poèmes courts, en voic: You who love short poems, here's a new one: “You, again.” It's even more beautiful than the first.
textes.Toi qui aimes les rimes, écoute celle-ci: You who love rhymes, listen to this one: “Oh friend who returns, my heart glows and burns.” It works! Write it down!
textes.Toi qui aimes les tic-tac et les boums,: You who love tick-tocks and booms, you're my official assistant. I've written your name on my cupboard door.
textes.Toi qui aimes les tic-tac, j'ai pensé à: You who love tick-tocks, I thought of you: I put a clock in my machine. Now it goes tick-tock before it goes boom.
textes.Toi qui aimes les vraies histoires, sach: You like true stories, so know that the one about Hugues's dragon is true. Almost all of it.
textes.Toi qui aimes les étoiles : à la prochai: You who love the stars: at the next festival, look carefully at the sky. One of the stars will be one of my lanterns. Will you know which?
textes.Toi qui aimes pleurer, j'ai écrit un cou: You love a good cry, so I've written a sad verse just for you. Hugues has already heard it. He's soaked.
textes.Toi qui aimes qu'on te fasse des farces…: You, who like having pranks played on you… Whatever you do, don't look behind you. … Hee hee! Again!
textes.Toi qui aimes quand ça pique un tout pet: You, who like things just a tiny bit spicy: I've kept some fire cinnamon for you. The mildest. Hardly any smoke.
textes.Toi qui aimes quand ça pique, j'ai un no: You, who like things spicy: I have a new chili. Stronger. Grumbald tasted it. He hasn't spoken since yesterday. He's fine.
textes.Toi qui aimes recevoir des lettres, je n: You who love receiving letters: I don't have one for you yet. But I look in my bag every morning. You never know.
textes.Toi qui aimes te perdre : si tu trouves: You, who like getting lost: if you find a cove that's on no map, come and tell me. I'll name it after you.
textes.Toi qui aimes à la fois ce qui dure et c: You who love both what lasts and what changes, you're like good iron. I told Pyrus. He nodded. Coming from him, that's a compliment.
textes.Toi qui aimes écouter : j'ai trois histo: You who love to listen: I've got three brand-new stories for you. One of them's about Orsik. Shh!
textes.Toi qui aimes écrire des lettres, tu m'e: You who love writing letters: will you give me one to deliver? No? I'll wait. My bag always has room.
textes.Toi qui aimes être devant ! Ne bouge pas: You who love being in front! Don't move. (Click!) That one's today's photo. I have one per visit. It's turning into an album.
textes.Toi qui aimes être seul quand tu as du c: You, who like to be alone when you're sad… The pool in the Gardens is calm tonight. Just so you know. I won't come.
textes.Toi qui arrives toujours en avance… tu n: You who always arrive early… couldn't you lend me your secret? For one letter. Just one.
textes.Toi qui as abandonné de compter les étoi: You who gave up counting the stars: so did I, last night. Three hundred and twelve. Always the same.
textes.Toi qui as caressé Tlaco : il se souvien: You who petted Tlaco: he remembers you! He's wagging his tail. Or maybe he saw a heron.
textes.Toi qui as compté jusqu'à mille : j'ai v: You who counted up to a thousand: I checked, there are more. Sorry. But well done.
textes.Toi qui as compté les étoiles : ce soir,: You who've counted the stars: tonight, count again with me. Two of us will make fewer mistakes. Or twice as many.
textes.Toi qui as construit un radeau : je t'ai: You who built a raft: I've kept you a plank from the Merciless. For your next one. Or for a stool.
textes.Toi qui as construit une barque, dis-moi: You who've built a boat, tell me: you wouldn't have a bit of wood, would you? People in the trade always do.
textes.Toi qui as des amis pour moitiés… combie: You who have friends for halves… how many do you have now? I count. It's my job.
textes.Toi qui as déjà mangé un truc horrible :: You who've eaten something horrible: I've saved you a portion of stew. To make peace with cooking.
textes.Toi qui as eu le mal de mer une fois : j: You who were seasick once: I haven't told anyone. Except Zébuline. She laughed. She understands you.
textes.Toi qui as eu peur en voyant Arcanelle :: You who were afraid when you saw Arcanelle: are you still afraid of her? She, at any rate, has got used to you. I can see it.
textes.Toi qui as gagné une fois : tu l'as raco: You who won once: have you told the story today? You must. Every day.
textes.Toi qui as jamais peur du noir, tu me ra: You who are never scared of the dark, will you tell me how you do it? Slowly. With some fireflies around, though.
textes.Toi qui as la main verte : il reste un c: You with the green thumb: there's still a free corner on my chinampa. For your willow.
textes.Toi qui as la main verte : mes poivriers: You with your green fingers: my peppers were asking for you yesterday. Well, they leaned your way. Same thing.
textes.Toi qui as le monde pour maison : n'oubl: You who have the world for a home: don't forget you also have a room here, under the roof. With the skylight.
textes.Toi qui as le pied marin, viens faire un: You've got sea legs, so come out in the rowing boat with me one day when there's a swell. Albertine wants to see.
textes.Toi qui as le rythme dans les pieds… tu: You with the rhythm in your feet… would you teach me? No, nothing. I didn't say anything. Boom.
textes.Toi qui as le rythme, viens taper avec m: You who've got rhythm, come and drum with me at the grill. Mustapha will pay you in sardines. Me, in applause.
textes.Toi qui as oublié ta première fête… je t: You, who forgot your first party… I made one up for you. There were dwarves. You danced a lot.
textes.Toi qui as pas de queue, t'as fait des s: You with no tail, did you do happy eyebrows today? Show me!
textes.Toi qui as peur de l'eau. … Bien. Regard: You who are afraid of water. … Good. Always watch the water. Not the sky.
textes.Toi qui as peur des clowns : rassure-toi: You, who are scared of clowns: don't worry, there aren't any on Balafre. Apart from the Governor.
textes.Toi qui as peur des grenouilles, comme m: You're scared of frogs, like me: you watch the left? I'll take the right. Always.
textes.Toi qui as peur du noir : la forge reste: You who are scared of the dark: the forge stays red till midnight. Drop by.
textes.Toi qui as peur du noir, reste loin des: You're scared of the dark, so keep away from the frogs. Inside, there are no lanterns.
textes.Toi qui as plusieurs maisons… Ramure en: You who have several homes… Is Ramure one of them now? Don't answer. I'll feel it.
textes.Toi qui as reconnu mon poisson, viens vo: You recognised my fish, so come and see the next one. I think it's a fish too. Maybe.
textes.Toi qui as toutes tes dents : fais-y att: You, who've got all your teeth: take care of them. And never take Belle-Humeur for a jokethter.
textes.Toi qui as trouvé un vrai trésor ! Tu m': You found a real treasure! Will you take me next time? I'll carry the shovel!
textes.Toi qui as très peur des crocodiles : je: You who are very scared of crocodiles: I count my toes, do you? Ten? Good. Me too.
textes.Toi qui as un chat ! Tu lui as dit bonjo: You who have a cat! Did you say hello to it from Miou? You have to, it's polite.
textes.Toi qui as un chien : est-ce qu'il aime: You who have a dog: does it like cats? Miou likes Peek'. Peek' isn't so sure.
textes.Toi qui as un peu peur de la mer : moi a: You who are a little scared of the sea: me too, a little. All right. A lot. But that stays between us.
textes.Toi qui as un peu peur des crocodiles :: You who are a little scared of crocodiles: we make a fine pair. We'll fish upstream, you and me.
textes.Toi qui as un peu peur du fond, comme mo: You, who are a bit scared of the deep, like me: breathe slower than the fear. It works for dancing too.
textes.Toi qui as un peu peur du noir, la lampe: You're a little afraid of the dark, so the lamp at the top of the chimney is always on. It's for you.
textes.Toi qui as un peu peur du noir… j'ai dem: You who are a bit scared of the dark… I asked a firefly to follow you tonight. If you see a little light, that's her.
textes.Toi qui as vaincu un monstre gigantesque: About that gigantic monster you defeated: I told Noisette. I made it a bit bigger. Just a bit.
textes.Toi qui as vu des dauphins, tu crois que: You've seen dolphins, so do you think mine was a real one? Say yes.
textes.Toi qui as vu du pays, dis-moi francheme: You've seen the world, so tell me honestly: can a map be wrong?
textes.Toi qui as vu tant d'îles… Si tu aimais: You who've seen so many islands… If you'd loved someone for a hundred years, how would you tell them?
textes.Toi qui as vu un serpent de mer : j'en a: You who've seen a sea serpent: I saw another one last night. Three humps. I've saved you a spot on the jetty.
textes.Toi qui as vu une baleine ! Raconte enco: You who've seen a whale! Tell me again. Nobody believes me, so I listen to you twice.
textes.Toi qui as vu une lumière que personne n: You who saw a light nobody else saw: if it comes back, come and get me. I'll believe you.
textes.Toi qui as été piqué : mes abeilles te p: You who've been stung: my bees apologise for the others. With a buzz.
textes.Toi qui attends que ça passe : tu as l'a: You, who wait for it to pass: you look well. This time. I'm keeping a potion aside anyway. With your name on it.
textes.Toi qui attises les feux de camp, je sur: You, who stoke campfires: I'm keeping an eye on your eyebrows. Still there? Good. Keep it up.
textes.Toi qui attrapes plein de navets, la pro: You catch loads of turnips, so next alert, I'm counting on you. Gently, always.
textes.Toi qui avais mangé « tout à l'heure » :: You who'd eaten “a while ago”: is it still a while ago, now? Ha!
textes.Toi qui avais un peu peur la première fo: You were a bit scared the first time: would you come with me on the Swallow? One day. Not today.
textes.Toi qui bois de l'eau… Hic ! Tu as peut-: You, who drink water… Hic! Maybe you're right. Mama Grog says the same. Don't tell her I said so.
textes.Toi qui bois des litres, je te fais conf: You drink gallons, I trust you. But drink anyway. Just to make me happy.
textes.Toi qui bois du lait chaud… j'ai repensé: You, who drink hot milk… I thought about Papa again, because of you. It did me good. Hic.
textes.Toi qui caches des choses vraies dans te: You who hide true things in your jokes… made one this morning? I'm suspicious now.
textes.Toi qui caresses les chiens qui dorment: You who pet sleeping dogs: come back during Tlaco's nap. He takes lots of them. Like me.
textes.Toi qui casses et qui répares : tu as fa: You who break and mend: were you careful turning around today?
textes.Toi qui chantes bien, ce soir tu montes: You who sing well, tonight you're up there with us. Saïd had better watch out.
textes.Toi qui chantes en travaillant, j'ai inv: You sing while you work, so I made up a verse for you this morning. The dough rose twice.
textes.Toi qui chantes à pleins poumons sous la: You who sing at the top of your lungs in the shower, the mic is still waiting for you for a chorus. I haven't forgotten.
textes.Toi qui cherches dans les livres : as-tu: You who look things up in books: have you given Ombreline's back? I haven't. But don't follow my example.
textes.Toi qui cherches des formes dans le ciel: You who look for shapes in the sky, I found a new one: it looks like you. A bit. With very heavy feet.
textes.Toi qui choisis les lames pour leur beau: You who choose blades for their beauty… Hm. I've got one with gilding. It cut down a dragon. A small one.
textes.Toi qui choisis les lames solides : j'en: You who choose sturdy blades: I've got a new one in from Ferronde's. Not pretty. Very sturdy. It's waiting for you.
textes.Toi qui choisis une lame pour son histoi: You who choose a blade for its story: I've got a new one. It's seen an ash storm. Captain Charbonnel swore it to me.
textes.Toi qui continuerais à jouer : la table: You, who'd keep playing: the table is waiting for you. It waits for everyone. It's very patient.
textes.Toi qui crois au destin, les pigeons ont: You who believe in destiny, the pigeons saw something for you this morning. Something good. Or round. It was blurry.
textes.Toi qui crois au talent : j'ai encore ga: You who believe in talent: I won again last night. Pure talent. Ask Sylvain. No, don't ask him.
textes.Toi qui crois aux fées… elles le savent,: You believe in fairies… they know, you know. Last time, up there, I talked about you. They smiled.
textes.Toi qui crois l'avenir écrit : ce matin,: You who believe the future is written: this morning, a rune moved as you went by. I won't tell you which one.
textes.Toi qui crois la moitié : alors, tu as c: You, who believe half: so, have you chosen your half? Take the one with the mermaid. It's the best.
textes.Toi qui crois que le soleil se lève touj: You who believe the sun always rises: it rose this morning. Did you thank it?
textes.Toi qui crois que les moustiques n'ont p: You who think mosquitoes have no names: then mine is the only one. He's very proud.
textes.Toi qui crois que les moustiques ont des: You who think mosquitoes have names: Xan says hello! Bzz! That means hello.
textes.Toi qui crois toutes mes histoires : j'e: You, who believe all my stories: I've kept one for you. The one about the nine-armed Kraken. It's true. Almost.
textes.Toi qui crois à la chance : elle t'a sou: You who believe in luck: did she smile at you today? She always smiles at me. I smile back. In gold.
textes.Toi qui crois à la chance : tu as toujou: You who believe in luck: do you still have your scarab? No? Hm. That explains a lot.
textes.Toi qui crois à la magie, tu as gardé mo: You believe in magic: did you keep my pebble? It's surely magic. Surely.
textes.Toi qui crois à toutes mes histoires, j': You who believe all my stories, I've got a new one. It's HUGE. And it's true. Nearly.
textes.Toi qui croyais que les plantes ne répon: You who thought plants don't answer… Try with the little blue flower, there. Say hello to it. … See? A blink.
textes.Toi qui dansais comme un pied… je t'ai v: You with the two left feet… I saw you the other night. At least one right foot now. We're getting there!
textes.Toi qui danses avec les pieds, j'ai mont: You dance with your feet — I turned the bass up a bit tonight. Just for your ankles.
textes.Toi qui danses dans ta tête… alors, ça s: You dance in your head… so, is it coming out a little now? I saw you tapping your foot the other night.
textes.Toi qui danses quand personne ne regarde: You who dance when nobody's watching: I'll play tonight, late, when the square is empty. I won't look. Promise.
You, who dance when nobody's watching: I'm not watching. Promise. Well, just a little, as a teacher.
You, who dance when nobody's watching: I won't watch. Promise. Well, just out of the corner of my eye.
textes.Toi qui danses sur les tables : j'ai fai: Hey, table-dancer: I've had the little one reinforced, with Borin's iron. It's waiting for you!
textes.Toi qui danses tout de suite : ce soir,: You who dance right away: tonight I'll start with a fast tune. For your feet.
textes.Toi qui danses tout le temps ! Je t'ai g: You, who dance all the time! I've saved you a spot by the fountain. Tonight, the light is waiting for you.
textes.Toi qui danses tout le temps, tu n'es pa: You who dance all the time, you didn't come last night. I'd saved you a jig. I played it anyway. For nobody.
textes.Toi qui danses un peu : ce soir, un peu: You who dance a little: tonight, a little more? I'll play gently. At first.
textes.Toi qui danses… Ce soir, tu viens ? Je t: You who dance… Are you coming tonight? I've saved you a spot behind me, near Grelot.
textes.Toi qui demandes ton chemin : demande-mo: You who ask for directions: ask me, then. I've still got corners of the map to show you.
textes.Toi qui dis des choses gentilles tous le: You say nice things every day, so teach me. I practise on the mill. It doesn't answer.
textes.Toi qui dis merci aux racines. J'ai véri: You say thank you to the roots. I checked. The east one squeaks less. Hmph.
textes.Toi qui dis qu'on peut gagner en arrivan: You, who say you can win by coming second: I won again! Well… second. So, won!
textes.Toi qui dis qu'une bonne carte ne se tro: You, who say a good map is never wrong… you're my only ally on this island. Along with Gaston, on the days he agrees.
textes.Toi qui dis qu'une dette, ça se paie tou: You say a debt always gets paid: you still owe me one visit a week. I'm writing it down.
textes.Toi qui dis que le soleil dépend de nous: You who say the sun depends on us: have you done your part today? One good deed is enough.
textes.Toi qui dis que seul le premier gagne… t: You, who say only first place wins… you'll see. This time's the one. My paws agree with you now.
textes.Toi qui dis toujours au revoir… alors di: You, who always say goodbye… then say it properly to me when you leave, all right? I collect them.
textes.Toi qui dis tout en face… non, rien. Je: You who say everything to people's faces… no, nothing. I wanted to ask your advice. Later. The usual?
textes.Toi qui disais qu'une dette, ça se pardo: You said a debt can be forgiven… I'm thinking about it. Slowly. Don't rush me: iron doesn't like that either.
textes.Toi qui disais « ça dépend » : aujourd'h: You who said “it depends”: today, nothing's biting. It's still worth it. Sit down.
textes.Toi qui donnes l'alerte : si tu vois que: You who raise the alarm: if you see something, you climb the Lookout. You shout. I come down.
textes.Toi qui dors comme un loir : tu as bien: You who sleep like a log: did you sleep well last night? Yes? I knew it, your eyes are bright.
textes.Toi qui dors comme une souche, garde ce: You who sleep like a log, keep that gift. And don't tell Faelar: he'd turn it into a contest.
textes.Toi qui dors la nuit : tu as rêvé de Xib: You who sleep at night: did you dream of Xibalba? No? Just as well.
textes.Toi qui dors mal… tes yeux vont mieux ?: You, the poor sleeper… are your eyes any better? No? Come back and see me, I've got fresh mist.
textes.Toi qui dors n'importe où : les chameaux: You who sleep anywhere: the camels have been asking for you. They have, really.
textes.Toi qui détestes l'injustice ! Les gens: You who hate injustice! People still mumble at the port. IT'S UNJUST. We agree.
textes.Toi qui détestes la pluie : reste loin d: You who hate rain: stay away from my workshop. Everything's wet here. Even me. Especially me.
textes.Toi qui emportes toujours une corde, j'e: You always take a rope, so I've got a new one, nicely braided. You'll like it.
You who hear the copper sing: tac. Ready, or not ready? I test you every time. Don't take offence.
textes.Toi qui entends ton cœur sous l'eau : re: You who hear your heart underwater: stay a little longer next time. After the heart, there's the rest.
textes.Toi qui es du matin et du soir, comme mo: You're a morning AND a night person, like me… so when exactly do you sleep? Not on the Swallow, OK? That's my spot.
textes.Toi qui es déjà parti une fois, tu ne re: You who've already left once, no regrets? No… I can see you have no regrets.
textes.Toi qui es entre les deux, comme moi. Sa: You who are in between, like me. Salam. We understand each other.
textes.Toi qui es souvent en retard… je ne te f: You who are often late… I won't lecture you. I was too, once. Just once. That was enough for me.
textes.Toi qui es tombé deux fois de mon hamac: You who fell out of my hammock twice: good news, I've put a cushion underneath. A small one.
textes.Toi qui espères le soleil : il est reven: You who hope for the sun: it came back this morning. Our prayers, or yours. It doesn't matter.
textes.Toi qui essaies de tenir ta promesse : t: You who are trying to keep your promise: hold on. The rum's still on the house. To keep you going.
textes.Toi qui fabriques ta chance : tu as des: You who make your own luck: you have a potter's hands, I think. Come back and throw a jar one day.
textes.Toi qui fais briller tes bottes : je les: You, who make your boots shine: I noticed them the other day. Not “acceptable” yet. But not bad.
textes.Toi qui fais briller ton sourire : tu l': You, who make your smile shine: you've still got it today. Perfect. Don't change a thing.
textes.Toi qui fais briller ton épée : tu l'as: You, who make your sword shine: did you oil it after your fights? A dull blade is a sad thing.
textes.Toi qui fais comme moi, viens à la table: You do like me, so come to the back table tonight: we'll compare bruises.
textes.Toi qui fais confiance aux pirates : ta: You who trust the pirates: is your purse still shut? Good. Your heart, keep it open.
textes.Toi qui fais de ton mieux : moi aussi. U: You who do your best: me too. One bird in three. We're improving.
textes.Toi qui fais des villes, regarde : j'ai: You who make towns, look: I've started a street. There are three houses and a dog. The dog's a pebble.
textes.Toi qui fais des vœux… La dernière pluie: You who make wishes… At the last meteor shower, I made one for you. I won't tell you which. Otherwise it won't work.
textes.Toi qui fais du bruit : je t'ai entendu: You who make noise: I heard you coming. From far away. Heel last.
textes.Toi qui fais encore des bêtises, on en f: You still get up to mischief, so shall we do some together? A little one. A nice one.
textes.Toi qui fais griller des choses : j'ai e: You, who toast things: I tried it with one of Bobor's brioches over a campfire. Don't do that. It caught fire.
textes.Toi qui fais réparer par les autres : tu: You who get others to fix things: you wouldn't have any wood, by any chance? Good wood. Not driftwood.
textes.Toi qui fais toujours le premier pas… Tu: You who always make the first move… Do you think it's never too late?
textes.Toi qui fais tout mourir : alors, tu as: You who kill everything: so, did you water anything today? Even a little weed?
textes.Toi qui faisais des tas de bêtises… tu m: You used to get up to loads of mischief… will you tell me about one? Just one? I won't tell Mummy!
textes.Toi qui gardes les secrets comme une tom: You who keep secrets like a tomb: I've got a piping-hot one for you. … No. Tomorrow. Maybe.
textes.Toi qui gardes les secrets « selon », Ga: You keep secrets “depending”, so: Gaubert's still smiling. You wouldn't happen to know why?
textes.Toi qui gardes les secrets « selon »… Al: You who keep secrets “depending”… So, how much for Khéty's? He loves someone. I don't know who.
textes.Toi qui gardes les secrets, tu n'as rien: You keep secrets, so you haven't said anything about the apples, eh? Good. The net's ready, just in case.
textes.Toi qui gardes tes souvenirs : je les re: You who keep your keepsakes: I recognise people like you. They walk past my shop window without stopping.
textes.Toi qui gardes tes souvenirs, je ne t'en: You who keep your memories, I won't ask you for one. But if one day you've got one to spare…
textes.Toi qui inventes quand tu ne sais pas… J: You who make things up when you don't know… I've thought about your answer again. It's wrong. But it made me laugh. Eighteen out of twenty.
textes.Toi qui irais voir les grottes tout seul: You who'd go into the caves alone: I've got my eye on you. Don't go down there without telling the guard.
textes.Toi qui jongles avec les aventures, tu e: You juggle adventures. Dropped any since? No? You're better than me.
You, who leave things alone. Stay that way. The world needs people who don't touch anything.
textes.Toi qui le dirais « tout simplement »… J: You who would tell them “simple as that”… I tried, yesterday. I said “hello”. It's a start, isn't it?
textes.Toi qui le prends sans sucre… J'ai mis t: You who take it without sugar… I've put your glass aside. Don't tell Zineb, she'd think I was ill.
textes.Toi qui lis des aventures : le rayon dou: You who read adventures: shelf twelve is waiting for you. I've put a new book there. It's about a traveller who looks like you.
textes.Toi qui lis des poèmes, j'ai mis un recu: You who read poems, I've set a collection aside for you. It's a little worn: someone reads it every night.
textes.Toi qui lis les cartes avant de partir :: You who read maps before setting off: I've fixed the swamp. Well, I think so. Tell me if you fall in.
textes.Toi qui lis parfaitement les cartes : vi: You, who read maps perfectly: come and see my latest. I need a fresh eye. Mine are a little worn.
textes.Toi qui lis une seule fois : je t'ai tro: You who only read once: I found you a very short book. Once will be enough. Promise.
textes.Toi qui m'as demandé si j'oserais… J'y p: You asked me whether I'd dare… I think about it every night. Don't tell anyone. Especially not the spiders.
textes.Toi qui m'as dit oui pour la pêche : cin: You said yes to fishing: five o'clock, the jetty, don't forget. I'm still waiting for you. So are the mackerel.
textes.Toi qui m'as dit que le Diable Repu étai: You who told me the Diable Repu was the best tavern in the archipelago, I've written it on the slate. With your nickname.
textes.Toi qui manges ce que tu trouves : tu as: You who eat whatever you find: did you find anything today? No? Then EAT.
textes.Toi qui manges de tout ! J'ai une nouvel: You who eat everything! I have a new recipe: sardine, cinnamon, herring. Will you try it?
textes.Toi qui manges du poisson le matin, je t: You eat fish in the morning, so I've saved you a savoury loaf. Just for you. Don't tell the oven.
textes.Toi qui manges les brioches chaudes, j'e: You who eat your brioches hot: I always keep one at the edge of the oven. For you. Well, for you and for Pépin.
textes.Toi qui manges les brioches de toutes le: You who eat brioches every which way: you're my favourite customer. Don't tell Asmodin. Or Pépin.
textes.Toi qui manges les brioches froides : j': You who eat your brioches cold: I tried it, for you. I waited until the next day. Well, until noon. It wasn't bad.
textes.Toi qui manges ta sardine nature : aujou: You who eat your sardine plain: today the embers are perfect. Nothing else.
textes.Toi qui marchandes toujours, approche !: You who always haggle, come closer! I've raised my prices just for you. Now you can bring them down.
textes.Toi qui marchandes toujours, je t'ai rés: You who always haggle, I've put a carpet aside for you. Starting price: outrageous. That'll take us all day.
textes.Toi qui marches sans bruit : je ne t'ai: You who walk without a sound: I didn't hear you coming. Good.
textes.Toi qui me crois pour le dauphin ! Tu es: You believe me about the dolphin! You're family now. Have you still got your necklace?
textes.Toi qui me crois… tu veux que je te la r: You who believe me… want me to tell it again?
textes.Toi qui me vois cuisinier : je m'entraîn: You who see me as a cook: I'm practising flying pancakes. The first one's on the ceiling. It's still there.
textes.Toi qui montres tes bobos tout de suite,: You, who show your scrapes straight away, let me see those hands… Hmm. You'll live, as usual.
textes.Toi qui n'aimes pas le poisson : mon pla: You who don't like fish: my plan is coming along. Honey sardine, this week. You won't see it coming.
textes.Toi qui n'aimes pas le poisson… Je ne l': You who don't like fish… I haven't told anyone. Except the mackerel. They're offended.
textes.Toi qui n'aimes pas les farces… Je n'en: You, who don't like pranks… I don't play any when you're around. Well, almost none. A little one. A teeny-tiny one.
textes.Toi qui n'aimes pas les photos : je n'en: You don't like photos: I haven't taken a single one of you. Well, just one, in my head. It came out nicely.
You who don't like being shouted at… Hello. See? I'm talking softly. IT'S HARD.
textes.Toi qui n'aimes pas quand ça pique, je n: You, who don't like spicy things: I didn't put any chili in your portion. I was very strong. It cost me.
textes.Toi qui n'aimes que les vraies histoires: You who only like true stories: last night's was true. Almost. The rest is up to you.
textes.Toi qui n'as jamais fait de bêtise… j'ai: You who've never done anything naughty… I found a brand-new stovepipe. Just saying.
textes.Toi qui n'as jamais gagné : viens au ter: You who've never won: come to the court. I've got a lucky ball. It has a dart in it.
textes.Toi qui n'as jamais le mal de mer : le T: You who are never seasick: the Firebrand's in no state to sail, but I've got a rowing boat. She rolls a lot. Perfect for you.
textes.Toi qui n'as jamais le vertige, tu me ra: You never get vertigo, so will you tell me what you can see down below from the crane? I've never dared.
textes.Toi qui n'as jamais rien planté : ma gra: You who've never planted anything: my seed is still waiting for you. A seed knows how to be patient.
textes.Toi qui n'as jamais rien vu d'étrange :: You who've never seen anything strange: look at Stoneheart one night. Just one. Then you tell me.
textes.Toi qui n'as jamais été piqué : viens vo: You who've never been stung: come and see my bees. They don't sting, they chatter.
textes.Toi qui n'as pas d'animal : Ptahmosé ven: You who have no pet: Ptahmosé sells faience scarabs. They don't eat anything. That's handy.
textes.Toi qui n'as pas de moitié… j'ai donné t: You who have no other half… I gave your name to a drop. It's on a flower, near the pond.
textes.Toi qui n'as pas peur de la mer… raconte: You who aren't scared of the sea… tell me again. The colour. The sound. Not the waves.
textes.Toi qui n'as pas peur des crocodiles : v: You who aren't afraid of crocodiles: go and say hello to Sobek, at the river mouth. From a distance. And bring back my net.
textes.Toi qui n'as pas peur du fond… tu me rac: You, who aren't scared of the deep… will you tell me what's down there? Take your time. I'm in no hurry.
textes.Toi qui n'as pas peur du noir : si tu cr: You who aren't scared of the dark: if you come across a lantern gone out in a tunnel, it's probably mine. Light it again.
textes.Toi qui n'as pas voulu caresser Tlaco :: You who didn't want to pet Tlaco: he doesn't hold it against you. He only bites jaguars. And flatbreads.
textes.Toi qui n'as peur de rien. Hm. Tiens ce: You who fear nothing. Hm. Hold this hot iron, then. … No. Joking.
textes.Toi qui n'as plus peur des démons, tu es: You who aren't afraid of demons any more, you're at home here. I told Asmodin. He had a room prepared. On principle.
textes.Toi qui n'as « pas le temps de dormir »,: You who have “no time to sleep”, you look like a dried mushroom. Sit down. Three breaths.
textes.Toi qui n'avais jamais compté les étoile: You who had never counted the stars: well, did you try? How many? Don't cheat, I'll know.
textes.Toi qui n'avais jamais essayé : elle a p: You who'd never tried: has my seed grown? No? Did you at least sing it something? Try again.
textes.Toi qui n'avais jamais pris la mer… Tu l: You who had never been to sea… Have you been since? You always arrive by strange paths, you do. I like that.
textes.Toi qui n'avais jamais rien construit :: You who'd never built anything: your peg is still holding, on the side of the Merciless. I look at it every morning.
textes.Toi qui n'avais jamais rien mangé de biz: You who'd never eaten anything weird: so, my chilli stew? Do you still have a tongue?
textes.Toi qui n'avais jamais tenu de promesse: You who'd never kept a promise: have you started? I'm watching. Club in hand.
textes.Toi qui n'entends rien sous l'eau, tu as: You who hear nothing underwater, you're lucky. Silence is rare. Hold on to it.
textes.Toi qui n'es jamais allé au cirque : reg: You, who've never been to the circus: look at the post on the quay. Seven knives, one single hole. The circus is me.
textes.Toi qui n'osais pas t'approcher : tu leu: You who didn't dare go near: did you say hello to them? Bzzz. That means hello. Try it.
textes.Toi qui n'y connaissais rien en tavernes: You who knew nothing about taverns: now you know the best one. The others will seem bland to you. Sorry.
textes.Toi qui nages comme un poisson ! Un jour: You, who swim like a fish! One day, we'll race all the way to the Shark. Not right now. Soon.
textes.Toi qui nages comme un poisson, reste pr: You who swim like a fish, stay near the quay when the fleet comes in. You never know. For Youssef.
textes.Toi qui nages un peu : on s'entraîne ens: You, who swim a little: shall we practise together one day? A little plus a little makes a lot.
textes.Toi qui nages un peu : tu m'apprendras ?: You who swim a little: will you teach me? Not in the big pond. In a teeny tiny puddle.
textes.Toi qui ne connais pas ta pointure ! Je: You who don't know your shoe size! I guessed it at a glance, last time. I won't tell you. That'll teach you.
textes.Toi qui ne crois pas aux fées… tu as vu: You don't believe in fairies… have you seen the little lights in the dune, at night? No? Look harder.
textes.Toi qui ne crois pas mes histoires : tu: You, who don't believe my stories: have you been to see Skull Rock, at night? Not yet? Then you don't know.
textes.Toi qui ne crois pas à la chance : moi n: You who don't believe in luck: neither do I. But I touch Big Blue before lighting the kiln. Just in case.
textes.Toi qui ne danses jamais : je surveille: You who never dance: I'm keeping an eye on your left foot. It nearly went already. I saw it.
textes.Toi qui ne danses jamais, j'ai vu ton pi: You who never dance, I saw your foot tapping the beat the other night. I didn't say a thing. I'm just smiling, that's all.
textes.Toi qui ne danses jamais… Hm. Rien. Je p: You who never dance… Hm. Nothing. I was thinking of something else.
textes.Toi qui ne danses jamais… viens ce soir: You who never dance… come tonight anyway. Feet always make up their minds in the end.
textes.Toi qui ne dors jamais assez… je sens qu: You who never get enough sleep… I can smell you've been running about again. A nap, {surnom}. Doctor's orders.
textes.Toi qui ne fais jamais le premier pas… T: You who never make the first move… Have you thought about it again? I have.
textes.Toi qui ne joues pas : tu reviens quand: You, who don't play: you keep coming back all the same. I'll end up believing it's for my conversation.
textes.Toi qui ne manges pas de poisson… vendre: You who don't eat fish… on Friday, one spoonful. Just one. To make me happy.
textes.Toi qui ne manges rien le matin… Tu as m: You don't eat anything in the morning… Have you eaten today? Don't lie, I've got a sharp eye.
textes.Toi qui ne marchandes jamais, je t'ai fa: You who never haggle, I gave you a discount. Without saying a word. Don't repeat it, I have a reputation.
textes.Toi qui ne marchandes jamais… on reprend: You who never haggle… shall we go back to the lesson? Repeat after me: “That's too expensive.” With feeling.
textes.Toi qui ne me crois pas… le dauphin est: You don't believe me… the dolphin came by again yesterday. OK, I wasn't there. But it came by again, for sure.
textes.Toi qui ne paierais rien pour une plume: You who'd pay nothing for a feather: I'd have given it to you for free. One day. Maybe. No.
textes.Toi qui ne ramasses jamais de coquillage: You who never collect shells: do you still have the one I lent you? Listen to it in the evening. You'll see.
textes.Toi qui ne rapportes jamais rien… Une ca: You who never bring anything back… A postcard weighs nothing, let me remind you. A penny and a half.
textes.Toi qui ne rates presque jamais : tu veu: You who almost never mess up: will you watch me practise? From a distance, I mean. Behind a wall.
textes.Toi qui ne sais pas attendre : la leçon: You who can't wait: the lesson continues. Sit down, hold the line, and shh.
textes.Toi qui ne sais pas attendre. Assieds-to: You who can't wait. Sit down anyway. We start with one minute. Shh.
textes.Toi qui ne sais pas danser : tu marches: You who can't dance: you walk in rhythm, I've noticed. Tum, tum. You're already dancing.
textes.Toi qui ne sais pas garder les secrets,: You can't keep secrets, so you wouldn't have heard anything, about some sacks of seeds? No? Shame.
textes.Toi qui ne sais pas jongler : tu as trav: You, who can't juggle: have you practised your fall? I want a lovely fall, with a little yelp.
textes.Toi qui ne sais pas écrire ton nom : ma: You who can't write your name: my House of Life is waiting for you. One afternoon is enough. Two, with my stories.
textes.Toi qui ne sais plus d'où tu viens… j'ai: You who don't remember where you come from… I found a seed that looks like you. Well, a bit. It looks lost too.
textes.Toi qui ne savais pas lire les cartes :: You, who couldn't read maps: north at the top, the sea in blue, the monsters in the corners. Do you remember?
textes.Toi qui ne savais pas nager… tu as essay: You, who couldn't swim… did you try floating? The sea holds you up, I told you.
You who couldn't hold a hammer. … Now you can, a bit. It's a start.
textes.Toi qui ne suis jamais les ordres, je ne: You who never follow orders, I won't give you any. I'll ask you. It's not the same.
textes.Toi qui ne t'es jamais perdu… Maman dit: You who've never been lost… Mum says people who never get lost don't go far enough. Or the other way round. I forget.
textes.Toi qui ne te retournes jamais… Je l'ai: You never look behind you… I did it for you last night. Nothing to report. Good.
textes.Toi qui ne vendrais jamais ton arme : je: You who'd never sell your weapon: I won't buy it from you. Even if you beg me. Well, if you beg me a lot…
textes.Toi qui ne veux pas de tatouage : je te: You who don't want a tattoo: I understand you. Really. Don't ask me why.
textes.Toi qui ne vois les serpents qu'après l': You who only see serpents after a mead: tonight, I'm buying you one at the Cauldron. We'll watch the sea together.
textes.Toi qui ne vois pas très loin : s'il y a: You who can't see very far: if there's something on the horizon, I'll tell you. Nearly always true.
textes.Toi qui oublies tes rêves… Perlée en a t: You forget your dreams… Perlée found one in the pond this morning. It was shaped like you. I've kept it.
textes.Toi qui ouvres les machines pour voir de: You who open machines to look inside, come: I've got an engine from another planet to take apart. It goes “blop”. Let's find out why.
textes.Toi qui paierais cher une plume de quetz: You who'd pay a fortune for a quetzal feather: one arrived this morning. Real. I'm keeping it for you. Friend's price.
textes.Toi qui paies presque toujours : mon rou: You who almost always pay: my rolling pin remembers you. Fondly. For now.
textes.Toi qui paies sans discuter… je n'ai pas: You pay without haggling… I haven't raised my prices for you. Well, hardly.
textes.Toi qui parles aux plantes en secret… Je: You who talk to plants in secret… I won't say a thing. But the big flower over there told me you'd said hello to it.
textes.Toi qui parles aux plantes tous les jour: You who talk to plants every day… The flowers here recognise you now. They blink green when you go by.
textes.Toi qui parles à tes affaires en cachett: You who talk to your things in secret, you know how to keep a secret. So do I. We keep ours, the two of us.
textes.Toi qui partages tes frites avec les mou: You who share your chips with the seagulls, I told them. They're waiting for you on the quay. All of them.
textes.Toi qui partirais sans hésiter, dis-moi: You who'd leave without hesitating, tell me: how does it feel, the first morning, when the coast disappears?
textes.Toi qui passes partout, dis-moi franchem: You go everywhere, so tell me honestly: will Caelan ever dare?
textes.Toi qui pleures devant la tourte, je t'a: You cry over pie, so I've saved you a slice. Bring a hanky with you.
textes.Toi qui pleures en cachette… si tu veux,: You cry in secret… if you like, my house is a good hiding place. Nobody comes. Except Grommelot, but he doesn't look.
textes.Toi qui pleures quand ça finit bien, pré: You cry when things end well, so get a hanky ready: I've got a new story, and the ending is magnificent.
textes.Toi qui prends ce qui traîne : tu n'es p: You who grab whatever's lying around: you haven't been by the workshop. I've made a note of it. I'm waiting for you. I've got the pins ready.
textes.Toi qui prends ton bain chaud, tout simp: You who like your bath just hot: the first pool is waiting for you. I've added bubbles. Free. Well, almost.
textes.Toi qui prends ton cacao avec un peu de: You who take your cacao with a little chilli: just the right amount. You're sensible. That's rare around here.
textes.Toi qui prends ton temps… Je t'ai attend: You who take your time… I waited for you earlier. Four seconds. It was very long. But I waited for you.
textes.Toi qui prends tout de suite une potion: You, who take a potion right away: I have a new one, against tiredness. Labelled. Dated. Tested on Bulle. He's fine. Almost.
textes.Toi qui prends à manger avant tout, tu a: You take food before anything else, and you're right. Did Mamie Rissole make you a pie? Take it.
