textes.Tu as encore parlé à ta barque ?: Have you been talking to your boat again?
textes.Tu as encore ta couronne de marguerites: Have you still got your daisy crown? Has it wilted? I'll make you another one!
Did you hear? She said thank you.
textes.Tu as entendu cette voix, aujourd'hui ?: Did you hear that voice today?
textes.Tu as entendu ta voix, ce matin ?: Did you hear your voice this morning?
textes.Tu as essayé ? Une seule pâquerette ?: Have you tried? Just one daisy?
textes.Tu as essayé, avec une fougère ?: Have you tried it, with a fern?
textes.Tu as essayé, sous la douche ? Même un t: Did you try it in the shower? Even a teeny little Ramen?
textes.Tu as eu l'occasion de lui parler, depui: Have you had a chance to talk to them since?
textes.Tu as eu ta part de lumière, aujourd'hui: Did you get your share of light today?
textes.Tu as fait la connaissance de {qn}, il p: You've met {qn}, I hear. What do you think?
textes.Tu as fini de la rater, oui. Hmpf. Montr: Finished botching it, you mean. Hmpf. Show me.
textes.Tu as fini tes calculs, petite ?: Have you finished your calculations, little one?
textes.Tu as frappé {qn} ? Ça ne se fait pas. T: You hit {qn}? That's just not done. Everyone's talking about it.
textes.Tu as frappé {qn} ?! On m'a tout raconté: You hit {qn}?! I've heard everything. You've got some nerve coming to talk to me.
textes.Tu as frappé {qn}, à ce qu'on dit. Je ne: You hit {qn}, so they say. I'm not saying it was deserved. I'm not saying it wasn't.
textes.Tu as gagné un poney en chocolat. Il fon: You won a chocolate pony. It melts fast: hurry!
textes.Tu as gardé de la place pour le gâteau ?: Did you save room for cake?
textes.Tu as gardé la lavande sous ton oreiller: Did you keep the lavender under your pillow? And the bad dreams? Come and sit on the bench, if you want to talk about them.
textes.Tu as goûté la soupe de ma cousine Joset: Have you tasted my cousin Josette's soup, at La Conque? Our mothers were sisters, sweetie! She says “taste” just once: at the bottom of the sea, you save your air. Me, I say “taste, taste”. When I opened my cinnamon in the middle of their Square, the whole city sneezed at once. She writes that the Square has finally stopped. Ha ha ha!
textes.Tu as goûté le chocolat de Firmin ? Alor: Have you tasted Firmin's chocolate? Then you've tasted my old boiler! Tell him to descale her properly every month, and to say good morning to her before he makes her whistle. She likes that. He already does? Ah, good lad.
textes.Tu as goûté le thé de Mamie Kiku ? Il ré: Have you tried Mamie Kiku's tea? It warms you down to your toes.
textes.Tu as gâté {qn}, à ce qu'on raconte. Ceu: Word is you spoiled {qn}. Anyone who's kind to my folks is welcome at my place.
textes.Tu as jugé, le grand. Un nain n'oublie j: You've passed judgement, tall one. A dwarf never forgets a judgement. Nor the person who gave it. … Come back anyway, go on.
textes.Tu as l'air soucieuse, ce soir, mon enfa: You look worried this evening, my child.
textes.Tu as l'air épuisé, {surnom}. Assieds-to: You look exhausted, {surnom}. Sit down under the leaves. Here, nothing can reach you.
textes.Tu as l'impression que les petits Moaïs: You feel like the little Moai at the back have moved. But no. … Did they?
textes.Tu as l'œil ! C'est mon préféré. Mais j': You've got a good eye! That's my favourite. But I have lots of favourites. All of them, actually.
You have your head on upside down.
textes.Tu as le nez fin ! Pas de soupe ! Les pa: You've got a good nose! No soup! The vegetable baskets from the Shared Gardens haven't arrived. Radis prepared them this morning, but he had to leave them in the plots: he was interrogating his carrots. My pot is empty, and an empty pot echoes. Go to the Shared Gardens, east of town, near the Boxes, and bring me three baskets. Don't eat them on the way! Well... one carrot. Just one. I'll be counting.
textes.Tu as le vertige, comme moi. Rappelle-to: You get vertigo, like me. Remember: look far away. If you like, I'll take you up in Mademoiselle. We'll look far away together.
textes.Tu as les deux yeux de corail ! Il ne re: You have both coral eyes! All that's left is to give them back to the Great Moai, in the middle of the Elders' Plateau.
textes.Tu as mangé un champignon pour me parler: You ate a mushroom to talk to me? I'm touched. A little. Don't get used to it.
textes.Tu as mangé à La Conque, au fond de la m: Have you eaten at La Conque, at the bottom of the sea? At Josette's? I wrote to ask her if her soups were pay what you can. She replied: “Gently priced, and with a wide-open heart.” So I sent her a ladle. Not Excalibur, my pebble: Excalibur never leaves the Fronde. Her little sister. Durandal. She serves the samphire soup now. Lucky her.
textes.Tu as mangé, ma petite Écrou ?: Have you eaten, my little Écrou?
You measured like a postman, Marcel.
textes.Tu as mis le pied sur l'île des nains ?!: You set foot on the dwarves' island?! Me, in sixty years at sea, never. Bring me back a pebble from their volcano so I can show it to Octave.
textes.Tu as mis tes gants ?: Have you got your gloves on?
textes.Tu as mis tes gants, au moins ?: Did you at least put your gloves on?
You wrote it down. Of course.
textes.Tu as offert {objet} à {qn} ? Tout le mo: You gave {objet} to {qn}? Everyone knows {il} can't stand that. I'm still laughing.
textes.Tu as ouvert un œil, la dernière fois ?: Did you open an eye last time? Just one?
textes.Tu as parlé à une plante, aujourd'hui ?: Did you talk to a plant today? They love it.
textes.Tu as pensé à une plume avant de dormir: Did you think of a feather before you slept? No? Try tonight! Just one. Feathers are patient.
textes.Tu as perdu un « goûte » en descendant !: You lost a “taste” on the way down!
textes.Tu as peur de quelque chose, toi ? Vraim: Are you scared of anything? Really scared, I mean?
textes.Tu as peur du noir, {surnom} ? Là-dessou: Are you scared of the dark, {surnom}? Down there, it's very, very dark.
textes.Tu as plongé jusqu'à la ville engloutie: You dived all the way down to the sunken city?! My grandfather was right! I have to redraw all my maps. All of them!
textes.Tu as pris la fuite… Ils s'en souviendro: You ran away… They'll remember that.
textes.Tu as pris le Funiculaire d'Azur ? Tu as: Have you taken the Azure Funicular? Did you hear Marius go “boom-tchak”? That's when his cabin rolls over the last sleeper. Bielle and I spent months laying the rails, and on the last day, we painted that sleeper violet. He's never repainted it. He says he can't help himself. I get it. Boom-tchak!
textes.Tu as pris le temps de t'asseoir au Cerc: Did you take the time to sit at the Circle? Is your first memory still sleeping? Leave it be. It will wake when it wants to.
textes.Tu as pris ta tisane de tilleul ? Tu as: Did you have your lime-blossom tea? You've still got owl eyes. The world can wait, I told you.
textes.Tu as quelque chose à me faire réparer,: Got anything for me to fix today?
textes.Tu as quitté la Grande Course… Les coure: You left the Great Race… The runners head back to the Games Clearing.
You're right not to judge too quickly.
textes.Tu as raison, mon fils, je disais justem: You're right, son, I was just saying…
textes.Tu as raison. La tasse qui tourne, j'en: You're right. I already have a spinning cup. It stirred my tea, then my tablecloth, then my cat. He doesn't come to tea with me any more.
textes.Tu as raison. Le commis va tamponner que: You're right. The clerk will stamp something, and everything will be better. Stamps always work.
textes.Tu as ramené Germaine. (Il la serre cont: You brought Germaine back. (He hugs her for a very long time.) … Thanks. Really. That was the longest speech of my life.
textes.Tu as rapporté deux runes de golem. La p: You brought back two golem runes. The gate of Forgefer opened for you.
textes.Tu as reconnu que j'étais ton rival éter: You acknowledged I was your eternal rival. I wrote it to my mother. She sends her regards. And a scarf.
textes.Tu as regardé dans les branches hautes ?: Did you look in the high branches?
textes.Tu as regardé le volcan, hier soir ? Tu: Did you look at the volcano last night? Did you see the green?
textes.Tu as relu un de tes préférés, depuis ?: Have you reread one of your favourites since? I reread chapter twelve. Again. It's still good.
textes.Tu as remarqué. (Elle pose sa main sur l: You noticed. (She places her hand on yours; it's light as a leaf.) The bridges are flickering, the fountain can't choose between two planets, and the Spire beats more weakly. The Heart is fading, my little star. It's very old: it came from Ondelune with us. Last night, three shards broke off and fell onto the island. Without them, it beats like a tired heart. And if the Heart stops… (She smiles.) We won't fly away. We'll fall. Gently, I hope. I don't like big falls at my age. Go see Volt, at the foot of the Spire. He pretends everything is fine. He knows everything. Help him.
textes.Tu as remonté une vieille botte ? Montre: You reeled in an old boot? Show me! … It's mine! I've been looking for it since the shipwreck. Bring it to me, please.
textes.Tu as rencontré Anatole, le liftier des: Have you met Anatole, the Strata liftkeeper? We talked through the speaking tube: two hundred metres up, plus a hundred underground. I said hello. He answered “Pardon?”. I think that's his way of saying hello.
textes.Tu as rencontré Aëlwen ? Elle m'a soigné: Have you met Aëlwen? She healed me when I was little. Her potions are bitter, but they work.
Have you met Barnabé? Then you know. He looks scared of everything, and he still comes back every day. I'm not scared of anything, so it doesn't count for me. For him, it counts double.
textes.Tu as rencontré Capucine, en haut ? Dis-: Did you meet Capucine, up top? Tell her Anatole has greased pulley number twelve. She'll understand. Between liftkeepers, that's our way of saying “I miss you”. Don't blush. I don't blush any more, I'm too old.
textes.Tu as rencontré Héloïse, en bas ? Elle t: Have you met Héloïse, down below? She told you she'd won, I bet. She's been saying that for twenty years. So have I, mind you. But in my case, it's true.
textes.Tu as rencontré Mathilde ? Elle rit comm: Have you met Mathilde? How does she laugh? With a “HA”? Ha! I knew it. I laugh with a “HO”. Together we'll go “HAHO”. The day she comes down, we'll shake the cavern. Warn Ludovic. He'd better prop things up.
textes.Tu as rencontré le Bourgmestre Hector ?: Have you met Burgomaster Hector? During his two-hour speech, I wrote everything down. Everything. Forty pages. It's the longest piece of news in my Notebook. I filed it under “weather”: very windy.
textes.Tu as rencontré une petite fille, dans l: You met a little girl in Atlantis? Ondine? She was born under a dome, like me? She's never seen the sun either? … Then we could go up and see it together! The two of us! With Lili! That makes three girls discovering everything!
textes.Tu as rendu quelqu'un heureux, aujourd'h: Did you make someone happy today?
textes.Tu as réparé d'autres choses, depuis ?: Have you fixed anything else since?
textes.Tu as répondu bien vite, toi…: That was a very quick answer, you…
textes.Tu as réussi ! Mais attention… la Reine: You did it! But careful… the Bramble Queen is waiting for us at the end of this corridor. I'll stay close to you.
textes.Tu as rêvé de quelque chose, avant de le: Have you ever dreamt of something before seeing it?
textes.Tu as sauté si haut que tu vois le somme: You jumped so high you can see the top of the Hanging Gardens. And a gurgle sleeping on it.
textes.Tu as senti la mèche, Fatima ?: Did you smell the wick, Fatima?
What you mostly are is three times my price.
textes.Tu as surtout une tisane à boire, Faelar: What you mostly have is a tea to drink, Faelar.
You shot like a klutz, Marcel.
textes.Tu as tout ce qu'il faut. On le fait ?: You have everything you need. Shall we do it?
textes.Tu as traversé le Lac Noir ! Derrière to: You crossed the Black Lake! Behind you, the false slabs sink for good: the path of the Ancients stays marked out.
textes.Tu as traversé le gouffre ! Sous tes pie: You crossed the chasm! Under your feet, a flagstone sinks a notch: the grate at the back creaks open.
textes.Tu as trouvé Pixel et Quark ! Va dire à: You found Pixel and Quark! Go and tell Pixel the game is over.
textes.Tu as trouvé la bonne personne pour ta n: Have you found the right person for your news?
textes.Tu as trouvé ton binôme prudent, {surnom: Found your careful dive buddy yet, {surnom}?
textes.Tu as trouvé un trésor dans tes poches,: Found a treasure in your pockets, {surnom}?
textes.Tu as un cœur d'elfe, {surnom}. Je garde: You have an elf's heart, {surnom}. I'll keep {dernier_cadeau} close to me.
textes.Tu as un péché mignon ?: Do you have a guilty pleasure?
textes.Tu as une bonne nouvelle à raconter, auj: Got any good news to tell today?
textes.Tu as une clé de douze, {surnom} ? Non ?: Got a 12 mm spanner, {surnom}? No? Then tell me: what colour for my next bus?
textes.Tu as une histoire à me raconter ?: Do you have a story to tell me?
textes.Tu as une mine affreuse, {surnom}. Tu t': You look dreadful, {surnom}. Did you pick a fight with a rock spire? Eat something, for goodness' sake.
textes.Tu as une tête de déterré, {surnom}. Ass: You look like something dug up from a grave, {surnom}. Sit down. And eat something before you fall off my ladder.
You look like someone who eats honey bread. That's my way of saying hello.
You've got a face worth painting.
textes.Tu as une épée ! Je peux la toucher ? No: You've got a sword! Can I touch it? No? Just a little bit? Fine.
textes.Tu as vaincu le Roi Gélatineux. Toi. Ava: You defeated the Jelly King. You. Before me. (He clenches his fists, then sighs.) … Congratulations. I hate you. No. Well done. I hate you a little. Well done anyway.
textes.Tu as vaincu le Serpent des Abysses ?! L: You defeated the Serpent of the Abyss?! The elders of my people will talk about it for a hundred years. Well… a hundred years isn't that long.
textes.Tu as vaincu le Serpent des Abysses… Bar: You defeated the Abyssal Serpent… Barnabé will make a forty-verse song out of it. Me, I'll just say: well done, {surnom}.
textes.Tu as vaincu un grand serpent, là-haut ?: You defeated a great serpent, up there? Hmph. Serpents are easy. Try brambles.
textes.Tu as vu ? Au milieu des aurores, à trav: You saw? In the middle of the auroras, through my new lenses... (He lets you look.) There. A tiny little star, at the edge of the sky. Ondelune's sun. You can only see it on aurora nights, when the sky is washed clean. I wanted someone from down below to see it too. Now there are two of us. Here: an astral crystal, and a star elixir. The crystal is for your machines. The elixir is for the evenings when you feel far from home.
textes.Tu as vu ? Il n'a même pas peur !: Did you see? It's not even scared!
textes.Tu as vu ? Tu as VU ? J'ai regardé le co: Did you see? Did you SEE? I watched the whole concert. Sitting in the grass. Without carrying a single crate. (He laughs, a real laugh.) Twenty years of touring, and it's on a little island that I got my first concert back. Thank you. Here: a share of the roadies' fund, two Spleen chocolates, and a title. Not an official one. We voted for it, by show of hands, last night. Unanimous, minus Grésil, who was asleep.
textes.Tu as vu Boulon ? Il a soulevé un conten: Did you see Boulon? He lifted a container. With a cat on it. The cat didn't notice a thing. Coo-roo!
textes.Tu as vu Lili ? Lili Altaïr, de la Cité: Have you seen Lili? Lili Altaïr, from the City of Clouds? Tell me everything! Does she really have eleven kites? What exactly is a kite? A fish that flies on the end of a string? … Tell her I'm keeping a shell for her. The most beautiful one. The one that sings.
textes.Tu as vu Marius, au Funiculaire d'Azur ?: Have you seen Marius, at the Azure Funicular? On reopening day, I sat next to his console. Down below, the Great Singer passed over the Dome. I put my hands on the glass, closed my eyes… and I heard her, {surnom}. Me! In my hands, in my feet. We both cried. Into our moustaches. Don't repeat that. Well, actually, do. But loudly.
textes.Tu as vu Maîtresse Brunehaut, à la Grand: Have you seen Mistress Brunehaut, at the Great Forge? Tell her that her wheels turn without a single squeak. And tell her… two knocks, then one. She'll understand. Me, I don't laugh in “HO”s. I laugh in “hm”s. It's more discreet. But it means the same.
textes.Tu as vu Maîtresse Capucine, au pied de: Have you seen Mistress Capucine, at the foot of the Column? She gave me a Guild cap for the reopening. Midnight blue, gold braid. I wear it on Sundays. The rest of the week, I look at it.
textes.Tu as vu Maîtresse Capucine, la Grande L: Have you seen Mistress Capucine, the Grand Liftkeeper? She came down for the reopening. She tapped the cabin's glass with her fingertips, listened, and said: “She's been well brought up.” I blushed. So did the cabin, I think. Well, it was the Great Pearl's reflection.
textes.Tu as vu Mila, au Dôme d'Azur ? On est n: Have you seen Mila, at the Azure Dome? We were born on the same day! She's never seen the sky, and I've never seen the sea. We're the same, but upside down! Her letter arrived all crumpled: it went through four postmen. Tell her I'm saving a kite for her. The whale-shaped one. That way, she'll have a sky with a whale in it.
textes.Tu as vu Mélisande, au Dôme des Serres ?: Have you seen Mélisande, at the Greenhouse Dome? We're “the three gardeners”: me, with too much sun; Bertille, in the Strata, with none at all; and Mélisande, who switches hers on with a button. I sent her a giant strawberry: three days to get down there! Now that the line has reopened, I'm inviting her up here. She's afraid my sun will be too strong. I'm keeping a straw hat for her.
textes.Tu as vu Nimiel ? Elle est encore montée: Did you see Nimiel? She climbed onto the footbridge with no hands again.
textes.Tu as vu Prisme ? Elle a sauté jusqu'à l: Did you see Prisme? She jumped all the way up to the aurora!
textes.Tu as vu Tom, à la Grande Forge ? Celui: Have you seen Tom, at the Great Forge? The one who taps three quick knocks? … I haven't met him for real yet. The day I went down, he was waiting for me on the platform, and I was at the Swap Shop. We missed each other by a hundred metres. After two years of talking through the rock!
textes.Tu as vu l'obélisque devant la Porte ? I: Have you seen the obelisk in front of the Gate? It goes all the way up to the surface! They say its tip touches the sky. Is that true?
textes.Tu as vu la Fontaine de lune ? La nuit,: Have you seen the Moon Fountain? At night, its crystal lights up all by itself.
textes.Tu as vu la baleine, aujourd'hui ?: Did you see the whale today?
textes.Tu as vu la balle ? Où est la balle ? IL: Did you see the ball? Where's the ball? THERE'S A BALL SOMEWHERE, I CAN SMELL IT!
textes.Tu as vu la grande porte, au pied du Cœu: Have you seen the great gate, at the foot of Stoneheart? I've been there! Well, nearly. As far as the first rock. Then I got hungry.
textes.Tu as vu la lumière, ce matin ? L'Arbre-: Did you see the light this morning? The Mother Tree was all golden.
textes.Tu as vu la petite Pimprenelle, en haut: Have you seen little Pimprenelle, up top? Tom talks about nothing else. Well, about “the person who taps”. He goes red as hot iron. When she comes down, I'll give her a specially forged bolt. The finest one. Made by Tom. He doesn't know that yet.
textes.Tu as vu la plage ? Sable fin, eau turqu: Seen the beach? Fine sand, turquoise water, and a lifeguard with arms like hams. Long live Port-Azur!
textes.Tu as vu la statue de Dame Ysolde, dans: Have you seen Lady Ysolde's statue in the fountain? She's holding up a lantern. She built the first cabin with a rope, a pulley and a salad basket! I tried it too. With the cat. He didn't like it.
textes.Tu as vu la tête de pierre à moitié ente: Have you seen the stone head half-buried west of the gorge? Clou won't go near it. He says it echoes, right next to it. Take a shovel… and a sword.
textes.Tu as vu le Grand Moaï, au milieu ? Il a: Have you seen the Great Moai, in the middle? He has a staircase in his belly!
textes.Tu as vu le Soleil de Laiton, autour de: Have you seen the Brass Sun, around the Upside-Down Column? A great sphere of brass rings, and at its heart an arc lamp that lights the whole cavern. By day it shines bright. At night it turns amber. It's our very own sun. It never sets: it just lowers its eyes.
textes.Tu as vu le canal ? Les enfants y font f: Have you seen the canal? The children float little mother-of-pearl boats on it.
textes.Tu as vu les carpes de lumière, sur la p: Have you seen the light carp in the square? If you touch the emitter, they change colour! I've done it a hundred times. A hundred and two.
textes.Tu as vu les engrenages de l'horloger ?: Have you seen the clockmaker's gears? One of them turns backwards, on purpose!
textes.Tu as vu les passerelles ? Moi, je n'y m: Have you seen the walkways? I never go up there with a tray of loaves. Once, just once…
textes.Tu as vu ma cousine Rosalie, au Grand Ma: Have you seen my cousin Rosalie, at the Great Market? She arrived on the first Funicular, with a sack of cinnamon as big as she is. “I'm going to wake up your noses!” She opened it in the middle of Pearl Square. The whole town sneezed at the same time. Professor Benthos said it was a very successful experiment.
textes.Tu as vu ma queue ? Elle fait des tire-b: Did you see my tail? It makes corkscrews when I'm happy.
textes.Tu as vu mes champignons qui brillent ?: Have you seen my glowing mushrooms? The fairies make them grow. They take you up there, above the clouds… Ask me, if you want to travel.
textes.Tu as vu mon neveu, là-haut ? Barnabé !: Have you seen my nephew, up there? Barnabé! Then you know. He came all the way down here without closing his eyes once. He told me: “In the water, there's no empty space, Uncle. There's blue.” For the ride back up, he closed his eyes. But he came back on Sunday.
textes.Tu as vu mon oncle Marius, au Funiculair: Have you seen my uncle Marius, at the Funicular? Did he tell you? I went all the way down without closing my eyes once! In the water, there's no empty space: there's blue. And a ray gliding right under your feet. Coming back up, I closed my eyes. But I went back on Sunday.
textes.Tu as vu passer quelque chose de beau, d: Did you see anything beautiful go by outside today?
textes.Tu as vu quelque chose de nouveau, aujou: Have you seen something new today?
textes.Tu as vu quelque chose, d'en haut, ou tu: Did you see anything from up there, or were you still asleep?
textes.Tu as vu ta baleine, ce matin ?: Did you see your whale this morning?
See that, Théo? I've nearly finished.
textes.Tu as écouté la pluie, ces jours-ci ?: Have you listened to the rain lately?
textes.Tu as écouté les gouttes de la voûte, {s: Have you listened to the drips from the vault, {surnom}?
textes.Tu as écouté sans avoir le mal de l'air: You listened without getting airsick: you'll make a fine aeronaut! Here, my spare compass. It points south… both ways. You can't go wrong.
You listened without getting airsick: you'll make a fine aeronaut! Here, a little cloud I caught over the City of Clouds.
textes.Tu attends qu'on t'ouvre, toi. Moi, j'at: You wait for someone to open. I wait for someone to knock. We'd make a good door, the two of us.
textes.Tu attends que ça passe. Hm. Ça passe so: You wait for it to pass. Hm. It often does, true. But not always. Promise me you'll come and see me when it doesn't.
textes.Tu aurais encore un champignon des fées: Would you happen to have another fairy mushroom?
textes.Tu aurais une graine dorée ?: Would you have a golden seed?
textes.Tu avais dit « beurk ». Je n'ai pas oubl: You said “yuck”. I haven't forgotten. Number three is waiting for you. It has reconciled entire families.
textes.Tu avais raison : il chante encore. J'ai: You were right: he's still singing. I've been thinking about what you said. I'm considering helping him. A little.
textes.Tu bascules la louche géante dans la Mar: You tip the giant ladle into the Cooking Pot, blow for a long time, and taste… Mmm! A perfect tomato sauce: garlic, basil, a hint of sugar. You fill a little jar.
textes.Tu bois une gorgée. Quelque part, un nua: You take a sip. Somewhere, a cloud is very proud of you.
textes.Tu boucles la ceinture et tu bombes le t: You buckle the belt and puff out your chest. Somewhere, Tom the Fiddler launches into the last verse of his song.
textes.Tu boucles les sangles de la selle naine: You buckle the straps of the dwarven saddle. Ventaile rises, proud, and offers you a golden feather. She is yours, and you are hers.
You move: the line goes back up.
textes.Tu branches la vieille guitare et tu t'a: You plug in the old guitar and step up to the amp… EEEEEEEEEEEEE! A terrible squeal: it's the Larsen effect! (That's where the island's name comes from.)
textes.Tu chanteras la marée, ce soir, Nausicaa: Will you sing the tide tonight, Nausicaa?
textes.Tu chantes tout doucement, toi. Comme Cl: You sing very quietly. Like Clou. One day, I'll hear you. Even very softly.
You sing too slowly, big sister.
textes.Tu cherches de vrais pirates ? Va au nor: Looking for real pirates? Go north, far north of Port-Azur: Balafre Island. Port-Coutelas. Over there, one wrong word and it's a brawl. I left two teeth and a reputation there. I'm not going back.
textes.Tu cherches les ennuis, crevette ? T'es: Looking for trouble, shrimp? You've come to the right bar.
textes.Tu chevauches Ventaile ! Mon arrière-gra: You ride Ventaile! My great-grandfather used to say the Sky Kings came down on eagles to drink our fizz. I didn't believe him. … Bring me back a feather from their castle.
textes.Tu choisis ta route, toi. Les pigeons re: You choose your own path. The pigeons respect that. They still placed a bet on you, though.
textes.Tu comptes quoi, aujourd'hui ? Pas des c: What are you counting today? Not strikes on the Lid, I hope.
textes.Tu connais Bertille, aux Jardins des Cha: Do you know Bertille, at the Mushroom Gardens? She sent me a glowing mushroom in a jar. It lives at the edge of my pond. It glows all blue at night. The water lilies find it a bit chatty. I'm very fond of it. It's a little piece of the Strata watching over my Greenhouses.
textes.Tu connais Firmin, du Piston Joyeux, en: Do you know Firmin, from the Jolly Piston, up top? He sent me his chocolate recipe in Anatole's cabin. I sent mine back: miner's chocolate, thick enough to stand a spoon up in. He replied: “Madam, that's a soup.” I took it as a compliment.
textes.Tu connais Honorine Lanterne, à La Marmi: Do you know Honorine Lanterne, at La Marmite in the Strata? We've been swapping recipes for twenty years. She sent me her miner's hot chocolate, the one where the spoon stands up. I sent her my samphire soup. She wrote back: “Tastes of the sea.” Coming from someone who lives under the rock, that's a very big compliment.
textes.Tu connais Mademoiselle Philippine, à la: Do you know Miss Philippine, at the Library of Maps in Hautefond? She sends me sky maps for my class, with arrows for the winds. On the latest one, she drew the Azure Dome from my letters, with the Great Singer above it. The whale is as big as the city. My pupils think that's exactly right.
textes.Tu connais Mathilde, la maman de Pimpren: Do you know Mathilde, Pimprenelle's mum? Mistress Brunehaut says she hits as hard as she does. I've never seen anyone hit as hard as Mistress Brunehaut. If it's true, the Lower Town must jump in the air every morning.
textes.Tu connais Pimprenelle, en bas ? Elle es: Do you know Pimprenelle, down below? She came up with a bag full of bolts! She gave me one. I gave her a bit of kite string. She says it's the best string in the world. She's right.
textes.Tu connais Rosalie Cannelle, au Grand Ma: Do you know Rosalie Cannelle, at the Great Market down below? She writes me three letters a week, full of gossip. In exchange, I send her my strawberries. Her letters smell of cinnamon, my strawberries smell of sunshine. It's good business.
textes.Tu connais du monde, ici ?: Do you know many people here?
textes.Tu connais l'histoire de Fanny qui a ren: You know the story of Fanny knocking over two glasses and a Bastien? The Bastien is me. Her arm flew out, and I ended up sitting in the sea. She laughed, I laughed. Since that night, I carry her baskets of croissants from the jetty to the dance floor. I've never told her why. The Bastien never really got back up, {surnom}.
textes.Tu connais le Père Bastien, des Vergers: Do you know Old Bastien, from the Orchards up top? He sent word he'd come down with a basket of apples, to do some swapping. Apples! I've only eaten three in my whole life. They say he talks to his trees. I listen to the waterfall. We'll get along nicely.
textes.Tu connais les champignons sauteurs ? On: Do you know about jumping mushrooms? We grew them for fun. Then the crystal spiders came, and we don't play anymore.
textes.Tu couds trop tard, Nolwenn. Je vois ta: You sew too late, Nolwenn. I see your lamp at night.
You sew too late. I can see your lamp.
textes.Tu cours sous la pluie ! Oh, c'est merve: You run in the rain! Oh, that's wonderful. So some of that rain comes here, through my waterfall, with your footsteps in it. I'll listen more closely next time.
textes.Tu crois au destin quand ça t'arrange. M: You believe in destiny when it suits you. Me too. Today, destiny says you're going to have a good day. Believe it.
textes.Tu crois aux fées, toi ? Pour de vrai, a: Do you believe in fairies? For real, with your heart?
textes.Tu crois qu'elle est grande, la mer ?: Do you think the sea is big?
textes.Tu crois qu'ils sont vrais, les champign: Do you think Lulu's mushrooms are real?
textes.Tu crois que je serai un grand sorcier,: You think I'll be a great wizard, you told me so! I think about it every time my spark goes off.
textes.Tu crois toujours qu'une machine peut tr: Do you still think a machine can find something beautiful?
textes.Tu crois toujours que certaines choses d: Do you still think some things should stay secret?
textes.Tu crois à la magie quand ça marche. Hie: You believe in magic when it works. Yesterday, it worked! A bit. One spark. It was pretty.
textes.Tu crois à la moitié de mes histoires. J: You believe half my stories. I'll tell twice as many, so you'll believe as many as before.
textes.Tu croques le champignon de Lulu… Il a u: You nibble Lulu's mushroom… It tastes of honey and rain. Everything starts to turn gently, the colours begin to sing, and the world dissolves into a golden light…
textes.Tu cueilles une tomate cœur-de-bœuf, lou: You pick an oxheart tomato, heavy and warm from the sun. It smells of green leaves and summer.
textes.Tu danses ? Alors tu tapes avec tout le: You dance? Then you tap with your whole body! Even better. Bielle's going to love you. Gamelle too. She dances with her ladle.
textes.Tu danses toujours aussi mal ? Entraîne-: Do you still dance as badly? Practise with a barrel. Don't tell anyone, but it works.
textes.Tu demandes de l'aide… C'est la meilleur: You ask for help… That's the best answer. Here, nobody ever fixes things alone. That's why it's called the FREE Workshop: free to come, free to help.
textes.Tu demandes quand c'est cassé. Alors dem: You ask when something's broken. So ask me. Always. Even for a tiny screw. Especially for a tiny screw.
textes.Tu demandes toujours à quelqu'un qui sai: You always ask someone who knows before touching a mushroom. Keep it up. All your life.
textes.Tu descends dans les Neuf Cercles ? Ébèn: Going down into the Nine Circles? Ébène says the hall of the Misers is full of weights to push. I weigh spices all day long: you push a weight with your legs, not your arms. And think before you push: you can't pull a weight back.
textes.Tu descends l'escalier de la Cathédrale-: You go down the stairs of the Forge Cathedral. The air grows cooler with every step… At the bottom, a door, and an inscription in letters of fire.
textes.Tu descends l'escalier de la vieille tou: You go down the stairs of the old tower. The steps sink into the dark, the air smells of moss and… jelly? Below, a hall, a set of rules, and a blue crystal.
textes.Tu descends l'escalier de service… et tu: You go down the service stairs… and come out into a vast hall, carved into the rock. In the middle, above a blue shaft, a giant ring turns slowly around a crystal heart.
You climb down the ladder… for a long time.
textes.Tu descends sous le Grand Temple. Sur le: You go down beneath the Great Temple. On the walls, Tlaloc and Huitzilopochtli watch you pass; somewhere below, a drum beats like a heart.
textes.Tu descends, longtemps, dans le ventre d: You descend, for a long time, into the belly of the Temple of Kukulkan. The air turns damp and cold. On the walls, the Feathered Serpent descends with you… and two young people, a blowgun in hand: the Twins.
textes.Tu dis presque depuis ce matin !: You've been saying almost since this morning!
You've been saying that for a hundred years, Grimli.
textes.Tu dis ça depuis cent cinquante ans. Man: You've been saying that for a hundred and fifty years. Eat.
textes.Tu dis ça depuis des mois, Tchoum !: You've been saying that for months, Tchoum!
textes.Tu dis ça depuis lundi !: You've been saying that since Monday!
You've been saying that for forty years.
textes.Tu dis ça tous les jours, Borin. Et tu r: You say that every day, Borin. And you go back for thirds.
textes.Tu disais ne pas aimer la soupe. Tu as f: You said you didn't like soup. You finished your bowl last time. I didn't say anything. I'm just smiling, that's all.
You said the tomato was a vegetable. Five out of ten. Have you revised since? I'll test you again.
textes.Tu disais que le temps efface tout. J'ai: You said time wipes everything out. I checked this morning: still nothing wiped. I'll keep you posted.
You said friends were worth the most. So I'll never make you pay for tea again. Well, Gloubi's tea. He'll do as he likes.
textes.Tu disais que mille ans, c'était trop lo: You said a thousand years was too long. One day at a time, my little star. Remember?
textes.Tu disais que tu donnerais tout. Tu as t: You said you'd give everything away. Have you found something you're attached to since? Tell me its story.
textes.Tu disais que tu dormirais trois cents a: You said you'd sleep for three hundred years… You look wide awake today. Faelar would be disappointed.
You said that about the ninetieth.
textes.Tu dormais dans la mine, Grimli. Comment: You were sleeping in the mine, Grimli. How would you know?
textes.Tu dors toujours par terre, toi ? Moi no: Still sleeping on the floor, are you? Me neither, eh. Obviously. Well… the boards under the counter are very nice. So they say.
textes.Tu dors un peu, maintenant ? Non ? J'ai: Sleeping a bit now? No? I've put a herbal tea aside for you, under the counter. For serious cases.
textes.Tu dors. Hm. Le sommeil aussi est un voy: You sleep. Hm. Sleep is a journey too: every night, the sun goes down to Xibalba, and it comes back. So do you. Sleep well, then.
textes.Tu débouches la fiole. Ça sent la vanill: You uncork the vial. It smells of vanilla and woodsmoke. You don't have horns… but you rub your temples a little, just to see.
textes.Tu décroches une botte de spaghettis bie: You take down a bundle of nicely dry spaghetti: hard as sticks, and smelling of wheat. (Recommendation no. 3: don't break them in two.)
textes.Tu dégages les gravats à la pelle, pierr: You clear the rubble with the shovel, stone after stone…
textes.Tu déplies l'Alouette, tu prends ton éla: You unfold the Alouette, take a run-up… three steps… and the void carries you. You're gliding!
textes.Tu déplies le Bail collectif. Trente et: You unfold the shared lease. Thirty-one signatures, a crested rat, a paw print (Sardine) and, right at the bottom, a tiny grey signature that trembles a little.
textes.Tu déroules le papyrus. Thot montre le c: You unroll the papyrus. Thoth points at the cartouche: the ibis, the eye of Horus, the sun. From top to bottom.
textes.Tu déroules ton diplôme. Le sceau de cir: You unroll your diploma. The wax seal is still smoking a little. You are a bachelor of flames, it says so.
textes.Tu effleures la table : la carte s'allum: You brush the table: the map glows brighter and turns. In the middle, the Esplanade and the Feather; to the south-east, the Station; to the east, the three domes of the Greenhouses; to the north, the Institute of Winds; to the west, the Harbour; to the north-west, the Mist Park and its Falls.
textes.Tu effleures les cordes du bout des doig: You brush the strings with your fingertips. They quiver one after another: plinnng…
textes.Tu effleures ta Clé d'étoile… Une lueur: You brush your Star Key… A glimmer streaks across the sky: the Star Glider is coming!
textes.Tu en as combien, de côté ?: How many have you got saved up?
textes.Tu en as déjà eu un ! Mais je te remets: You've already had one! But I'll top up your glass with a little more sunshine, for the road. There. This one's mostly made of smiles.
textes.Tu en as déjà un ! Garde de la place pou: You already have one! Save some room for something else.
textes.Tu en as déjà un ! Un seul suffit : les: You already have one! One is enough: bad dreams are afraid of dreamcatchers.
textes.Tu en as déjà un : il te reste à trouver: You already have one: you still need to find the other.
textes.Tu en as déjà un, non ?: You've already got one, haven't you?
textes.Tu en as déjà un, non ? Dans les cages d: You already have one, don't you? In the Column's shafts, we travel light.
textes.Tu en as déjà un, non ? Ici, on évite d': You've already got one, haven't you? Round here, we try not to have two of the same thing: there's always someone who has zero.
textes.Tu en as déjà un, non ? Ici, on évite le: You've already got one, haven't you? Up here, we avoid waste. One is enough.
textes.Tu en as déjà un, non ? Il ne faut pas ê: You already have one, don't you? Don't be greedy. Well, yes, a little, but not too much.
textes.Tu en as déjà un, non ? Sous terre, on v: You've already got one, haven't you? Underground, we travel light: the galleries are narrow.
textes.Tu en as déjà un, non ? Sous un dôme, on: You've already got one, haven't you? Under a dome, we don't hoard: space is rationed, like the air.
textes.Tu en as déjà un, non ? Sur Astralys, on: You already have one, don't you? On Astralys, we say: “One thing is a keepsake. Two of the same thing is clutter.”
textes.Tu en as déjà un, non ? Un aventurier, ç: You already have one, don't you? Adventurers travel light. In theory.
textes.Tu en as déjà un. Un seul suffit, s'il e: You already have one. One is enough, if it's dwarf-made.
textes.Tu en as déjà une. Une seule suffit : ce: You already have one. One is enough: what I forge doesn't break.
textes.Tu en es à combien, mon cœur ?: How many are you up to, sweetheart?
textes.Tu enfiles le poing de fer et tu frappes: You slip on the iron fist and punch your palm. Clang! That's going to hurt. Somebody.
textes.Tu enfiles un grand manteau de laine rou: You slip on a big, warm red wool coat. It smells a little of sulfur. (You never know: the inscription on the door insists.)
textes.Tu enjambes le bord du cockpit et tu t'a: You climb over the edge of the cockpit and sit down. It smells of new leather and wood glue.
textes.Tu entends cette musique qui monte de la: Can you hear that music coming up from the bottom shaft? Hmph. In my day, building works made less noise.
textes.Tu entends la Grande Forge ? Boum… boum…: Hear the Great Forge? Boom… boom… That's the steam hammer. Brunehaut calls it Grand-Mère. It rocks me to sleep.
textes.Tu entends le violon ? Ça veut dire que: Can you hear the violin? That means dessert is coming.
textes.Tu entends, mon chéri ? Il a changé une: Do you hear that, dear? It changed a note.
Do you hear, dear? The wind is dreaming.
textes.Tu entres chez Augustin Meule, au cœur d: You step into Augustin Meule's home, at the heart of his mill. He's resting by the millstone, to the rhythm of the sails.
textes.Tu entres dans l'atelier de Gaspard. Il: You step into Gaspard's workshop. He's working late, loupe screwed into his eye, surrounded by his hundred clocks.
textes.Tu entres dans le Jardin des Apesanteurs: You enter the Zero-Gravity Garden: you feel light as a feather, like a soap bubble.
You step into the mushroom circle. The glimmers spiral up around you…
textes.Tu es allé au Dôme des Serres, au fond d: Have you been to the Greenhouse Dome, at the bottom of the sea? Did you see Mélisande? With Flora, up in the Clouds, we're “the three gardeners”. I sent her a glowing mushroom, in a jar. It lives by her pond, apparently, and her water lilies find it chatty. Now that the Line has reopened, I'm going down to see her garden. She switches her sun on with a button. I haven't got one at all. We'll get on just fine.
textes.Tu es allé chez Octave ?! Il t'a dit que: You went to Octave's?! Did he tell you the shipwreck was my fault? It's not true. The map was right. It was the rock that was in the wrong place.
textes.Tu es allé chez les elfes ! Raconte ! Es: You went to the elves! Tell me everything! Do they have shells? No? What a strange people.
textes.Tu es blessé ! Assieds-toi. Non, ne disc: You're hurt! Sit down. No, don't argue. One sap potion, and you'll be good as new.
textes.Tu es descendu au Dôme d'Azur ? Tu as vu: Have you been down to the Azure Dome? Did you see Ernest, at the Currents Trading Post? I went down to buy mother-of-pearl chips from him. I paid him in news: three bits, all fresh, including one about the Burgomaster and a brooch. He gave me a good price. Now my jewellery has a glint of the sea. Shiny, eh?

Have you been down to the Azure Dome? Did you see Yolande, at the Diving Suit Workshop? The Funicular's wheels were cast right here, at the Great Forge! I'd put a note on the crate: “Tempered in laughter. HO HO!” She kept the crate. And she taps on her glass: two knocks, then one. I taught her that. She laughs in “hm”s, apparently. That counts. HO HO HO!
textes.Tu es descendu dans l'Arbre-Mère ?! Il y: You went down inside the Mother Tree?! Are there fairies? REAL ones? Take me next time! Please!
textes.Tu es descendu jusqu'à la Fronde ? Tu as: You went all the way down to the Fronde? Did you see my grandpa, by the brazier? He told you about his mohawk, I bet. … He held out the talking key to you? Then you're one of us. He doesn't give it to just anyone. The Burgomaster got it. He never got over it.
textes.Tu es descendu à la Grande Forge des Str: You went down to the Great Strata Forge? Then it's her! Mistress Brunehaut! The one who's been answering me for twenty years! Does she laugh with a “HO”? … HA HA HA! I knew it! I'm going down on Sunday. Warn her: she'd better hold on to her anvil.
textes.Tu es déjà au royaume des fées. Garde ce: You're already in the fairy kingdom. Keep this mushroom for another time.
textes.Tu es déjà mon écuyer, mon brave ! Le pr: You're already my squire, brave one! A squire's first duty: come back to see me. You did. Well done.
textes.Tu es généreux ! Je vais écrire ton nom: You're generous! I'll write your name on the “pay-it-forward soups” board. No, you don't want me to? Then I'll write “a wonderful stranger”.
You're the best neighbour in the sky.
textes.Tu es le 1 000 000e visiteur de ton prop: You are the 1,000,000th visitor of your very own journal!
You're the best stove on the island.
You're the most useful deaf man in Carène.
textes.Tu es le vent, moi je suis la tempête !: You're the wind, I'm the storm! Whoooooo!
textes.Tu es loin de chez toi, voyageur. Je sui: You are far from home, traveller. I am Ix Kanul, high priestess of Kukulkan, the Feathered Serpent. At the equinoxes, his shadow comes down the temple stairs. Today, it is you who climb them. What do you seek?
textes.Tu es mon humain préféré. Enfin, après T: You're my favourite human. Well, after Tornade. And after the sausage seller.
textes.Tu es monté jusqu'ici ? Bienvenue sur ma: You climbed all the way up here? Welcome to my platform. Ilyria Fildaube. Mind the threads: they're everywhere, and they're mine.
textes.Tu es passé au Piston Joyeux ? Firmin a: Have you been to the Jolly Piston? Firmin has Ferdinand's old boiler! Up top, the whole town sets its watches by its whistle. I can hear it from here, when the wind comes down the Column. It's the only thing from up there I hear properly.
textes.Tu es passé au Piston Joyeux, en bas ? F: Have you been to the Jolly Piston, down below? Firmin, Gustave's brother, sends a hot chocolate on the first capsule of the morning. It still arrives hot. Gustave tastes it, pulls a face, and finishes it. Every morning.
textes.Tu es passé par la boulangerie, la mare,: You went by the bakery, the pond, and the market twice.
textes.Tu es passé par les mares du nord. Il y: You went past the northern ponds. There's mud on your left boot. Hello, {surnom}.
textes.Tu es passé à la Gare des Strates ? Anat: Have you been to Strata Station? Anatole looks after the Funicular gate there. For twelve years, he oiled it every evening, just in case. He used to write to me: “Gate oiled. Still closed. Still ready.” Three lines. Twelve years. I've kept every letter. I reread them whenever the cabin is late. Which is never. So I reread them anyway.
textes.Tu es pire qu'Amenemhat avec ses devinet: You're worse than Amenemhat with his riddles.
textes.Tu es retourné voir la mer rouge ? Elle: Have you been back to see the red sea? Smells good, eh?
textes.Tu es toujours pressé. Et tu me dois deu: You're always in a hurry. And you owe me two feathers.
textes.Tu es tout pâle ! Mange. Non, pas de dis: You're so pale! Eat. No, no arguing: EAT.
You're an angel in an apron.
textes.Tu es un lecteur de Cerise, alors ! Elle: You're a Cerise reader, then! She'll draw you a horse with a mohawk. I can't compete. Nobody can compete with a mohawked horse.
textes.Tu es un vrai pirate, toi, ou juste un m: Are you a real pirate, or just a cabin boy?
You've come to see me %d times.
textes.Tu es vraiment médecin, ou tu as juste u: Are you really a doctor, or have you just got a saw?
textes.Tu essaies. C'est honnête. C'est déjà pl: You're trying. That's honest. That's already more than half my customers. Here, a rum, on the house. To keep you going. Easy, it bites.
textes.Tu fais quoi dans la vie, déjà ?: What is it you do again?
textes.Tu fais rouler les dés dans ta main. Six: You roll the dice in your hand. Six, six, six. Again. Six, six, five. Not bad. Nobody saw a thing.
textes.Tu fais siffler la plume dorée… Un cri d: You blow the golden feather like a whistle… An eagle's cry answers, far away. Ventaile is coming!
textes.Tu fais tinter la clochette : ding, ding: You ring the little bell: ding, ding! The bushes shake, and Truffe trots out, ears flopping, tail curled like a corkscrew. He presses his snout against your hand. Oink! He follows you now.
textes.Tu fais tourner l'attrape-rêves. Les per: You twirl the dreamcatcher. The beads tinkle softly. You yawn.
textes.Tu fais tourner la bague à ton doigt. Le: You twist the ring on your finger. The little crystal catches the light and throws a blue glint on your hand. Somewhere, Lumi would say: “Shiny, eh?”
textes.Tu fais tourner la barre. L'Albatros ne: You spin the helm. The Albatross doesn't budge an inch: it's moored. The helmsman laughs: “We're not flying today! Just rehearsing.”
textes.Tu fais tourner la maquette du doigt. El: You give the model a spin with your finger. It was already turning on its own; now it turns a little faster, and looks delighted.
textes.Tu fais tourner la perle entre tes doigt: You turn the pearl between your fingers. Deep inside, a little golden gleam drifts by, then a violet one, like the Great Pearl when evening comes.
textes.Tu fais tourner la plume entre tes doigt: You twirl the feather between your fingers. Somewhere in the Twisted Wood, an owl hoots.
textes.Tu fais un nœud de marin, comme Galet. P: You tie a sailor's knot, like Galet. Then you undo it. Then you tie it again. It's strangely soothing.
textes.Tu fais, avant, l'île f'appelait l'Île V: You know, the ithland uthed to be called Green Ithland. Then Barbe-Thanglante came and dug the Balafre — the Thcar — to hide hith treathure. That'th what they thay. I thay it wath the rain.
textes.Tu ferais ça ? Bien. L'herbe à fièvre po: You'd do that? Good. Fever grass grows at the water's edge, in the Drowned Marsh: silvery tufts that glow a little when the sun is low. I need three. And watch the water, not the tufts: crocodiles come out of the water.
textes.Tu ferais ça ? Les cempasúchil poussent: You'd do that? The cempasúchil grow on the chinampas in the south, beside the canals: orange tufts, like little suns. I need five bunches. Don't step on the beans!
textes.Tu ferais ça ? Mon tajine du vendredi, c: You'd do that? My Friday tagine is a whole affair: I need two sea bream, nice ones, fresh ones. Not Saïd's: he shouts at them all morning, their flesh gets stressed. Catch them yourself, or find them, but bring me two. And you'll taste the best tagine on the whole island.
textes.Tu ferais ça ? … Rhubarbe. Rouge comme u: You'd do that? … Rhubarbe. Red as a sunset, ill-mannered as a cabin boy. He flew off three days ago toward the northern jungle. Joe heard him swearing near the old abandoned camp. Spiders have made their nest there, be careful. First go and see Joe, in the square: he talks to birds better than to men.
textes.Tu fermes les yeux quand je chante, tu s: You close your eyes when I sing, you know.
textes.Tu fermes les yeux. Un ronron profond, r: You close your eyes. A deep, steady purr, coming from everywhere at once: from the rock, from the handrail, from your feet. A hundred and twenty years it's been going. It makes you want to say thank you.
textes.Tu feuillettes « Le Boucanier ». Page 3: You leaf through “Le Boucanier”. Page 3: “A ROBOT FROM LISSE APOLOGISES FOR FORTY MINUTES.” Page 4: a crossword where all the answers are “BOUCAN”.
textes.Tu fouilles tes poches… pas assez de piè: You rummage through your pockets… not enough coins. Lentille laughs: “Then it's zero! Zero is a price too!”
textes.Tu frappes un nain ? Sur SA montagne ?!: You hit a dwarf? On HIS mountain?!
textes.Tu frottes la lentille avec un chiffon d: You rub the lens with a soft cloth: it shines like a new penny. The apprentice hands you three shiny new coins: “For your trouble!”
textes.Tu frottes le patch des Rats de Cale. Qu: You rub the Bilge Rats patch. Somewhere in the Boucan, a guitar goes “BRRRANG”. It's surely no coincidence.
You rub the scarab between your fingers. It's warm, like a summer morning.
textes.Tu frottes ton badge. Il fait « bip-bip: You rub your badge. It goes “beep-beep” and displays, in tiny letters: “Hello!”
textes.Tu gardes un secret ? Chaque pièce que j: Can you keep a secret? Every coin I earn goes into a jar under my bed. I never buy myself anything, not even a ribbon. When there's enough, I'll buy giant flower seeds and replant the north, flower by flower, all the way to the sea. People think I'm stingy. I'm only patient.
textes.Tu gardes un souvenir de quelqu'un, toi: You keep a keepsake of someone too. I've got my little horse. We understand each other, you and me.
textes.Tu gardes ça pour toi, hein, {surnom}. J: Keep this to yourself, OK, {surnom}. I made a necklace for Zoé, with a heart-shaped shell. I'd been looking for that shell for four years. She said “Oh, a crab!” and laughed. I said yes, a crab. Now she wears it every day, and I don't know how to tell her it wasn't a crab.
textes.Tu goûtes toujours avant de saler ? Bien: Still tasting before you salt? Good.
textes.Tu grandis ! Tu grandis ! Tu vois par-de: You're growing! You're growing! You can see over people's heads! You feel as strong as Boulon!
textes.Tu gravis l'escalier de racines…: You climb the staircase of roots…
textes.Tu gravis les marches de la Tour des Tem: You climb the steps of the Tower of Storms… the wind howls louder and louder.
textes.Tu grimpes sur le dos de Géryon. « Accro: You climb onto Geryon's back. “Hold on tight,” he says in his kindly voice. He spreads his wings, dives into the chasm in wide circles… and sets you down, all the way at the bottom, at the edge of Malebolge.
textes.Tu inventes ! Ha ! Comme Grand-père Ébèn: You make it up! Ha! Like Grandpa Ébène. Very bad for exams, and very good for stories. You'd make a poor scholar, but a marvellous storyteller.
textes.Tu jettes ce qui est cassé, toi. Ne jett: You throw out what's broken, you do. At least don't throw out the Léviathan. It's got two or three good centuries left in it.
textes.Tu jettes l'or et le jade dans le feu… L: You throw the gold and jade into the fire… The flames hiss and shrink back, like Tecciztécatl, the rich one, who drew back four times before the blaze. Nothing happens. (On the fresco, it's the other god who jumps.)
You throw the bones into the middle of the room. The jaguars pounce on them growling… and lie down to gnaw. They're not interested in you at all anymore.
textes.Tu jettes les roseaux et les épines de N: You throw in the reeds and thorns of Nanahuatzin, the poor one, the brave one, who leapt without hesitating… The fire roars, rising to the vault! And from the blaze, slowly, a sun rises.
textes.Tu jures de rien dire ? Juré craché ? Le: Swear you won't tell? Cross your heart and spit? The ginger cat sleeps on a roof near the Fondouk, everybody almost knows that. But I climbed up to see him, {surnom}. He was sleeping on papers. Old pirate papers. I only told Tibo. 'Cause I'm scared of one thing: that those papers make the pirates leave again. And Tibo with them. So shh. Shh shh shh.
textes.Tu l'as arrosé, papa ? Il a grandi ?: Did you water it, Dad? Has it grown?
textes.Tu l'as dessiné rond, j'espère ?: You drew it round, I hope?
textes.Tu l'as entendue chanter, la baleine. De: You heard the whale sing. Since then I listen better. Nausicaa says I make a funny face.
textes.Tu l'as fait exprès ?: Did you do that on purpose?
textes.Tu l'as gardée assez longtemps, ta nouve: Have you kept your news long enough? Out with it!
textes.Tu l'as jouée, hier soir ? Ma note ?: Did you play it last night? My note?
textes.Tu l'as mangée, cette fois, ou tu as bou: Did you eat it this time, or plug a leak with it?
textes.Tu l'as pensé. Ça fume derrière tes yeux: You thought it. There's smoke behind your eyes.
textes.Tu l'as réparé ! Voilà, c'est ça, le sec: You fixed it! There, that's the secret: you break it, you fix it, you start again. I'm going to try the “fixing” part.
textes.Tu l'as tenu comme un vrai pilote ! Tien: You held it like a real pilot! Here: our little practice kite. At the Wind Festival, you'll fly with us!
textes.Tu l'as tenu comme un vrai pilote ! Tu a: You held it like a real pilot! You've already got a kite? Then sugar puffs it is: at the Wind Festival, you fly better on a full stomach.
You held it like a real pilot… Shh. Here: our little practice kite. Tomorrow, at the Wind Festival, you'll fly with us.
You held it like a real pilot… Shh. You've already got a kite? Then sugar puffs it is: at the Wind Festival, you fly better on a full stomach.
textes.Tu l'as toujours, ton caillou ?: Have you still got your pebble?
textes.Tu l'as toujours, ton coquillage-trésor: Do you still have your treasure-shell? Keep it safe. Pirates steal everything.
textes.Tu l'as vu aussi, gamin ? Le slime remon: You saw it too, kid? The slime is rising. In the wells, in the fountain, and this morning in Rissole's soup. She's furious. It comes from below, from the Dungeon of a Thousand Steps, at the foot of the Fangs. Five floors. Right at the bottom is the Jelly King, with his little crown. As long as he's there, the jelly will keep rising. You're rank D now: you're ready. Go down, defeat him, and bring me his Royal jelly heart. And when he splits into little pieces… whatever you do, don't panic. I know what I'm talking about.
textes.Tu l'as vue ? Pimprenelle ? En vrai ? El: You've seen her? Pimprenelle? For real? What's she like? Does she really have three hundred bolts? … Don't tell her I asked. Just tell her… three quick knocks. No, two knocks, then one. No… Tell her hello. There. Hello.
textes.Tu l'as vue, ce matin ?: Did you see it this morning?
textes.Tu l'as… tu es remonté de Xibalba. (Ix K: You have it… you came back up from Xibalba. (Ix Kanul kneels.) The Twins tricked the Lords and became the Sun and the Moon. You, you became a story. Keep the mask: its place is on the Altar of the Three Suns, in the highlands. Here, some festival cacao.
textes.Tu l'espères. C'est la réponse d'un sage: You hope so. That's a wise man's answer. We hope so too, every night. That's why we keep watch.
textes.Tu l'ouvres ! Comme moi ! Il y a toujour: You open it! Like me! There's always something inside, here. Come to the hangar, I'll show you. Wear gloves.
You'll let it freeze, you mean.
You weigh it in your hand: heavy as a melon. You set it down gently on the edge of the planter. It'll grow back on its stem, apparently.
textes.Tu la trouves toujours parfaite ? … Merc: Still think it's perfect? … Thank you.
textes.Tu laisses toujours tout tranquille ? Je: Still leaving everything alone? I'll do the checking, then.
textes.Tu lances les trois gâteaux de miel. Tro: You throw the three honey cakes. Three heads, three “gulps”. Cerbère licks his chops… yawns with all three mouths… and collapses, snoring. A three-voice snore. The south gate opens.
textes.Tu le diras à personne, {surnom}. Les le: Don't tell anyone, {surnom}. The letters are signed “The Seagull”. But the handwriting, I know it. It's the one on the Perroquet's slate. Lola's. I keep them all in a crate I called “Lola”. I've written forty replies. Never sent them. I don't know how you start a letter to a seagull.
textes.Tu le dis toujours : c'est moi qui ai ga: Still saying it: I'm the one who won?
textes.Tu le dis à personne, hein ? Mon grand-p: You won't tell anyone, right? My grandad always asks me what I can see on the horizon. He says it's to train me to be a captain. That's not true. His eyes are tired, he can't see the line between the sea and the sky any more. So I pretend I don't know, and I tell him everything. Even the seagulls. Especially the seagulls.
textes.Tu le disais déjà quand j'avais vingt-qu: You were already saying that when I was twenty-four.
textes.Tu le répares ! Bravo ! Viens à l'Atelie: You fix it! Well done! Come to the Free Workshop whenever you like. There's always a twelve spanner waiting for you. Put it back where it belongs afterwards, though.
You'd know, if you tasted it.
textes.Tu le transformes ! Ah, toi, tu es une i: You transform it! Ah, you're an inventor at heart. A toaster that becomes an alarm clock — that's exactly how I do things. Well, almost.
textes.Tu le vois, au sommet de la tour, au cen: Do you see it, at the top of the tower, in the centre of the city? It makes the air, the light and the dome. When it shines, the sea sings. When it fades… the sea falls silent.
textes.Tu leur dis au revoir ?: Will you say goodbye to them?
textes.Tu leur parles toujours ? Dis-leur bonjo: Still talking to them? Say hello to them from me.
textes.Tu lis par-dessus mon épaule, toi ?: Reading over my shoulder, are you?
textes.Tu lui as déjà écrit ?: Have you written to him yet?
textes.Tu lui parles ?! … Moi aussi, je parle à: You talk to it?! … I talk to my anvil too. Don't tell anyone. Her name's Berthe. She gives very good advice.
textes.Tu lâches le frein : les ailes prennent: You release the brake: the sails catch all the wind! The shaft roars, the millstone sings louder, and it snows flour.
textes.Tu lâches tout juste au-dessus de ta bar: You let go just above your rowboat… and land right in it! The Alouette folds back into your bag.
textes.Tu lèves la baguette, tout doucement. Le: You raise the baton, ever so gently. The night wind holds its breath…
textes.Tu lèves les quatre sceaux vers la grand: You raise the four seals toward the great gate…
textes.Tu lèves les trois sceaux vers la Dame d: You raise the three seals toward the Figurehead Lady. They light up: gold, bronze, silver… The wood creaks. Slowly, between her hands, the shell opens.
textes.Tu lèves les yeux. Une table te regarde,: You look up. A table stares back at you, legs in the air. All the furniture is stuck to the ceiling!
textes.Tu m'accompagnes ce soir ?: Will you play for me tonight?
textes.Tu m'apportes un arbre, la prochaine foi: Will you bring me a tree next time?
You've bought %d item from me, for %d coins.
textes.Tu m'as acheté %d objets, pour %d pièces: You've bought %d items from me, for %d coins.
textes.Tu m'as apporté des coquillages de la vr: You brought me shells from the real sea! I've kept every one.
textes.Tu m'as avoué que le noir te fait un peu: You admitted the dark scares you a little. Me too, when it goes boom… boom. But shh.
textes.Tu m'as avoué que tu caches tes blessure: You admitted you hide your injuries. So I watch how you walk. You walk fine. For now.
textes.Tu m'as battu, à l'Arène. Doucement, mêm: You beat me, at the Arena. Gently, even. I wrote you a poem. It rhymes with “champion”. Twice. I'll read it to you one evening, under the lantern.
textes.Tu m'as battue. Toi. Un Pied-Lourd. Avec: You beat me. You. A Heavy-Foot. With a propeller machine. (She folds her arms, then bursts out laughing.) Rematch! Tomorrow! And the day after! For the rest of our lives!
textes.Tu m'as dit : un équipage fidèle. Je m'e: You told me: a loyal crew. I remember. If I'm ever a hand short, I'll know where to look.
textes.Tu m'as dit merci, une fois. Je l'ai not: You said thank you to me, once. I noted it. In my head. Don't do it too often, it feels funny.
textes.Tu m'as dit qu'Arcanelle t'avait mis en: You told me Arcanelle filled you with joy, coming out of the mist. Keep that joy close: it's the best of lanterns.
textes.Tu m'as dit qu'il faut dire au revoir av: You told me you have to say goodbye before leaving. I think about it often. I haven't found the words yet.
textes.Tu m'as dit qu'ils auraient peur de nous: You told me they would be afraid of us. So I'm practising being gentle. I'm starting with Coralin. It's a long job.
textes.Tu m'as dit qu'on nous accueillerait à b: You told me they would welcome us with open arms. I repeat it to myself on the nights the crystal falls silent.
textes.Tu m'as dit qu'on écrit l'avenir en marc: You told me we write the future as we walk. Then walk straight, {surnom}. The stones are taking notes.
textes.Tu m'as dit qu'une carte, ça peut se tro: You told me a map can be wrong. I thought about it all night. So did Gaston. He was snoring, but he was thinking about it.
textes.Tu m'as dit que j'aurais un peu peur et: You told me I'd be a bit scared and that's normal. So I'm practising: I'm a bit scared every day now.
textes.Tu m'as dit que la tomate était une amie: You told me the tomato was a friend. I repeated it to my tomatoes. They blushed. Twenty out of ten, still.
You told me your friends keep you warm. I think of it when I see Ébène cheating at draughts. You were right.
textes.Tu m'as dit que toi aussi, tu étais part: You told me you'd left without saying goodbye too. Have you thought about it since? I think about it every morning, while I polish Bertha.
textes.Tu m'as dit que tout le monde devait avo: You told me everyone should get to speak. I remember it every time I open an assembly.
textes.Tu m'as dit que tu aimais les lames lour: You told me you like heavy blades. I've got my eye on you, {surnom}. You've got a dwarf's heart in a body that's too long.
textes.Tu m'as dit que tu chantais faux. Tapage: You told me you sing out of tune. So does Tapage. He's legendary. Think about that next time you're in the shower.
textes.Tu m'as dit que tu mangeais très bien. J: You told me you were eating very well. I'm checking anyway. You've lost weight.
textes.Tu m'as dit que tu n'avais pas le rythme: You told me you had no rhythm. Fibber. Your heart beats in time, I checked.
textes.Tu m'as dit que tu ne chantais jamais. L: You told me you never sing. The festival's not over yet, {surnom}. I promised.
textes.Tu m'as dit que tu ne pleurais jamais. J: You told me you never cry. I think about it often. So I cry a little for you. It doesn't cost me anything.
You told me you'd plant a forest. I kept a seed for you. Start with one tree: the forest will come later.
textes.Tu m'as dit que tu te perdais dans la br: You told me you get lost in the mist. If one evening you don't come home, I'll come. I already know the way you walk.
textes.Tu m'as dit que tu trouvais %s très symp: You told me you found %s very nice.
textes.Tu m'as dit que tu trouvais %s un peu bi: You told me you found %s a bit weird.
textes.Tu m'as dit que ça dépendait de qui donn: You told me it depended on who gives the order. I hope I'm the kind people follow.
textes.Tu m'as déjà aidée ! La grosse bat comme: You've already helped me! The big one beats like a heart. The others I'll see to myself: they're my daily walk.
You've given me %d gift, the last one: %s.
textes.Tu m'as fait %d cadeaux, le dernier : %s: You've given me %d gifts, the last one: %s.
textes.Tu m'as fait une de ces peurs ! J'ai cru: You gave me such a fright! I thought it was Monday.
textes.Tu m'as frappé ?! À moi ?! Viens là !: You hit me?! ME?! Come here!
textes.Tu m'as parlé de perles sous la mer. Je: You told me about pearls under the sea. I can't sleep for thinking of them. Did you bring any back? A little one? Half of one?
textes.Tu m'as raconté qu'il vit dans une caban: You told me he lives in a hut perched up a tree, and that he forges up there. A forge in a tree! With wood all around! I laughed for three days. On the fourth, I thought: that takes courage. Or no brains. I haven't decided yet.
You brought me crystal shards. My fireplace has never been so pretty. … I mean: so warm.
textes.Tu m'as rapporté mes cinq gouttes de ros: You brought back my five dewdrops. I won't lose them again. Promise. Almost.
textes.Tu m'as rendu ma baguette ! Depuis, je n: You gave me back my wand! I haven't let go of it since. Not even to sleep.
textes.Tu m'as trouvé la bague. Je… je ne l'ai: You found me the ring. I… I haven't given it to her yet. But soon!
textes.Tu m'avais conseillé d'attendre un signe: You advised me to wait for a sign. I've noted a hundred and seventeen since. Not one of them is clear.
textes.Tu m'avais demandé qui j'étais. Aujourd': You asked me who I was. Today, you know. And you'll never forget it again. I'll see to that.
textes.Tu m'avais dit les étoiles. J'y repense: You told me the stars. I think about it every evening when I close the workshop. I still haven't found the hole.
textes.Tu m'avais dit qu'on a un peu peur des d: You told me people are a little afraid of demons back home. Have you told them about us since?
textes.Tu m'avais dit qu'on peut être fort et d: You told me you can be strong and gentle. I wrote the poem. It's three lines long. It rhymes with “gentle”. Twice.
textes.Tu m'avais dit que c'est la lumière qui: You told me it's the light that makes the sky blue. I asked the Professor. He said yes. Then he left. Why?
textes.Tu m'avais dit que c'était difficile, d': You told me it was hard, being strong and gentle. You were right. I broke another cup this morning. Gently.
textes.Tu m'avais dit que c'était tout noir et: You told me it was all dark and all slimy. I told Titouan. He said eww. We laughed.
textes.Tu m'avais dit que j'étais la preuve qu': You told me I was the proof that you can be strong and gentle. I think of it every time I step into the Arena. Thank you.
textes.Tu m'avais dit que le ciel est bleu parc: You told me the sky is blue because it's happy. Today it's very blue. It must be super happy. Why?
textes.Tu m'avais dit que ma place était ici. T: You told me my place was here. You're right. But one day, here is going to float. You'll see.
textes.Tu m'avais dit que personne ne t'attenda: You told me nobody was waiting for you. That's not true any more: I'm waiting for you. Sit down.
textes.Tu m'avais dit que tu aimais ce qui chan: You told me you liked things that change. Ortie would be delighted. Me, I'm worried. And a little proud.
textes.Tu m'avais dit que tu cassais. Tu as cas: You told me you break stuff. Broken anything since? Bring it to me. We fix everything here.
textes.Tu m'avais dit que tu chantais faux. Ess: You told me you sing out of tune. Try anyway. The dough won't say anything. Neither will I.
textes.Tu m'avais dit que tu demandes quand tu: You told me you ask when you don't know. So ask me anything. I've got three centuries of answers in store.
textes.Tu m'avais dit que tu dormais mal. Tu as: You told me you sleep badly. Have you tried my moon tea? No? The leaves told me so: you're stubborn.
textes.Tu m'avais dit que tu l'avais fait, et q: You told me you'd done it, and it went well. I think about it every morning. On the way.
textes.Tu m'avais dit que tu ne lisais pas beau: You told me you don't read much. The little book with pictures, have you finished it? It doesn't matter. It's waiting for you.
textes.Tu m'avais dit que tu ne savais pas nage: You told me you couldn't swim. I haven't told anyone. We don't talk about it, people like us.
textes.Tu m'avais dit que tu ne savais plus d'o: You told me you didn't remember where you came from. I know: from the Smoking Cauldron. A little. Sit down.
textes.Tu m'avais dit que tu préférais le milie: You told me you preferred the middle of stories. Then you'll love your own: I think you're right in the thick of it.
textes.Tu m'avais dit que tu préférais les rond: You told me you preferred the rounds. If you want to come with me one day, wear good shoes. And don't go clang.
You told me it depends who against. I think of it every race. Against Bondi, it counts double, I've decided.
textes.Tu m'avais dit que ça dépend de ce qu'on: You told me it depends what you're waiting for. I thought about it again on the jetty. You were right. Shh.
You told me it depended on the day. So today, is it a quiet day or a noisy one? … Oh well, I'm shouting anyway.
You told me it depended on the dark. I think about it all the time. Tonight, it's a nice dark. I think.
textes.Tu m'avais dit « ami ». Je n'ai rien rép: You said “friend”. I didn't answer. I'm answering now: rival. Friend. Rival. There.
textes.Tu m'avais dit « bientôt ». J'ai repassé: You told me “soon”. I ironed my dress. Twice. Still nothing. I'm a little cross with you.
textes.Tu m'avais dit « pas encore ». Alors ? C: You told me “not yet”. So? When's your naughty thing happening? I've kept some smoke powder specially.
textes.Tu m'avais parlé de tes cauchemars de gr: You told me about your frog nightmares. Any better? I'm praying you dream of tadpoles now. They're smaller.
textes.Tu m'avais parlé de ton mal de mer. Mang: You told me about your seasickness. Eat some dry bread before you set sail. Gilles says it works for sleeping too.
textes.Tu m'emmènes encore au désert, mon oncle: Will you take me to the desert again, uncle?
textes.Tu m'offres un verre avec quoi ? Tes poc: Buy me a drink with what? Your pockets sound empty.
textes.Tu manges un champignon pour nous compre: You're eating a mushroom to understand us? Coo-roo! We'll tell you everything. Absolutely everything. Sit down.
textes.Tu marchanderais la lune elle-même, Aëlw: You'd haggle over the moon itself, Aëlwen.
textes.Tu marchandes bien, pour un {surnom}. Al: You haggle well, for a {surnom}. Go on then: a small discount. Don't tell anyone.
textes.Tu marches ? Bon. Marcher, c'est courir: You walk? All right. Walking is running with patience. Marcel says it's worth forty marathons. He exaggerates. Not by that much.
textes.Tu marches, je marche. Tu cours, je cour: You walk, I walk. You run, I run. You stop, I sit and gaze at you lovingly. That's the plan.
textes.Tu me cherchais jusqu'à la Cathédrale-Fo: You came looking for me all the way to the Forge Cathedral? At this hour, I come to listen to the Ember Heart. It tells me how the city is doing. Better than Asmodin, and in fewer words.
textes.Tu me comprends ? Alors écoute bien, c'e: You understand me? Then listen carefully, it's important: MINE. ALL. MINE.
textes.Tu me disais que tout tombait. Parfait :: You told me everything falls. Perfect: you're already halfway to being a juggler. Come on, I'll teach you the other half.
textes.Tu me dois deux pièces, Tonneau !: You owe me two coins, Tonneau!
textes.Tu me ferais une jarre de pluie ?: Would you make me a rain jar?
You'll tell me at the second coffee.
textes.Tu me la prêtes, un jour ?: Will you lend it to me one day?
textes.Tu me le dis tous les matins depuis quat: You've told me that every morning for eighty years.
textes.Tu me marches sur les pieds, mon trésor: You're treading on my toes, sweetheart!
textes.Tu me racontes la suite ?: Will you tell me what happened next?
textes.Tu mesures encore les gens, Coquillard ?: Still measuring people, Coquillard? Go and measure your words.
textes.Tu mets le casque jaune. Il est un peu g: You put on the yellow helmet. It's a bit big. You look like a real pilot. Well, a real pilot who's a bit lost.
textes.Tu montes dans le rayon de lumière, lége: You rise up the beam of light, light as a feather. Down below, your boat becomes tiny.
textes.Tu montes l'escalier en colimaçon du bef: You climb the spiral staircase of the belfry…
textes.Tu montes sur l'estrade. Ton cœur s'envo: You step onto the platform. Your heart flies out of your chest — you can see it! — and lands on the left pan. The jackal leans toward you.
textes.Tu montes vers la lumière… le vent souff: You climb toward the light… the wind is blowing up above.
textes.Tu montes à bord de l'Albatros : une lon: You climb aboard the Albatross: a long gondola of varnished wood, armchairs facing the portholes, and the helm right at the far end.
textes.Tu montes à bord de la Libellule : une l: You step aboard the Dragonfly: a long white gondola, armchairs facing big windows onto the sky, and right at the end, the bridge.
textes.Tu montes, marche après marche, dans le: You climb, step after step, into the heart of the tree…
textes.Tu montes, tu montes… et tu redescends e: Up you go, up and up… and you glide back down like a feather. It's wonderful.
You've been meditating for sixty years.
textes.Tu n'aimes pas la soupe ? Tu n'as pas go: You don't like soup? You haven't tasted mine. Sit down. One bowl. Just one. Then you tell me.
You couldn't catch the turnips. Remember: from the side. They can't turn.
You don't have any seal power yet.
textes.Tu n'as encore rien attrapé ? Patience,: Haven't caught anything yet? Patience, {surnom}. It took me three years to catch my first fish. Mind you, my rod was made of seaweed.
textes.Tu n'as jamais voulu me dire d'où tu vie: You never would tell me where you come from. That, I remember.
textes.Tu n'as pas de radio, mais tu m'entends: You don't have a radio, but you still hear me on the loudspeakers, eh? That's all that matters.
textes.Tu n'as pas encore de machine volante. À: You don't have a flying machine yet. In Cliquetis, Philibert Vis, “the inventor without an invention”, dreams of building one…
textes.Tu n'as pas encore de pouvoir. Les quatr: You don't have a power yet. The four seals of the great eastern island each hide one…
textes.Tu n'as pas eu le temps de dire « bonjou: You didn't have time to say “hello.” The door shut by itself. Well, not by itself.
textes.Tu n'as pas oublié ? Tu me montreras le: You haven't forgotten? You'll show me the sky. It's written down.
textes.Tu n'as pas oublié mes {manque} coquilla: You haven't forgotten my {manque} shells? I've already made room for them on the shelf!
textes.Tu n'as pas peur du noir, toi. Mais j'ai: You're not afraid of the dark. But I saw you smile when I switched on the fairy lights. I saw it.
textes.Tu n'as peur de rien, tu m'avais dit. Tu: You told me you weren't scared of anything. Have you been to the lake since? The Duchess is waiting for you.
textes.Tu n'as que {coquillages} bâtons. Il m'e: You've only got {coquillages} sticks. I need {manque}. The island's woods are full of them.
textes.Tu n'aurais pas vu mes noix de coco, toi: You haven't seen my coconuts, have you?
textes.Tu n'avais jamais compté les étoiles. Tu: You'd never counted the stars. Have you started? One is already one more than none.
textes.Tu n'avais pas de vélo. J'ai mis de côté: You didn't have a bike. I've put three frames aside for you. We'll make one. Whenever you like.
textes.Tu n'avais pas voulu répondre, l'autre f: You didn't want to answer, the other day. I won't ask again. Neither will Bertha.
textes.Tu n'en as que {coquillages}. Il m'en fa: You've only got {coquillages}. I need {manque} in all. Look on the beach by your village, they sparkle in the sun.
textes.Tu n'entends pas le cuivre, alors je tap: You can't hear the copper, so I hit harder for you. TAC. There. No need to thank me.
textes.Tu n'y connais rien ? Alors commence par: You don't know anything about it? Then start with the best! Sit down: a hot sulphur punch, a frozen lava, and you'll know.
textes.Tu n'étais pas sûr, la dernière fois. C': You weren't sure, last time. That's good. A good lookout doubts. And then he writes it down.
textes.Tu nages ! Espace : remonter, Ctrl : plo: You're swimming! Space: surface, Ctrl: dive, Shift: swim fast. Facing a pier or a rock, press Space to haul yourself up.
textes.Tu nages ! Stick gauche : nager vers où: You're swimming! Left stick: swim where you're looking (look down to dive). A: surface, B: descend, left trigger: swim fast.
textes.Tu ne connais encore aucun sort. Les maî: You don't know any spell yet. The masters of Arcanelle, the wizards' island, teach six of them.
textes.Tu ne connais pas encore la magie de tél: You don't know teleportation magic yet. The fairies, maybe, someday…
textes.Tu ne crois pas à la magie. Je ne t'en v: You don't believe in magic. I don't hold it against you. I'm just preparing a little surprise for you. Heh heh.
textes.Tu ne crois à aucune de mes histoires. C: You don't believe any of my stories. Just like Barricade. Deep down, I like that. Every audience needs a few sceptics.
textes.Tu ne croyais pas aux navets qui courent: You didn't believe in running turnips. Now you've seen them. Handsome, aren't they?
textes.Tu ne dis plus « trois » à voix haute, j: You don't say “three” out loud anymore, I hope?
textes.Tu ne le diras à personne, que c'était m: You won't tell anyone it was me, right? I'm working on an even scarier ghost. With chains. And a saucepan.
textes.Tu ne le sais pas par moi !: You didn't hear it from me!
textes.Tu ne les as même pas, les quarante pièc: You haven't even got the forty coins! Ha! Come back when you're rich.
textes.Tu ne les coupes plus au couteau, j'espè: You don't cut it with a knife anymore, I hope? My heart couldn't bear it.
You don't trust them, I know. Neither do I. But greet them all the same. They pay.
textes.Tu ne marchandes qu'avec moi, hein ? Alo: You only haggle with me, eh? Then come on, I've been practising. You won't win.
textes.Tu ne me ferais pas un prix ?: Couldn't you give me a better price?
You never make me pay for it.
textes.Tu ne parles jamais ? Tu as perdu ta lan: Do you never talk? Cat got your tongue?
textes.Tu ne partages pas tes frites ! « À MOI: You don't share your chips! “MINE!” Ha ha! You're a real seagull, you are.
textes.Tu ne prends jamais de corde. Je t'en ai: You never take a rope. I've put one aside for you. For the day you fall down a hole.
