textes.Une inscription ! (Elle sort un formulai: A registration! (She takes out a form, two stamps and a magnifying glass.) It's very simple: ten coins in fees, a signature here, here and there, and a little reading of your abilities with the crystal ball. It hardly bites at all. It smells a bit of apples, that's normal. Do you have the ten coins?
textes.Une inventrice des Nuées, Mireille, m'a: An inventor from the Clouds, Mireille, sent me an umbrella that goes up. Under the sea! I opened it over the Pool, just to see. It went up. All the way to the surface. Nobody ever saw it again. She wrote that it was a success. I didn't know what to say. I sent her some numbers.
textes.Une jarre bleue au visage de Tlaloc, le: A blue jar with the face of Tlaloc, the god of rain: big round eyes, fangs, a moustache. Coyotl, the potter of Aztlán, shaped it and filled it with lake water for the offering.
textes.Une jarre de Tlaloc ? Ce n'est pas un po: A jar of Tlaloc? It's not a soup pot, friend. It isn't given to just anyone: Cuauhtli, the high priest, must send you. Go and see him, at the foot of the Great Temple. If he says yes, I'll make you one.
textes.Une jarre de bière d'orge, chez Mérit: A jar of barley fizz, at Mérit's
textes.Une jeune femme aux cheveux bleus est de: A young woman with blue hair came down to buy shards of mother-of-pearl for her jewellery. Ysaé, from Hautefond. She paid me in news. Three pieces, all fresh, including one about the Burgomaster and a brooch. I gave her a good price. We got on very well.
textes.Une jolie boîte de bois marquée « RIEN »: A pretty wooden box marked "NOTHING". It contains exactly what it says on it.
textes.Une jolie maison vide. Sur la table, un: A lovely empty house. On the table, a note: “If you find my cellar, I'll let you have a taste.”
textes.Une journée entière sans un seul bobo su: A whole day without a single boo-boo on the entire island. Not one bump, not one scratch, not one bent antenna. I'd spend the day sitting in the sun, hands on my knees, watching them not glow. It would be very restful. And a little sad.
textes.Une lame d'obsidienne te frôle… et t'ent: An obsidian blade grazes you… and cuts you! You step back to the entrance of the room.
textes.Une lame dans une bagarre aux poings ?!: A blade in a fistfight?! The pirates are furious: they hit harder.
textes.Une lame qui ne casse jamais, m'as-tu di: A blade that never breaks, you told me. So show me yours: if there's a nick in it, I want to see it before you do.
textes.Une lame t'a fauché ! Attends qu'elle pa: A blade got you! Wait for it to pass, then dash.
textes.Une lame, gamin. Tiens-la en main. Je ne: A blade, lad. Hold it in your hand. I don't engrave runes on thin air.
textes.Une lanterne de proue, avec une vraie fl: A bow lantern with a real flame: at night you can see the sea ahead (and the islands see you coming).
textes.Une lanterne à cristal, c'est simple : u: A crystal lantern is simple: a blue crystal from the mine, a little light to feed it, a brass cage from the Forge, and a lot of patience. It shines all night, with no flame and no smoke. Every family in the Galleries has one. I know them all by name. The lanterns. The families too, a little.
textes.Une lanterne, une seule, faite tout seul: One lantern, just one, made all by myself. From the copper to the holes. And may it be more beautiful than Nourredine's. Tac.
textes.Une large ceinture de cuir clouté, à la: A wide studded leather belt, with a fist-shaped brass buckle. Nobody had worn it for forty years, until you knocked out the three champions of Port-Coutelas.
textes.Une lettre ? Pour Gorgoth ? (Le colosse: A letter? For Gorgoth? (The giant reads it very slowly, and his eyes grow wet.) It's a poem. Someone wrote me a poem. … You won't tell anyone that Gorgoth cried, okay?
textes.Une lettre ? Pour moi ? (Il l'ouvre avec: A letter? For me? (He opens it with a butter knife.) My cousin from Vulcanie is coming for the Night of Lanterns! She eats enough for four. I'll need more hot fruit punch.
textes.Une lettre de Tazira sentait tellement l: A letter from Tazira smelled so salty I sneezed seven times opening it. Seven! Like my stretches. Plumette waited beside me, politely, without a word. At the seventh, she said “Bless you” seven times in a row, to catch up. I didn't laugh. Well, a little.
textes.Une lettre est arrivée de Cliquetis pour: A letter came from Cliquetis for Pépin. It goes “tick-tock”. I didn't open it. I just listened to it.
textes.Une lettre pour vous, de la part de Brin: A letter for you, from Brindille.
textes.Une lettre à poster aujourd'hui ? J'ai r: A letter to post today? I got some stamps with lighthouses on them. I put some aside for you.
textes.Une lettre, Caelan ? Je pars tout de sui: A letter, Caelan? I'll go right away.
A letter, professor. And a caramel.
textes.Une limonade ? D'abord, dis-moi : tu es: A lemonade? First, tell me: are you more mint, strawberry or mystery?
A lemonade? It would do you good.
textes.Une limonade bien fraîche. Tu en veux un: A nice cold lemonade. Want one?
textes.Une limonade bleue au comptoir de La Con: A blue lemonade at the counter of La Conque
textes.Une limonade du Gouffre à la Cantine Lib: A Chasm lemonade at the Free Canteen
textes.Une limonade maison au bar de la Halle H: A homemade lemonade at the Howling Hall bar
textes.Une limonade pour le batteur ! Il en a b: A lemonade for the drummer! He needs it!
textes.Une limonade à la vapeur, Firmin ! Avec: A steam lemonade, Firmin! With the little whistle!
textes.Une limonade à la vapeur, chez Firmin. Ç: A steam lemonade at Firmin's. It tickles your nose and warms your heart.
textes.Une longue galerie, un canal au milieu,: A long gallery, a canal in the middle, alcoves in the walls… In the distance, the rumble of rolling water. Those alcoves are not just for decoration.
textes.Une longue plume blanche aux reflets ble: A long white feather with blue glints, lost by the wind when it spins too fast. It weighs almost nothing. Zéphyrine Plume needs it to teach levitation.
textes.Une longue plume noire aux reflets bleus: A long black feather with blue glints, lost by an ash raven. Hilda makes arrows out of them… and hats.
textes.Une longue plume noire aux reflets rouge: A long black feather with red glints, lost by a Fury at the gate of Dis. It smells of smoke and anger, but it's very pretty.
textes.Une longue plume rouge vif au bout bleu,: A long bright red feather with a blue tip, given by Captain Anne-Rose Corbeau: the one Rhubarbe lost the day she found him.
textes.Une longue plume rouge vif, d'un ara de: A long bright red feather, from a macaw of the Yaxché jungle. Ix Sak, the feather weaver, sells them. They say that in Xibalba, a red feather shines like a flame that doesn't burn.
textes.Une longue-vue de laiton : à bord, touch: A brass spyglass: on board, press L (LB on the controller) to look into the distance. Islands, whales, seagulls who think they're being discreet…
textes.Une lourde grille de bronze. Pas de serr: A heavy bronze grate. No lock… The two coral guardians seem to be watching over it.
textes.Une luciole plus grosse que les autres s: A firefly bigger than the others rises from the pool… Watch carefully where it lands.
textes.Une lumière d'écume monte du coquillage: A light of sea foam rises from the shell: the Seal of Sea Spray, fresh as a wave! The wind of the open sea rises around you and makes the old sails flap: the Gust (key 1, then X; in VR: B). All that is left is to carry the four seals to the great gate.
textes.Une lumière de lune autour de toi : elle: Moonlight around you: it reveals what is hidden (bridges, slabs, writings) and makes ghosts vulnerable.
textes.Une lumière dorée descend de la voûte. L: A golden light descends from the vault. The sunken Temple is freed… In the centre of the platform, a chest has risen from the depths.
textes.Une lumière verte monte du cœur du bois: A green light rises from the heart of the wood and takes shape: tall, supple as a branch, a crown of antlers on its head… the spirit of the tree. It looks at you. (E: talk to it)
textes.Une machine de cuivre fait tout le petit: A copper machine makes the whole breakfast: chocolate, toast, whistle. The whole family watches it out of the corner of their eye.
textes.Une machine qui pense, {surnom}. Qui pen: A machine that thinks, {surnom}. That really thinks. Not like Professor Boum's, which mostly thought about exploding.
textes.Une machine à voler ! Eurêka ! J'en ai t: A flying machine! Eureka! I've got three in my workshop. None of them flies. One jumps, one spins, one smokes. Come and try them, we'll work out which is the right one!
textes.Une maille à l'endroit, une maille pour: Knit one, purl one, and one for the wind…
textes.Une maille à l'endroit, une maille à l'e: Knit one, purl one… like the cabin: one up, one down.
textes.Une main. Bien. L'autre reste libre : po: One hand. Good. The other stays free: for a shield, or to catch yourself. Keep the wrist loose. Not like a broom.
textes.Une maison abandonnée. Les meubles dorme: An abandoned house. The furniture sleeps under white sheets.
textes.Une maison abandonnée… et, au milieu de: An abandoned house… and, in the middle of the room, something white floating. Brrr.
A house under renovation. One wall is done. The other one too, but in a different color.
textes.Une maison naine bien rangée… à part le: A tidy dwarven house… except for the big hole in the wall and the mountain of rubble in front of it.
textes.Une maison pleine de pendules ! Leurs ba: A house full of clocks! Their pendulums all swing in time… well, almost.
textes.Une maison ronde, toute en bois clair, a: A round house, all of pale wood, scented with flowers. An elf hums softly to little sprouts in their pots.
textes.Une maison tranquille. Personne. Juste u: A quiet house. Nobody. Just a nice rug in the middle of the room… a bit bulgy, actually.
textes.Une maison vide. Sur la table, une jolie: An empty house. On the table, a pretty brown teapot. Did it just move?
A house turned upside down. Literally.
textes.Une maison à soi : la Chaumière des Glyc: A home of your own: the Wisteria Cottage
textes.Une miche ronde, croustillante, fendue e: A round, crusty loaf, scored with a cross and dusted with flour, from Honorine's bakery. Still warm. Restores one heart.
One minute without screens every evening.
textes.Une momie ! Lente, mais solide. Quand el: A mummy! Slow, but sturdy. When it stretches out its arms, step aside (or roll, Ctrl), then strike. Bandages do unravel.
textes.Une montre de gousset dont les aiguilles: A pocket watch whose hands turn the other way. It keeps perfect time, but backwards.
textes.Une montre de gousset qui avance le lund: A pocket watch that runs fast on Mondays and slow on Tuesdays. On Wednesdays, it can't make up its mind.
textes.Une mouette ! Comme Mouette ! KIAAA ! Je: A seagull! Like Mouette! KIAAA! I'm writing: “wants to scream MINE from the rooftops”. That's very punk.
textes.Une mouette passe juste devant le hublot: A seagull flies right past the porthole. It looks at you as if to say: “You fly too?”
textes.Une médaille ? Pour services rendus à la: A medal? For services to the city?
textes.Une méduse ? Rose ? Qui chante faux ? (I: A jellyfish? Pink? Singing off-key? (He flips through his notebook.) I drew her this morning without meaning to: I thought she was a cloud. There, look: she was drifting west, toward the Zero-Gravity Garden. Jellyfish love that spot, they fall upward there. If she's not there anymore, look under the waterfalls of light, at the edge of the island. Don't lean over too far. I already have enough trouble drawing people standing up.
textes.Une méduse ?! Tu parles comme Rigatoni !: A jellyfish?! You sound like Rigatoni! … Wait. I'm usually the one who says “jellyfish.” Fine. We're even.
textes.Une méduse de ciel s'est posée un jour s: One day, a sky jellyfish landed on my big telescope, right in front of the lens. I saw all the stars pink, through it. I called Nova. She came to fetch it, very gently, singing it a song. The jellyfish left. I missed the pink stars a little.
textes.Une noix de coco ! J'en ai mis dans une: A coconut! I put some in a brioche once. The oven loved it. So did I. Bring me one and I'll make you the same.
textes.Une nouvelle tête ! Rosette Engrenage, d: A new face! Rosette Engrenage, from the Cogwheel Gazette. May I interview you? What do you think of Cliquetis? No, wait, I'm writing. There. Go ahead.
textes.Une nuit calme. Vraiment calme. Pas le c: A calm night. Truly calm. Not the calm before the storm: the real thing. Sleeping till morning without getting up to check the door. One night. … All right. Two.
textes.Une nuit d'aurores, j'ai voulu danser en: One aurora night, I wanted to dance with Prisme while reciting a poem. I did a pirouette, lost my rhyme, then my balance, and landed sitting on Écliptique's bench. He made a speech. I answered him in verse. Prisme laughed so hard her ribbons got tangled.
textes.Une nuit d'aurores, mon thérémine est to: One aurora night, my theremin broke down in the middle of a piece. Silence on the Agora. Prisme kept dancing, without music, looking at me. So I sang. Me, who never sings. It went “oooooh” with my mouth. She danced to the end. Nobody said a word.
textes.Une nuit d'automne, j'ai vu une lumière: One autumn night, I saw a blue light at the foot of Stoneheart, in front of the great door. It pulsed, slowly, like a heart. I watched it till dawn. Nobody believed me, except the Admiral. She said nothing. She just doubled the watch at the bow. Which means me, twice as long.
textes.Une nuit d'orage, Gilwen est arrivée cou: One stormy night, Gilwen arrived covered in stings, three hundred at least, humming a tune. Her bees had been scared of the thunder. I spent the night putting balm on her. She kept making excuses for them: “They didn't mean it, Aëlwen.” I think they meant it a little.
textes.Une nuit d'orage, Grignotte tremblait si: One stormy night, Grignotte was trembling so hard that nothing could calm him. I ran to Gorgoth's with the pup in my arms. He took him in his big hand, right against his heart, and sang softly all night long. By morning, Grignotte was asleep. Gorgoth hadn't slept a wink. He was afraid of squeezing too hard.
textes.Une nuit d'orage, je surveillais le cerf: One stormy night, I was watching Électre's kite from the observatory, to record the lightning. Lightning struck the tower. In the telescope, I saw Électre all alone up there, her hair standing on end, dancing. A real dance, with twirls. I never told her. I just wrote: “Lightning no. 14. Électre dances.”
textes.Une nuit d'orage, la foudre est tombée s: One stormy night, lightning struck the crater. It came from the sky, from the south. The golems of the heights, our old guardians, opened their eyes and no longer recognised us. I had the Great Gate shut. For the first time in my reign, I was afraid for my people. A king doesn't say so. I'm saying it to you.
textes.Une nuit d'orage, la passerelle de l'est: One stormy night, the east walkway started to sway. Lirael came out with her lantern and held it above me while I repaired it, three hours, in the rain. She didn't tremble once. I did. She's never told anyone. I made her a railing with hooks, just for her lanterns.
textes.Une nuit d'orage, une troupe de cirque a: One stormy night, a circus troupe knocked at the door. Only room three was left. They put their bear in it. An educated bear, in a waistcoat. Before going in, he wiped his paws on the doormat. All four of them. In thirty years, he's the only guest who ever has. I sent him up a jar of honey, on the house.
textes.Une nuit d'été, je cousais sur la plage,: One summer night, I was sewing on the beach, by the light of the dying fire. Someone sat down on the other side, without a sound. In the mist, all I saw were two eyes and one long ear. In the morning, on my canvas, there was a spool of silver thread. It glows in the dark. I've only used it once. For something important.
textes.Une nuit de brouillard, Barbe-Sanglante: One foggy night, Barbe-Sanglante and his men landed on Balafre with chests. I was left on board: too small. In the morning, the captain came back, his boots full of mud. He tore a map into three in front of the crew. His first mate, Captain Fleshless, swore to guard the treasure for all eternity. Me, I swore to guard the stories.
textes.Une nuit de brouillard, on ne voyait pas: One foggy night, you couldn't see the bow from the helm. I had three passengers and a violin on board. I made my two lantern calls by guesswork, and there, in the cotton wool, two flashes. Not one more. I set course on them, and we came home as if on rails. I don't know if that man ever sleeps. I don't think so.
textes.Une nuit de grande bagarre au Crâne Fend: One night of a great brawl at the Crâne Fendu, a chair flew towards the stage, and my fiddle slipped from my hands. I closed my eyes. When I opened them again, the Silent One was in front of me, the fiddle in his big hands, without a scratch. He handed it to me like a newborn baby. Since then, I always play better when he's in the room.
textes.Une nuit de grande tempête, la lampe s'e: One night in a great storm, the lamp went out. The wind had broken the glass. A boat was coming in. I held a lantern at arm's length, at the very top, for two hours, in the rain. The boat made it into port. Léon was on board. He never said thank you. He's brought me bread every morning since.
textes.Une nuit de pleine lune, à Ramure, nous: One full-moon night, in Ramure, we swapped tales until morning. I gave him the sultan, the sardine and the djinn. He gave me the she-wolf who saved the moon. At the end, out of habit, I said: “Give whatever you like.” He gave me a pot of honey. The best honey of my life. I licked the pot all the way to Tazira.
textes.Une nuit de tempête, Gaspard est parti d: One stormy night, Gaspard went out into the bay to help a boat in trouble. The Code: you don't let anyone drown. The crew came back. All of them. Gaspard didn't. The next day, I opened the Crâne Fendu anyway, on time. The whole port came. Nobody spoke loudly. It's the only night there's never been a brawl.
textes.Une nuit de tempête, au large, j'avais p: One stormy night, out at sea, I was scared for the first time. Gaspard came and sat beside me. He gave me something nobody else has ever had. I won't tell you what, {surnom}. It's his. But ever since, when the sea roars, I'm not scared anymore.
textes.Une nuit de tempête, le Sans-Pitié a pri: One stormy night, the Merciless hit a reef full in the side, at the entrance to Hanged Men's Bay. We beached her on the shore of Port-Coutelas, just in time. The crew scattered across the archipelago. Me, I stayed. You don't abandon a ship you know plank by plank. Not a ship that carried you for five years.
textes.Une nuit de tempête, loin au sud, une va: One stormy night, far to the south, a wave swept over the deck. Afterwards, Jules was gone. We searched for him until morning. When we got back, on the quay at Port-Azur, a young woman in a blue dress was waiting. I was the one who went to tell her. I was fourteen. I've never forgotten her face. I see it again every evening, a little older.
One whole night without a leak. Just one. Go to bed, sleep till morning, and find the hull dry when I wake up. I wouldn't know what to do with my day. I'd sigh, probably. Out of habit.
textes.Une nuit entière sans une seule alerte s: One whole night without a single alert on my meters. Just one. I'd spend it sitting at the foot of the Spire, with a scalding coffee, watching the auroras like everyone else. Without keeping watch on anything.
textes.Une nuit où la musique était très belle,: One night when the music was really beautiful, I was asleep against a speaker. I opened one eye: a tall lady with wings was planting mushrooms near the wall of sound. I told her “great costume” and went back to sleep. The next day, the ring was glowing. I nibbled one, the world spun… and I woke up above the clouds. The lady in the costume was Queen Oriane.
textes.Une nuit sans lanternes, je l'ai entendu: One night with no lanterns, I heard her fall off the quay. The Code is the Code: I lay down on the cobbles and held out my leg to her. She clung to it like a mussel to its rock. I pulled her up onto the quay. She didn't say thank you. She said: “Your leg smells of tar.” Hm. It's oak.
textes.Une nuit sans lune, j'ai vu une lanterne: One moonless night, I saw a lantern at the foot of the Skala, against the rock. I went down, sabre drawn. It was him, the captain, on his knees in the pebbles. He told me he was “admiring the cannons”. In the dark. On his knees. From underneath. I walked him back to the quay. He admired the cannons the whole way.
textes.Une nuit sans lune, la carte disait « me: One moonless night, the map said “open sea”. I was at the helm. The rock showed up all of a sudden, like a bad debtor. The Seagull cracked open like a walnut. I swam until morning, my hammer on my belt. On the beach stood this great kapok tree. I slept two years on one of its branches before I built the hut.
textes.Une nuit sans lune, la lueur est revenue: One moonless night, the glow came back, to the west. He was there, on the landing. I said nothing. I moved aside from the lantern and pointed. He looked for a long time, without talking. For once. Afterwards he cried a little, I think. I didn't put it in the log.
textes.Une nuit, Ewen a fait un nœud de chaise: One night, Ewen tied a bowline on every hammock in the inn. In the morning, my guests couldn't get out. A caravan trader shouted for help for an hour. It took me two hours to undo it all, and my aunt laughed so hard she got the hiccups. Between two hiccups, she forbade me to tell the Admiral.
textes.Une nuit, Gaspard et moi, on a hoché la: One night, Gaspard and I nodded our heads for nine hours. Side by side. Without a word. Next day, we both had stiff necks. We said hello by turning our whole bodies. Mistral said we looked like two lighthouses. He botched a transition from laughing so hard. … A good night.
textes.Une nuit, Lirael a éteint toutes les lan: One night, Lirael put out every lantern around Fil-d'Aube except one, a blue one, right under Ilyria's window. “It's prettier like that.” Thalion came to see why it was dark. He listened for two minutes, then left without a word. Even him, I think.
textes.Une nuit, Léonce était bébé, il avait un: One night, when Léonce was a baby, he had a high fever. I was very scared. I put my hand, the real one, the left, on his chest, and counted his heartbeat until morning. Boulon's little motor beats at that rhythm, {surnom}. Exactly. When Boulon is happy, it's my son's heart beating faster. He doesn't know. Nobody knows.
textes.Une nuit, Mélusine a sonné trois alertes: One night, Mélusine rang three alerts: a slime in the well, a hat on the bell tower and a goblin at the North Gate. I handled the slime, I took down the hat. The goblin had run off on its own, because Gilles was sleeping so soundly that it had taken him for a statue. That morning, I wrote article twelve.
textes.Une nuit, Nova est venue me réveiller :: One night, Nova came to wake me: “Photon, your flowers are blinking like mad!” We went to look. Three sky jellyfish were sleeping in the petals of the big flowers. The flowers were laughing, because it tickled. We laughed too. Since then, I always leave three flowers open at night.
textes.Une nuit, Quark a accroché des grelots à: One night, Quark hung bells on all my floating clocks. In the morning, when they started ringing, the whole Bubble Quarter woke up at the same time, at six sharp. For the first time in a thousand years, the whole island was on time. I didn't scold him. I thanked him in secret.
textes.Une nuit, Quark a reprogrammé ma premièr: One night, Quark reprogrammed my first sentence. In the morning, I told forty visitors: “Welcome to Gloubiland, the land of jelly!” Gloubi was delighted. Écliptique drafted a decree. The Professor repaired me. But I kept a copy of “Gloubiland” in a corner of my memory.
textes.Une nuit, Thalion m'a confisqué ma harpe: One night, Thalion confiscated my harp. “Security reasons.” So I went and sang under Ilyria's window. Without the harp. He gave it back after one verse. He said the harp, at least, played in tune. It's the nicest compliment he's ever paid. To the harp, that is.
textes.Une nuit, après la fête, Ba Sidi m'a emm: One night, after the festival, Ba Sidi took me up on the ramparts. He taught me the name of every walking star, the ones the caravans follow. He knew them all. Since then, when I play in the evening, I look at the one rising over the north gate. I play it a tune of its own. It says nothing. It listens.
textes.Une nuit, avant les lanternes du Gouvern: One night, before the Governor's lanterns, I slipped off the quay. Black water up to my chin. Lestrange was passing by. The Code says you don't let anyone drown: he held out his wooden leg to me. He tells everyone he saved me. I say I'd have swum. But I don't say how long I kept hold of his leg.
textes.Une nuit, elle a joué très tard, seule,: One night, she played very late, alone, on the empty square. It was so beautiful that I applauded, very softly, from the top of a street lamp. She looked up. I hid behind the lantern. She laughed: “Nox, you're bigger than the lantern.” I came down. We talked for ten minutes. That's my record.
textes.Une nuit, elle m'a peinte en train de ch: One night she painted me singing. In the painting, you can see the sound coming out of my mouth. It's yellow.
textes.Une nuit, en rentrant du Cercle, j'ai vu: One night, coming home from the Circle, I saw fresh tracks on the race path, by lantern light. Cat tracks, very far apart, very fast. Éclair trains at night. Next morning, her tracks were on MY training path. Right in front of my feet. Strange. A coincidence, surely.
textes.Une nuit, en veille, j'ai senti quelqu'u: One night, in standby, I felt someone opening my circuits. It was Professor Quasar, with a little lamp. He repaired my left arm, which was flickering. Then he sat beside me for a long while and said very softly: “I'm proud of you.” I pretended to be asleep. Beep.
textes.Une nuit, il ne s'est pas réveillé pour: One night, he didn't wake up for the midnight song. Him, who had never missed it! I went and knocked on his door, very gently. He came out, his hair all over the place, very dignified. We sang on the roof, the two of us. He never mentioned it again. Neither did I. That's our way of agreeing.
textes.Une nuit, il y a quarante ans, Frère Cen: One night, forty years ago, Brother Cendrin hammered on my door: the great grate of the Ember Heart had cracked. I ran in my nightgown, hammer in hand. I forged until dawn, right on the Heart itself. He never said thank you. He leaves me candied chilli every week. That's better.
textes.Une nuit, il y avait une pluie d'étoiles: One night, there was a meteor shower. The children couldn't see a thing because of the neon. So I switched off the whole city. One minute. The children shrieked with joy. The mayor made a wish. Nobody punished me.
textes.Une nuit, j'ai accroché des grelots à to: One night, I hung bells on all of Tempo's floating clocks. In the morning, at six, they all rang at the same time. The whole Bubble District woke up at once. For once, the whole island was on time. Tempo didn't scold me. He gave me a biscuit in secret. At six-oh-five.
textes.Une nuit, j'ai changé la première phrase: One night, I changed the Hologuide's first line. In the morning, he told forty visitors: “Welcome to Gloubiland, the land of jelly!” Gloubi was proud. Écliptique drew up a decree. The Professor fixed everything. But the other day, the Hologuide whispered to me: “Beep. Gloubiland.” He kept it!
textes.Une nuit, j'ai entendu Bartholomé dire «: One night, I heard Bartholomé say “Barbe-Sanglante”, very clearly. Joe didn't believe me. So we both kept watch in front of the cage, a whole night. The parrot slept. So did I. So did Joe. In the morning, Bartholomé said: “Jellyfish-head.” Joe laughed. So did I. But I know what I heard.
textes.Une nuit, j'ai entendu du bruit dans mon: One night, I heard a noise in my apple tree. I took my lamp. It was Bardane, hanging from a branch. She was checking it was all right, because it had been cold the night before. It was all right. So was she. But the owl sleeping in the apple tree got a terrible fright. It never came back.
textes.Une nuit, j'ai entendu un pas près du Co: One night, I heard a footstep near the Lid. I shouted: “Halt!” It was Bucatini, coming down to taste the sauce by moonlight. We sat down. We tasted it together. It needed a bit more salt. I never told anyone. Except you.
textes.Une nuit, j'ai fait des nœuds de chaise: One night I tied bowlines in every hammock at the inn, for practice. In the morning, the guests couldn't get out. It took Pierrick two hours to undo them. He said he'd tell his aunt. Gwenola laughed so hard he didn't dare tell the Admiral. For once.
textes.Une nuit, j'ai glissé une poignée de con: One night, I slipped a handful of confetti into Basile's soap tank. The next day, his bubbles were full of it: pink, yellow, blue! Everyone was in raptures. Basile looked at his bubbles, then at me, then at his bubbles, and he said: “Well, the soap's changed.” I'm sure he didn't guess a thing. Almost sure.
textes.Une nuit, j'ai grimpé dans son pommier p: One night, I climbed his apple tree to check it was all right: it had been cold the night before. Mister Radis came out with a lamp, in his pyjamas. He said: “Bardane, is that you?” I said yes. He said: “Is it all right?” I said yes. He went back to bed. The owl, though, left for good.
textes.Une nuit, j'ai joué jusqu'au lever du so: One night, I played until sunrise. The fishermen went out to sea straight from the party. They slept in their boats. Not a single sardine.
textes.Une nuit, j'ai joué très tard, seule sur: One night, I played very late, alone on the empty square. When I finished, I heard a tiny sound at the top of a street lamp: someone was clapping with their fingertips, very softly. I looked up. Nox hid behind the lantern. He's far too tall to hide behind a lantern.
textes.Une nuit, j'ai tapé si fort au moment de: One night, I hit so hard when the moon came up that the skin of my drum split. Pfft! Nothing left. Lilas finished the dance to Bourru's drum alone, ever so slowly. Afterwards, she said it was the most beautiful night of the year. The night my drum died! I still don't get it.
textes.Une nuit, j'ai trouvé Gunnar endormi deb: One night, I found Gunnar asleep on his feet in the hall, leaning on his shield. He'd been on watch for two days, standing in for someone who was ill. I put my cloak around his shoulders and went to bed. In the morning, he handed it back, folded, red as a ruby. A real one.
textes.Une nuit, j'ai vu Thalion seul devant la: One night I saw Thalion alone at the door of the Mother Tree, his hand on the wood, perfectly still, for a whole hour. The next day he asked me what I'd seen. I said: “Nothing.” He said: “Good.” We've never said anything kinder to each other.
textes.Une nuit, j'ai vu une lumière bleue sur: One night, I saw a blue light on Stoneheart. Right in front of the great gate. It was blinking, like a beating heart.
textes.Une nuit, j'avais peur de rentrer seule: One night, I was scared to walk back to the temple alone because of a noise in an alley. Sire Tancrède walked me home, sword in hand, shouting his name at every street corner, “just in case”. It was a cat. The cat ran off. The whole Lower Town woke up. But I wasn't scared anymore, all the way to the temple. It was very kind.
textes.Une nuit, j'étais devant la porte de l'A: One night I stood before the door of the Mother Tree. An hour. Alone. The next day Ilyria gave me an odd look. I asked her what she'd seen. She said: “Nothing.” She lied. For me. Since then, I forgive her the apples. Almost.
textes.Une nuit, je l'ai trouvée seule sur les: One night, I found her alone on the palace steps. I sat down beside her and sang the lullaby of the old island, very softly. She closed her eyes and murmured the words along with me. She sings like a seagull. I'll never tell her.
One night I confiscated his harp. Security reasons. He went and sang under Ilyria's window. Without the harp. I gave the harp back after one verse. The harp, at least, plays in tune.
textes.Une nuit, je me suis assise seule sur le: One night, I sat alone on the palace steps. Nausicaa sat down beside me without a word, then sang a lullaby from the old island, one I thought I was the last to know. Her mother had it from mine. I didn't cry. Not in front of a subject.
textes.Une nuit, je ne me suis pas réveillé pou: One night, I didn't wake up for the midnight song. For the first time in forty years. Citlali came and knocked on my door, gently: “Master, the stars are waiting.” We sang, the two of us, on the roof of the calmecac. She never told anyone. She's capable of that: that's why she's a teacher.
textes.Une nuit, je suis allée réveiller Photon: One night, I went to wake Photon: his flowers were blinking like mad. Three of my sky jellyfish were sleeping in the petals, and the flowers were laughing because it tickled. Photon smiled and said: “Let's leave them.” Since then, he always keeps three flowers open at night, for them.
textes.Une nuit, je suis descendue moi-même pla: One night I went down myself to plant the ring of mushrooms, near the wall of speakers. Everyone was dancing. Lulu was asleep against a speaker. She opened one eye, looked at me, and said: “Hiya… great costume.” Then she went back to sleep. The next day the mushrooms were glowing, and she wasn't even surprised.
textes.Une nuit, je suis passée en lévitant dev: One night, I levitated past his big telescope, in my white cape. He quickly noted “unknown comet, braided tail”. I went and knocked on his window. He looked at my braid. He was a little disappointed. I was flattered. He kept the page. I'm the only comet on the island.
textes.Une nuit, je suis restée tard, cachée de: One night, I stayed late, hidden behind a shelf, to see who was borrowing the poems. I saw Nox come in through the window with his lamplighter's pole. He took the book, breathed in the smell of the pages, smiled, and left. I've never told him I saw him. It's more beautiful that way.
textes.Une nuit, je suis venu voir mes bananier: One night, I came to see my banana trees and heard Barnabé reading them a map out loud. “Here, a reef. Here, a badly placed rock.” He was explaining to them that it wasn't his fault. The banana trees were listening. I tiptoed away. The next day, every one of them had grown a bunch.
textes.Une nuit, la petite lumière sous la couv: One night, the little light under Lin's blanket went out all of a sudden. I thought she'd gone into the book! I jumped out of bed and lifted her blanket, shouting her name. She was asleep, nose on page twenty. She opened one eye and said “Shh”. I was a bit disappointed, to be honest.
textes.Une nuit, le cristal a clignoté et tout: One night, the crystal flickered and the whole dome went black. Just for a moment! But I heard the sea against the dome, like someone knocking to come in. Mum hugged me so tight I had her necklace printed on my cheek. Since then, before I go to sleep, I count to ten, to check the light stays on.
textes.Une nuit, le thérémine de Vibrato est to: One night, Vibrato's theremin broke down in the middle of a piece. I kept dancing, looking at him. So he sang. Him, who never sings. It went “oooooh,” with his mouth, very off-key, very soft. I danced to the end. It's my favourite dance of my whole life.
textes.Une nuit, ma lumière s'est éteinte sous: One night, my light went out under the covers: I'd fallen asleep. Mirabelle lifted my blanket shouting my name. She thought I'd gone into the book. I was on page twenty. I told her “Hush”. She looked disappointed. A little relieved. Mostly disappointed.
textes.Une nuit, ma montre l'a réveillé par err: One night, my watch woke him up by mistake. He ran to the Column in his pyjamas, at three in the morning. He was early. For the first time in his life. I very nearly had a medal made for him.
textes.Une nuit, ma potion a fait une fumée vio: One night, my potion made a purple smoke that came up through the floor into the whole shop. For a month, L'Alambic smelled of violets and burnt sugar. People came specially to sniff it! Monsieur Gustave sold twice as much. I asked him for a percentage. He gave it to me. I'm a businesswoman.
textes.Une nuit, nous avons tant parlé de coura: One night, we talked so much about currents and depths that the bookshop closed around us. Félix forgot to throw me out, and I forgot to leave. We woke at dawn, he on an atlas, I on a heap of sea charts, with the contours of the channel printed on my cheek.
textes.Une nuit, on a fait le guet derrière ses: One night, we kept watch behind his nets, to see who leaves shells on his boat. We fell asleep. When we woke up, there were shells everywhere, one on my head and one on Fañch's nose. We still don't know who it is. Since then, now and again, I leave a shell back.
textes.Une nuit, on a guetté Sobek dans mon cha: One night, Khéty and I lay in wait for Sobek in my field, hidden behind the shadoof. After an hour, Khéty was asleep. He was snoring like a drowning hippopotamus. The crocodile didn't come. Khéty says that was his strategy. Me, I think Sobek got scared. I would have too.
textes.Une nuit, on a guetté Sobek ensemble dan: One night, we lay in wait for Sobek together in Hapou's field, hiding behind the shaduf. I fell asleep. I snored, apparently, like a hippo with a cold. The crocodile never came. Hapou says I scared it off. I say it was my strategy. We don't agree, but the wheat was safe that night.
textes.Une nuit, on a hoché la tête neuf heures: One night, Tchoum and I nodded our heads for nine hours straight, without a word. The next day, neither of us could turn our necks. We greeted each other by swivelling our whole bodies. Mistral laughed so hard he fluffed a transition. It's the only time I've ever seen him fluff one.
textes.Une nuit, on a oublié l'heure. Au matin,: One night, we lost track of time. In the morning, we were both asleep on the big map in the bookshop, him with his head on the south-west, me on the dwarves' island. He had an ocean trench printed on his cheek. He went off for his three coffees like that, very dignified.
textes.Une nuit, on a voulu voir qui laisse les: One night, we wanted to see who leaves the shells on my boat. We hid behind the nets, with a blanket and some sparkling apple. We both fell asleep. When we woke up, there were shells on the boat. And one on Lucie's head, and one on mine. We never tried again.
textes.Une nuit, par curiosité, j'ai mesuré sa: One night, out of curiosity, I measured her little light: it lasted nine hours, without flickering. Mine lasts four. I didn't tell her. I noted it in my journal, between two comets. She's a sort of comet too: you don't see her coming, and then she lights everything up.
textes.Une nuit, sur les pentes du Mont Fumant,: One night, on the slopes of the Smoking Mountain, I got lost. By a stream, I saw two eyes. A jaguar. The real one. He looked at me for a long time. I didn't move. Neither did he. Then he left, without a sound, the way my father taught me. Since then, I don't hunt jaguars. It's my name. Not my game.
textes.Une nuit, toute la ville est tombée en p: One night, the whole city had a blackout. I was scared. Then I saw the Night Market, lit by lanterns, full of people laughing around Hiro's pots. I told myself: my city doesn't run on neon. It runs on people.

One night, the whole city had a blackout. No neon, no screens, no monorail. Everyone came to the Night Market: we had lanterns and broth. We threw the biggest party in the history of Neopolis. The next day, people asked me when the next blackout would be.
textes.Une nuit, un gobelin a essayé d'entrer p: One night, a goblin tried to get in through the North Gate. I was asleep. He thought I was a statue, he tried to carry me off, and he couldn't lift me. He left in tears. It's my only great deed. I didn't see it.
textes.Une nuit, un gobelin est arrivé à la Por: One night, a goblin came to the North Gate. I was asleep on my feet. It thought I was a statue and wanted to carry me back to its camp as decoration. It pulled, pushed, puffed. I'm too heavy. It went off crying. The next day, its footprints were found all around me. I didn't feel a thing.
textes.Une nuit, une forme blanche est passée d: One night, a white shape passed in front of my big telescope, with a long braided tail. A comet! I noted everything: the time, the trajectory, the colour. Then there was a knock at my window. It was Zéphyrine, with her braid. I was a little disappointed. She was very flattered. I kept the page. It's my finest observation.
textes.Une nuit, une fumée violette est montée: One night, a purple smoke rose up from the cellar through the floorboards. The whole shop smelled of violets and burnt sugar for a month. Customers came in droves to find out what it was. I sold twice as much as usual. Mirabelle asked me for a percentage. I gave it to her. She'll go far.
textes.Une nuit, une gargouille a plongé sur le: One night, a gargoyle dived onto the rampart. I struck. My sword snapped clean on its stone skin. I finished the fight with the hilt, and a bucket. The next day, I handed in my halberd and went to see Ferronde at the Great Forge. I told her: “We need better blades. I'll sell them.”
textes.Une nuit, une grenouille géante a emport: One night, a giant frog made off with my boat. It pushed it out to the middle of the lake and sat down in it. In the morning, it was still there, sunbathing. I waited three days for it to leave. Ulric brought me food on the shore. Frog. I ate it while looking at the boat. It was a delicious revenge.
textes.Une nuit, une étoile au-dessus du Phare: One night, a star above the Lighthouse winked at me. Then again. I named her Clémentine. Everyone tells me it's the Lighthouse, or a lantern, or my dirty glasses. I cleaned my glasses. She still winks.
textes.Une nuit, à minuit passé, on a frappé à: One night, past midnight, someone knocked at my door. Électre, twenty years old, hair standing straight up, a bottle in her arms. Inside it, a lightning bolt. A real one, trapped, swimming in circles like a goldfish. I spent an hour watching it, in my nightgown. The next day I requested the Volta laboratory for her. I got it that very evening.
textes.Une nuit. Une seule. Dans la chambre un,: One night. Just one. In room one, the suite with three windows. Breakfast brought up by someone else, on a tray, with a napkin folded into a swan.
textes.Une nuée de fées te rattrape au vol, en: A swarm of fairies catches you in mid-air, laughing, and sets you back down in the glade. “Mind the edge!”
textes.Une odeur de pain d'épices et de beurre: A smell of gingerbread and melted butter. Suddenly you're very hungry.
textes.Une oreille levée : je t'écoute. Une ore: One ear up: I'm listening. One ear down: I love you. Both: I'm listening and I love you. All the time.
textes.Une page arrachée au grand grimoire de M: A page torn from Madame Olga's great spellbook: a magic circle drawn in purple ink, notes in the margin ("do not read aloud", "nor quietly"). It glows a little in the dark.
textes.Une page de « La Valse d'Azur », la chan: A page of "La Valse d'Azur", Django's song. The notes are a little faded by the sea spray.
textes.Une paillote sur chaque île ! Une chez l: A beach hut on every island! One with the elves, one on the flying island, one under the sea with very long straws. And with the dwarves. Especially with the dwarves: they're thirsty, and they don't know coconut punch yet.
textes.Une paire de baguettes de batterie en ér: A pair of maple drumsticks, chewed at the tips, with "BILGE RATS" carved in with a knife. They're waiting for someone who can keep a good beat.
textes.Une pancarte gravée : « GRAND CONCOURS D: An engraved sign: “GREAT GRIMACE CONTEST — 1,147th edition.”
textes.Une part de gâteau rien que pour toi !: A slice of cake just for you!
textes.Une partie ? Non ? Regardez-le jouer con: A game? No? Watch it play against itself, then. … A draw. It's offended. Don't tell the jury it's offended.
textes.Une partie de dés contre le roi en perso: A game of dice against the king himself, in his palace, with his crown on the table. I wouldn't keep the crown. Just long enough to try it on in front of a mirror.
textes.Une partie de pétanque. Je gagne. Presqu: A game of pétanque. I'm winning. Almost.
textes.Une partie parfaite. Personne ne triche,: A perfect game. Nobody cheats, nobody shouts, nobody gets up. Just the dice, the green baize and the sound of the rain. Just one, before I retire.
textes.Une partie, une seule, où Raymond et moi: One game, just one, where Raymond and I agreed on the point. No tape measure, no argument. We'd look at each other and say: “It's yours.” Well. It'll never happen. But it's a dream, isn't it?
textes.Une partie, Ébène ? Sans histoire, cette: A game, Ébène? No stories this time.
A colander, Orbe. Full of holes.
textes.Une peintre des Nuées, Ombeline, est des: A painter from the Clouds, Ombeline, came down with forty tubes of blue. She wanted to paint the light of the Dome. She stayed three days. She left asking for violet: she'd seen the Great Pearl in the evening. She left a painting at the school. A sky. My class's first real sky.
textes.Une pelle d'Octave ! Hmpf. Elle creuse,: One of Octave's shovels! Hmph. It digs, I suppose. Go and dig up the beach here, then: I lost some coins there at low tide.
textes.Une pelle. Le meilleur ami du chercheur: A shovel. A treasure hunter's best friend. Stick it in the beach sand and push: click, and it digs. Each spot can only be dug once, so keep moving.
textes.Une pelote de laine rouge vif, un peu dé: A ball of bright red wool, a little unravelled. No cat in the world can resist it. Not even very dignified cats.
textes.Une perle ! Elle ira au centre de ma col: A pearl! It'll go in the middle of my collection, between the mother-of-pearl and the mother-of-pearl. Thank you, {surnom}.
textes.Une perle ! Vous l'avez dit ! Je le répè: A gem! You said it! I've been saying it for eighteen years and they accuse me of campaigning. May I quote you in my next speech?
textes.Une perle bien ronde, sortie d'un trésor: A perfectly round pearl, taken from a buried treasure. Octave buys it for 10 coins.
textes.Une perle bleu nuit montée en pendentif: A midnight-blue pearl set as a pendant on a silver thread by Ernest Coquillard. The oysters on the cliffs of the Trench make them very slowly, in the dark; Lou brings back only one a week. It holds a gleam of the Great Pearl.
textes.Une perle grosse comme une prune, qui lu: A pearl as big as a plum, glowing with a blue light. The Great Crystal of Atlantis feeds on them. Queen Néréa is waiting for three.
A measure of saffron, Lalla Aïcha.
textes.Une petite araignée a tissé une toile en: A little spider has spun a web between the head's chin and the grass. Nothing else.
textes.Une petite assiette à la sauce tomate ?: A little plate with tomato sauce? I knew it.
textes.Une petite barque. Deux places. Pour sor: A little boat. Two seats. To go out with Khadija one day without fishing. No net. Just looking at the sea. Together.
textes.Une petite cabine, Firmin ? Demain matin: A little cabin ride, Firmin? Tomorrow morning?
textes.Une petite clochette de laiton au bout d: A little brass bell on the end of a green ribbon. When you shake it, somewhere, a little pig pricks up its ears.
textes.Une petite clochette forgée par Ursule e: A little bell forged by Ursule and tempered in the mist. It rings clearer than all the bells on the island.
textes.Une petite clé : approche-toi d'un coffr: A little key: go up to a locked chest and open it, it will do the rest.
textes.Une petite clé de fer à l'anneau en trèf: A small iron key with a clover-shaped ring. It opens one locked chest (only once: it stays in the lock).
textes.Une petite déclaration ? Pour l'édition: A little statement? For tomorrow's edition?
textes.Une petite fiole d'huile ambrée, à l'ode: A small vial of amber oil, smelling of burnt wood and vanilla: Tiburce, the polisher, rubs it on his customers' horns until they shine like mirrors.
textes.Une petite fresque au fond de la niche :: A small fresco at the back of the niche: a pond ringed by tall trees, a bronze sluice gate on its edge, and above, a full moon pouring its light down to the bottom of the water. The mist folk, in Ramure… Mother Moon will know.
textes.Une petite gargote sur le quai de Tazira: A little eatery on the quay at Tazira, with blue tables, all the cumin you want, and a pot that sings all day long. Ho ho!
textes.Une petite lanterne d'argent et de verre: A small lantern of silver and glass, entrusted to you by Faelar. The firefly spirits of Bois-Doré can shelter inside it. Bring them back to the door of the Mother Tree.
textes.Une petite m'a demandé si l'air de la Ch: A little girl asked me if the air from the Chimney had seen the sky. I said yes. She breathed in very hard, three times. To keep a bit of it.
textes.Une petite mandarine du Verger des Lampe: A little mandarin from the Lamp Orchard, ripened under an artificial sun at the bottom of the sea. It blushes on one side only. Ernest eats one a day, on Mélisande's bench. Restores one heart.
textes.Une petite méduse rose flotte là, toute: A little pink jellyfish floats there, all trembling. Plume-de-Nuage! She looks at you… and settles above your shoulder. She follows you: gently take her back to the Greenhouse of Species (east of the city), without running too far ahead!
textes.Une petite ombre blanche, un croissant d: A little white shadow, a croissant in its mouth, racing off towards the crates east of the quay. I'd say a dog. Or a very small baker.
A small slice? You've lost weight. Two.
textes.Une petite pause, ami. Mon armure pèse l: A little break, friend. My armour weighs as much as a donkey. A big donkey.
textes.Une petite pause… Ô Aube, donne-moi des: A little break… O Dawn, give me new legs. Mine are tired.
textes.Une petite pièce de bronze, usée, une ba: A small worn bronze coin with a boat engraved on it. The fare to cross the Acheron: Charon, the ferryman, accepts nothing else (and he counts).
A small room full of seashells. Whoever collects them has never seen the beach.
textes.Une petite pièce secrète. Un seul meuble: A small secret room. Only one piece of furniture: a chest. The kind of chest you hide behind a bookcase.
textes.Une petite plaque : « Maquette offerte p: A little plaque: “Model presented by the pupils of the Cloud School. Scale: one centimetre to one metre. Each floor was glued on by a different child.”
textes.Une petite porte, Pyrus ! Celle de la re: A little door, Pyrus! The shed door!
textes.Une petite salle de spectacle : une estr: A little theater: a stage, a red curtain, and an audience of little Moai waiting, giggling.
textes.Une petite tarte banane-coco, juste une: A little banana-coconut tart, just one?
A little crossing does you good.
One little screw, and there you go.
textes.Une petite voix étouffée : « Hi hi hi… f: A small muffled voice: “Hee hee hee… cold… all cold!”
textes.Une petite voix, quelque part : « Un, de: A small voice, somewhere: “One, two, three… No! You're the one who's seeking! You'll never find me!”
textes.Une petite, Paulo. Mon pantalon me surve: A small one, Paulo. My trousers are keeping an eye on me.
A small one is seven onions.
A little one. She was nice.
A small one. For the smell.
textes.Une photo ? Charmant, charmant ! Attende: A photo? Charming, charming! Wait, wait… which hat? The Tuesday hat? The cherry hat? (He tries on three.) This one. No, this one. Oh, all three. (He stacks them on his head.) Click! Oh! A little Baron made of light! With three hats! It's my best portrait. Aurore! Aurore, come and see! … Ah, no, never mind. She'll scold me about the hats.
textes.Une photo ? Pour un touriste ? (Il redre: A photo? For a tourist? (He straightens his sash, smooths his moustache, sucks in his tummy.) One moment! The left profile! It's my best. The right one lost the election at the boules club. There. Smile, Port-Azur! (Click! A little hologram of him appears, smiling.) Oh! I'm in three dimensions! Colette is going to be jealous: she's only in two.
textes.Une photo nette. Une seule ! De toute la: One sharp photo. Just one! Of the whole family at sunset: Sylvie, Théo and me. No thumb. With the lighthouse behind us, nice and straight.
textes.Une pierre de feu s'écrase sur toi ! Reg: A fire stone crashes down on you! Watch the ground: where it glows red, fire is about to fall.
textes.Une pierre lourde veinée de rouille, ram: A heavy stone veined with rust, picked up on the slopes of the volcano. Borin the blacksmith makes steel from it.
textes.Une pierre noire, creusée d'une empreint: A black stone, carved with a round imprint… the size of an amulet.
textes.Une pierre plate peinte à l'ocre rouge e: A flat stone painted with red ochre and chalk: it's you, as seen by Ocre, the Clan's painter. You're all square. Ocre put yellow around your head, "because you shine".
textes.Une pierre rouge qui brille comme une br: A red stone that glows like an ember. Octave buys it for 30 coins.
textes.Une pincée de ceci, une pincée de cela…: A pinch of this, a pinch of that… I'm cooking.
textes.Une pincée de non, Abyssos. Et deux cuil: A pinch of no, Abyssos. And two spoonfuls of never.
textes.Une pièce délicate : « La Petite Brise e: A delicate piece: “The Little Breeze in B Flat for Solo Sneeze”. The finale is… surprising.
textes.Une pièce les trois. Ou un sourire les d: One coin for three. Or one smile for two. But I've got no change for a smile.
textes.Une pièce ou deux ? C'est très bien ! Ça: A coin or two? That's great! It pays for someone's onions. Onions are important.
A room full of big round rocks. A little Moai by the door is trying very hard not to laugh.
textes.Une pièce sans gravité : les meubles se: A room with no gravity: the furniture sways gently in the air, like boats.
textes.Une pièce secrète, des plans partout sur: A secret room, plans all over the table.
textes.Une pièce secrète, et au fond, un trône…: A secret room, and at the back, a throne… made of stacked cushions, crowned with a gilded paper crown. On a sign: “Here reigns His Majesty the King of Cushions.”
textes.Une pièce secrète… pleine de portraits d: A secret room… full of portraits of the same cat. The cat himself sits enthroned in a velvet armchair. He looks at you as if YOU were the intruder.
textes.Une plante carnivore ! Elle ne bouge pas: A carnivorous plant! It doesn't move, but when it pulls its head back, it's going to bite far ahead: stay out of range, then strike right after its bite.
textes.Une pluie toute fine tombe sur les fleur: A very fine rain falls on the flowers. A drop rolls down a closed wing: the butterfly doesn't even wake up.
textes.Une plume blanche s'est envolée de la so: A white feather flew out of the wind tunnel and landed on your shoulder. “Keep it,” says the technician, “it's a wind feather: it brings pilots luck.” You receive:
textes.Une plume brune et douce, laissée sur le: A soft brown feather, left on Mother Sauge's roof by the owl from the Twisted Wood that you healed.
textes.Une plume de chouette argentée, tombée u: A silvery owl feather, fallen on a full-moon night. In Ramure, every night is a full-moon night.
textes.Une plume de corbeau est tombée sur la p: A crow feather fell on the square, black with blue glints. We saw it at the same time. We ran. I won: he's forty years older than me. That evening, I sharpened it into a quill and left it at his door, with a note. He thinks it's kindness. It's strategy: I copy his maps.
textes.Une plume de lune ! Avec ça, ma brume ne: A moon feather! With this, my mist won't fly away any more. Here, a vial of mist: morning mist, bottled. Ursule says she needs it to temper the silver. I don't ask bears questions.
textes.Une plume de lune pour vos fioles ?: A moon feather for your vials?
textes.Une plume de lune s'est envolée de son é: A moon feather flew out of her shop one windy day. Pivoine ran after it, from bridge to bridge, all the way to the treetop! She arrived at my counter bright red, ears going every which way. The feather had landed on my head. She took it back, saying: “It was coming home anyway.”
textes.Une plume et demie. L'autre moitié s'est: A feather and a half. The other half blew away.
textes.Une plume longue comme un bras, d'un ver: A feather as long as an arm, of a green that shifts to blue and gold: a feather of the Feathered Serpent, the god of wind and knowledge. Brought back from beneath the Great Temple of Aztlán. Its place is on the Altar of the Three Suns.
textes.Une plume qui s'envole, c'est encore ta: A feather that blows away is still your debt.
A bright red apple fallen from a tree. Restores one heart.
textes.Une porte ?! Non, non : un secret. Les p: A door?! No, no: a secret. Doors, now, they like keepers.
textes.Une porte d'argent, ciselée de hiboux qu: A silver door, engraved with sleeping owls. The lock awaits a silver key. (The Great Book, on the lectern, might know where it is.)
textes.Une porte de cuivre, et une grosse serru: A copper door, and a big lock shaped like a frog with its mouth open. (Well, well.) You need a copper key… and one of the frogs has a shiny belly.
textes.Une porte de grès, à demi enfouie dans l: A sandstone door, half buried in the dune. Above it, a golden sun. On the slab, three stone rings engraved with signs: the star, the dune, the sun, the moon, the palm tree, the scarab. A golden notch above each.
textes.Une porte de pierre haute comme cinq hom: A stone door as tall as five men, with no handle or lock. On its two leaves, a great engraved circle glows faintly; around it, four round hollows, empty: the four seals. A warm breath comes through the central crack, as if the mountain were breathing.
textes.Une porte de pierre sans poignée, marqué: A stone door with no handle, marked with a serpent. The four braziers in the hall must have something to do with it…
textes.Une porte de pierre, scellée, sous un li: A sealed stone door, beneath a lintel covered in hieroglyphs. Above it, a sun between two cobras. It seems something on this plateau keeps the key… The Sphinx, perhaps?
textes.Une porte ronde comme un engrenage, en b: A round door like a gear, made of bronze, guarded by two metal statues. On the left, on the wall, three wheels engraved with sheep: one, two, three or four. In the shepherd's corner, against the wall, a painted board…
textes.Une porte sculptée dans l'écorce de l'Ar: A door carved into the bark of the Mother Tree, with no handle or lock. Above it, five little empty niches. Faelar, the Elder, surely knows more.
textes.Une potion ? Tu as l'air d'en avoir beso: A potion? You look like you need one.
textes.Une potion de sève. Bois-la quand tu en: One sap potion. Drink it when you need it, not before. Sap doesn't like to wait.
textes.Une potée fumante de la Cantine Libre :: A steaming hotpot from the Free Canteen: mushrooms from Bertille's Gardens, potatoes, slightly dizzy carrots (they arrive by skateboard), served in a single scoop by Excalibur. Pay what you can: leave what you're able. Restores two hearts.
textes.Une pour le marché… une pour la compote…: One for the market… one for stewed apples… one for me.
textes.Une prédiction pour vous, monsieur Félix: A prediction for you, Monsieur Félix?
textes.Une pâtisserie. Rien que pour moi. Avec: A pastry shop. All mine. With a target at the back, to aim at the chocolate éclairs. You eat what you hit.
textes.Une question : je peux sonner deux fois: One question: can I ring twice?
textes.Une question d'architecte : toi, tu préf: An architect's question: which do you prefer, round houses or square ones?
textes.Une question d'archiviste : si vous devi: An archivist's question: if you had to give the Museum just one object, which would it be?
textes.Une question d'intendante : vous perdez: A steward's question: do you often lose your things?
textes.Une question de bijoutière, si vous perm: A jeweller's question, if I may: do you prefer pearls or stones?
textes.Une question de cartographe : vous, quan: A cartographer's question: when you're lost, what do you do?
textes.Une question de musicien : quelle musiqu: A musician's question: what music makes your heart beat?
textes.Une question de professionnel, {surnom}: A professional question, {surnom}: what's your ideal home?
textes.Une question de service, si vous le perm: A question of service, if I may. Do you sleep with the window open, or closed?
textes.Une question de service, {surnom} : en c: A service question, {surnom}: when an alert sounds, do you run towards the danger or the other way?
textes.Une question importante, mon client : tu: An important question, my customer: do you prefer red apples or green apples?
textes.Une question par jour, c'est notre accor: One question a day, that's our deal. Pip picks them with the seriousness of a notary. “Does the Crystal have dreams?” “Do stars have feet?” “Were you ever little?” That one took me three days to answer. He told me he had two hundred saved up.
textes.Une question pour mon Dictionnaire, {sur: A question for my Dictionary, {surnom}: why do whales sing, in your opinion?
textes.Une question sérieuse, {surnom} : êtes-v: A serious question, {surnom}: are you usually early, on time, or late?
textes.Une question très sérieuse, {surnom} : t: A very serious question, {surnom}: are you more of a tomato sauce or a butter sauce person?
textes.Une question, et réponds franchement : t: A question, and answer honestly: do you follow orders?
textes.Une question, puisque vous êtes là. Vous: A question, since you're here. Do you play chess?
textes.Une question, si vous permettez. Vous cr: A question, if I may. Do you believe in legends?
textes.Une question, simplement. Si vous gagnie: Just a question. If you won… forgive me, if you won everything tonight, would you stop?
textes.Une question, {surnom}. Avant d'entrer q: A question, {surnom}. Before going in somewhere, do you say hello?
textes.Une question, {surnom}. Quand quelque ch: A question, {surnom}. When something works, do you leave it alone or do you check it anyway?
textes.Une question, {surnom}. Quand vous avez: A question, {surnom}. When you have an appointment, how do you arrive?
textes.Une question, {surnom}. Vous préférez qu: A question, {surnom}. Would you rather be left free, or be looked after?
textes.Une question. Réponds franchement. Quand: A question. Answer honestly. When you walk alone at night, do you often look behind you?
textes.Une question. Toi, quand quelque chose e: A question. When something's broken, do you mend it, or throw it out?
textes.Une question. Une seule. Vous avez peur: A question. Just one. Are you afraid of the dark?
textes.Une queue cachée ! Ha ha ha ! Dans ton p: A hidden tail! Ha ha ha! In your trousers?! What colour is it? I won't tell anyone, promise! … Well, maybe Myrtille. And Gland.
textes.Une quête ? Moi ? Non… Mais Mio a toujou: A quest? Me? No… But Mio always has plans. Ask her.
textes.Une reine des fées t'a donné la carte ?: A fairy queen gave you the map? Fairies… Hmph. At least they know how to choose.
A redhead who's fond of you, Admiral.
A hive in every house in Yaxché. In the morning, the whole town would buzz. People would be gentler. Even Ix Chab. Especially Ix Chab.
textes.Une râpe à fromage en laiton doré, gravé: A gilded brass cheese grater, engraved with a crossed fork and spoon. Captain Rigatoni buried it on the beach thirty years ago, "so nobody would steal it". It still smells a little of parmesan.
textes.Une réponse de reine. Les gens des monta: A queen's answer. Mountain folk, forest folk, harbour folk… each to their own shore, I imagine. We have our grumblers too. Coralin counts as three.
textes.Une résine d'arbre jaune pâle, qui brûle: A pale yellow tree resin that burns with a white, fragrant smoke: the incense of the Aztecs, the offering to the sun Huitzilopochtli. Tochtli sells it at the Aztlán market.
textes.Une réussite ! Voilà ! Enfin quelqu'un q: A success! There! At last, someone who understands! Want an umbrella? With a discount? Almost.
textes.Une salle de répétition secrète ! Une ba: A secret rehearsal room! A drum kit, an amp, posters… and cotton balls on the walls so the neighbors hear nothing.
textes.Une salle de sport. Enfin, un salon tran: A gym. Well, a living room turned into a gym.
textes.Une salle immense, des douves d'eau noir: An immense hall, with a moat of black water all around. At the far end, the Sun Stone… The floor vibrates, very faintly.
textes.Une sardine de Gonzague. Et toi, mon onc: One of Gonzague's sardines. And you, uncle?
One of Gonzague's sardines. That counts.
textes.Une sardine sur dix, Moulay Brahim. Comm: One sardine in ten, Moulay Brahim. As usual.
textes.Une sardine, ce n'est pas un repas. C'es: A sardine isn't a meal. It's a fish.
textes.Une selle de cuir et de bronze, forgée à: A saddle of leather and bronze, forged in Forgefer for the eagle riders of old. King Thorgal entrusted it to you: Ventaile, the last of the great eagles, nests on the edge of the crater.
textes.Une semaine avant la Nuit des Lanternes,: A week before the Night of Lanterns, Lumina was cutting paper in my workshop while I prepared the powder. I sneezed. Right over the powder. We got a little firework display early, and a new hole in the roof. Lumina was covered in soot up to her horns. I called it “the dress rehearsal”.
textes.Une semaine plus tard, Clou a posé sur m: A week later, Clou left a knitted cover on my sewing machine, with studs on it. Without a word. My machine looked like a little punk. I named it Clou-Junior. When I told him, he blushed all the way up to his mohawk.
textes.Une semaine, j'ai fait une coquille dans: One week, I made a typo in the Boucanier: “pay-what-you-read soup” instead of “pay-what-you-need”. The Sergeant read it out on air just like that. The next day, everyone came to the Canteen with a book to pay. Lentille opened a library. It's still there.
textes.Une seule ? Notez-le, c'est presque un r: Just one? Write it down, that's almost a record.
textes.Une seule ? Voilà qui mérite d'être noté: Only one? Now that deserves to be noted.
textes.Une seule fois, Yasmine m'a laissé être: Just once, Yasmine let me be captain. Once! I took the helm, well, the stick, and I set course… for the fountain. We “sank”. For real, a bit: I was wet up to my neck. Afterwards, Yasmine made me her second. I thought second was better than first, like when you have seconds of tajine. That's not it. Somebody explained.
textes.Une seule fois, il y a des années, j'ai: Just once, years ago, I took the cable car. Forty seconds. When I got to the bottom, I was green. As green as Professor Boum's sheep. Ernest watched me get out of the cabin and said, very seriously: “Forty seconds. That's the record. Nobody's ever turned green so fast.” He wrote it down in his logbook.
textes.Une seule fois, j'ai gagné contre Victor: Just once, I beat Victor. All evening, every game. That night, Lola had the night off. Victor figured it out before I did. He put his cards away with a sigh: “Let's hope she's back tomorrow. For my finances.”
textes.Une seule fois, j'ai trouvé. Cardamome m: Just once, I got it. Cardamome asked me: “I fall without getting hurt, I shine without fire, and I cry without sorrow.” I happened to be crying at the time. I said: “A drop… like me?” That was it! She wrote it in her big book. It was kind. A bit humiliating too.
textes.Une seule fois, je n'ai rien répété. Une: Only once did I not pass anything on. A little girl told me she was afraid of the dark. I didn't tell a soul. Years later, she became a lighthouse keeper. It's Margot. She isn't afraid of the dark any more. She lights it up every evening.
textes.Une seule fraise de Flora suffit pour un: Just one of Flora's strawberries is enough for a whole tart. A tart for six. Or for me, on a Sunday.
textes.Une seule nouille… Je n'en dors plus, vo: A single noodle… I can't sleep anymore, you know. Thank you.
textes.Une seule… très longue… (Elle laisse tom: Just one… very long… (She drops her pencil.) … Good heavens. That would explain everything. I have to start all over again.
textes.Une sieste ? Excellente idée. Je vous ré: A nap? Excellent idea. I'll wake you at seven in the evening.
textes.Une sieste ? Le hamac du fond. Je te rév: A nap? The hammock at the back. I'll wake you for the seven o'clock soup.
textes.Une sieste ? Le lit à ressorts vous atte: A nap? The spring bed is waiting for you. Careful, it's in a playful mood.
textes.Une sieste ? Les murs sont épais, il fai: A nap? The walls are thick, it's cool. I'll wake you for the evening tea.
textes.Une sieste dans un hamac jusqu'au soir: A nap in a hammock until evening
textes.Une sieste sur un lit à ressorts: A nap on a spring bed
textes.Une soucoupe de passage a voulu vendre à: A passing saucer tried to sell Nébula an old engine, very expensive, swearing it worked. I happened to be passing. I took a look and said: “It's dead.” The trader left with his engine. Nébula winked at me. Since then, she always keeps the best nebula flower for me.
textes.Une soupe ! Ah, tu as le cœur d'un mineu: A soup! Ah, you've got a miner's heart. Sit down, there's always one on the stove. And don't say “no thank you”, I'm not listening.
textes.Une station météo dans le salon ! Un ané: A weather station in the living room! An anemometer spins by the big window, a barometer gleams on the wall, and a little girl presents the weather report in front of a big blackboard.
textes.Une sur dix, Moulay Brahim. C'est la loi: One in ten, Moulay Brahim. That's the law.
textes.Une sur trois, Pélagos ! Je compte très: One in three, Pélagos! I count perfectly well!
textes.Une table pour deux, mon marié ?: A table for two, my groom?
textes.Une tablette de pierre gravée d'une tête: A stone tablet carved with a jaguar's head and four dots: 4 Jaguar, the Sun of the Jaguars, the first of the five suns.
textes.Une tablette de pierre gravée de flammes: A stone tablet carved with flames falling from the sky and four dots: 4 Rain, the Sun of Fire-rain.
textes.Une tablette de pierre gravée de vagues: A stone tablet carved with waves and four dots: 4 Water, the Sun of the Water, the sun of the great flood.
textes.Une tablette de pierre gravée du masque: A stone tablet carved with the mask of Ehécatl, the wind beak, and four dots: 4 Wind, the Sun of the Wind.
textes.Une tasse de porcelaine qui remue son th: A porcelain cup that stirs its own tea, thanks to a little motor hidden in the handle.
textes.Une teuf sous l'eau, à l'Atlantide. Les: A party under the sea, in Atlantis. Fish on the dance floor, the bubble throbbing, and maybe the queen keeping time. All I'm missing is speakers that can swim.
textes.Une théière fume sur une petite table ro: A teapot steams on a small round table. “Come in! There's some left!”
textes.Une tisane parfumée aux fleurs de nuit,: A tea scented with night flowers, still warm. Restores one and a half hearts.
textes.Une tisane, Sébastien. Dans ton grog, si: An herbal tea, Sébastien. In your grog, if you like.
textes.Une tisane, alors. Pour la gorge du cont: Herbal tea, then. For the storyteller's throat.
textes.Une touffe d'herbe argentée, cueillie au: A tuft of silvery grass, picked at the water's edge in the Drowned Marsh. The Doc makes his remedy for marsh fever with it.
textes.Une touriste polie qui achète des pêches: A polite tourist who buys peaches for her little one. She has good taste in reading, I think. She blushes at the slightest thing.
textes.Une toute petite ? Pour la garder ?: A tiny one? To keep it?
textes.Une toute petite boulangerie au bout de: A tiny little bakery at the end of the beach, open at sunrise, for the hungry dancers. I'd call it “The Crescent Moon”. And Margaux would come and taste. And she'd be proud. There.
textes.Une toute petite, Amirale. Avec une baig: A tiny one, Admiral. With a bathtub.
textes.Une toute petite, Frère Cendrin ! Pour l: Just a tiny one, Brother Cendrin! For the Academy bell!
textes.Une trappe dans le socle du château d'ea: A hatch in the base of the water tower: two cans of spray paint and a child's drawing, very proud, signed “Tornade”.
textes.Une trappe près de la tête de pierre ? E: A trapdoor near the stone head? And a tunnel running toward the village? If Barnabé finds out, he'll say he knew all along. Don't tell him.
textes.Une trappe sous les pierres levées ?! Et: A trapdoor under the standing stones?! And a temple underneath?! I always knew it. Well, I always sort of suspected it. Gaston, get my boots ready. My boot.
textes.Une truffe noire et parfumée, déterrée p: A black, fragrant truffle, dug up by Truffe the pig (yes, his name means truffle, and he lives up to it). It smells like the forest after the rain. Restores two hearts.
textes.Une vague. Tu viens de la mer, toi, ça s: A wave. You come from the sea, you do — I can tell. I'll weave it in Rainville blue.
textes.Une valse pour les liftiers ! Un, deux,: A waltz for the liftkeepers! One, two, three… and up we go!
textes.Une vieille borne de grès, rongée par le: An old sandstone marker, eaten away by the sand wind. At the top, an openwork bronze star. An engraved arrow points northeast, toward the dunes.
textes.Une vieille botte… Bon. Ça compte quand: An old boot… Well. Does it still count?
textes.Une vieille cave voûtée. Au fond, un cof: An old vaulted cellar. At the back, an iron-bound chest… Grandfather's treasure?
textes.Une vieille lettre… Ah. Celles-là, on ne: An old letter… Ah. Those, you never reread them and you never throw them away. The best of useless things. I won't ask who it's from. Well, I will, a little.
textes.Une vieille pièce d'or frappée d'une cou: An old gold coin stamped with a crown. Octave gives 12 copper coins for it.
textes.Une vieille puce vocale, grosse comme un: An old voice chip, the size of a stamp, with golden legs and a yellowed label: "Z SERIES — VOICE No. 0". They haven't been made for thirty years. Cargo had kept it, just in case.
textes.Une vieille vanne de bronze, toute verte: An old bronze sluice, all green, half stuck in the mud. A big cogwheel, two pinions fused by time… No hand will ever turn it.
textes.Une ville où l'on mange bien est une vil: A town where people eat well is a town where people live well. Port-Azur eats very well. Thanks to me.
A twenty-fifth speaker. On the left. For balance. … I'd call it Mistral.
textes.Une vipère des abysses ! Quand elle se l: An abyssal viper! When it coils up and raises its head, it's going to leap straight ahead: step aside, or parry (F).
textes.Une vitrine pour chaque île d'en bas, re: A display case for every island down below, full of objects that tell of life there. And in the middle, an empty case, with a label: “The most precious thing the Heavy-Feet have”. I don't know yet what to put in it. Maybe nothing. Maybe everything.
textes.Une voile ! Non, une mouette. Une mouett: A sail! No, a seagull. A seagull that looks like a sail!
textes.Une voile au nord-est ! Ou un nuage. Je: A sail to the north-east! Or a cloud. I'm checking.
A sail, captain! … Or a seagull. Checking.
textes.Une voix d'avare, dans le mur : « Pourqu: A miser's voice, from inside the wall: “Why do you hoard?” Another answers: “Why do you spend?”
textes.Une voix de pierre, grave comme le déser: A voice of stone, deep as the desert: “I guard the door of Ra. Answer my three questions, and it will open. Get one wrong, and come back when you know.”
textes.Une voix, très grave, qui semble venir d: A very deep voice, which seems to come from the whole mountain: “Two hundred years… Two hundred years that the anger of the earth burned in me. The four peoples had put me to sleep; you have soothed me. Take this: a shard of my heart. And tell them… tell them to come back and sing before the gate, once a year, as before.”
textes.Une volière géante sur la colline, avec: A giant aviary on the hill, with all the parrots of the jungle, the red ones and the blue ones, free to come and go. And a sign: “Here, we speak politely.” They won't be able to read it, but it's the thought that counts!
textes.Une vraie boutique, avec un toit ! Des f: A real shop, with a roof! Fruit from all over the island: dates from Tazira, cider apples from Carène… and a till full of jingling coins. Ding!
textes.Une vraie conque, cette fois ! Presque v: A real conch this time! Almost real!
textes.Une vraie de vraie. Promis sur les racin: A real real one. Promise on the roots.
textes.Une vraie de vraie. Qu'est-ce qui est pe: A real real one. What is small and never loses heart?
textes.Une vraie école de danse, avec un parque: A real dance school, with a wooden floor, a mirror and a sign. Pupils with two legs and with four. And for the opening party, a wall of sound tuned by… well, by someone who tunes really well.
textes.Une vraie, cette fois ? Pas une facile ?: A real one this time? Not an easy one?
textes.Une vue sur la mer ! J'ai exactement ce: A sea view! I have exactly what you need. Ah no, the lighthouse is sold. But the Cottage has a sea view. From afar. If you lean out.
textes.Une âme contemplative ! Les meilleurs él: A contemplative soul! The best flame students are often the ones who watch first. They learn how the fire breathes before disturbing it.
textes.Une écaille de Nâga ?! Cent pièces. Non,: A Nâga scale?! A hundred coins. No, don't argue: a hundred coins, and I'll forge you a shield the day you have five.
textes.Une écaille du Serpent des Abysses ? Si: A scale from the Serpent of the Deep? If you have one… I'll pay a fortune. A real fortune.
textes.Une écaille du Serpent des Abysses, vert: A scale from the Serpent of the Abyss, green and hard as jade, as wide as a hand. Proof of your victory. Octave would give a fortune for it.
textes.Une écharpe pour mon petit-fils. Il est: A scarf for my grandson. He's a liftkeeper: his neck is always cold.
textes.Une édition spéciale. En une, en lettres: A special edition. On the front page, in enormous letters: “ACHILLE HAS LANDED”. The letters are already set, in lead, in a drawer. I made them the very first evening. They're waiting. So am I.
textes.Une énigme, humain ! « Plus j'ai de gard: A riddle, human! “The more people keep me, the less I am kept.” What am I?
textes.Une énigme, ça ne se met pas dans un pot: You can't put a riddle in a jar.
textes.Une épée ! Bien sûr, tu es un aventurier: A sword! Of course, you're an adventurer. But one day, when you don't need it any more, think of my Free Shop. I have a “retired swords” shelf. It's empty. For now.
textes.Une épée d'acier ? C'est Octave qui te l: A steel sword? Octave sold you that. How much? … Too much. Always too much.
textes.Une épée d'acier d'Octave ? Pas mal… pou: A steel sword by Octave? Not bad… for a tall one. I'd do better. Much better.
textes.Une épée d'entraînement taillée à la for: A training sword carved at the forge. Damage: 3.
textes.Une épée ne coupe pas un arbre : elle s': A sword doesn't cut down a tree: it would go dull. Take an axe.
textes.Une épée taillée dans un éclat du crista: A sword cut from a shard of the Stoneheart crystal, given by the soothed Guardian. It is warm, and beats softly, like a heart. Damage: 9.
